text.施展热情之风技能，按照恢复能力的20%恢复生命最少队员生命。: When using Wind of Passion, restores HP of the Party member with lowest HP by 20% of Heal.
text.热情之风技能命中目标时，按照每秒伤害的20%，造成额外伤害，若命中队员，则按照恢: On Wind of Passion's hit, inflicts extra 20% damage of DPS. In case there's a Party member on its way, restores the Party member's HP by 10% of Heal.
text.掷出三向火扇再收回，造成伤害，并附带击飞效果。: Throws burning fans to three ways then pulls them back. Puts enemies in Airborne state.
text.给我方全部人员形成屏障，抵消3次伤害并持续20秒，恢复10%生命。: Creates a barrier for all allies that negates the damage of 3 hit(s) from enemies for 20 second(s), restores HP by 10%.
text.命中目标时，移动速度、武器技能恢复速度、次元切割攻击速度提升20%并持续2秒。: On hit, increases moving speed, weapon skill regen speed, Dimension Breaker's attacking speed by 20% for 2 second(s).
text.命中目标时，以40%概率，按照每秒伤害的30%造成额外近程伤害；此外，英雄自身恢:
On hit, inflicts 30% of DPS as additional melee damage with a 40% chance. Additionally, she recovers her own HP by 2% and the HP of other allies by 6%.
When using Tempest of Time and Space, allies' Atk increases by 20% for 8 seconds.
text.借助时空威力引起巨大风暴，造成近程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Creates a giant tempest of time and space to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.向目标发射神灵箭，按照每秒伤害的475%，对敌人造成远程范围伤害。: Shoots spirit arrows that inflict 475% of DPS as ranged damage.
text.制造巨型漩涡吸引周围敌人，按照每秒伤害的450%造成远程伤害，使我方全部人员暴击: Spins a massive pool of water that sucks in surrounding enemies to inflict 450% of DPS as ranged damage and increase all allies' Crit Hit Chance by 20% for 5 seconds.
text.装备弓，伤害值提升20%，装备篮子，普通攻击恢复值提升1倍。: With a bow equipped, Atk increases by 20%. With a basket equipped, normal attack's Heal doubles.
text.战斗中，英雄的承受伤害减免30%；命中目标时，防御提升30%并持续3秒。: Damage taken during battle decreases by 30%. On hit, Def increases by 30% for 3 seconds.
text.普通攻击扩散伤害值提升50%，命中一名目标敌人时，按照每秒伤害的30%，造成额外: Damage within the Sorcery's reach increases by 50%. Inflicts extra 30% of DPS as ranged damage when it hits a single enemy.
text.召唤风雨圣鸟，对前方敌人造成远程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Summons a holy bird that rules over rain and wind to inflict ranged damage to enemies in front. Puts enemies in a(n) Downed state.
text.佩戴武器时，英雄的职业技能随着武器而变。\n- 作为非队长时也能使用武器技能，但:
When equipped, the Hero’s abilities will adjust to fit the weapon.
- Even when not the party leader, the weapon skill can still be used, but only 20% of damage and Ailment will be applied.
- When the weapon skill hits a single target, the damage dealt is increased by 50%.
- Party Effects will change to Increase Weapon Skill Regen Speed and Skill Damage.
- Normal Attack will change to Offing.
- Chain Skill will change to Water Tornado.
- Special Ability will change to Flowing Water.
text.发射最多可以弹射至3个目标的水珠，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Shoots a ball of water that spreads to up to three targets to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.凝聚神力，对目标敌人造成400%远程范围伤害，提升40%自己近程伤害并持续8秒。: Condenses mana to inflict 400% of ranged damage and increase her melee Atk by 40% for 8 second(s).
text.凝聚神力，对目标敌人造成420%远程范围伤害，提升40%自己近程伤害并持续8秒。: Condenses mana to inflict 420% of ranged damage and increase her melee Atk by 40% for 8 second(s).
text.使用时按照每秒伤害的475%造成近程伤害，我方全部人员的攻击提升20%，持续24: When used, inflicts 475% of DPS as melee damage, and increases all allies’ Atk by 20% for 240 seconds.
text.黑暗扣杀命中目标时，降低30%暗属性抵抗并持续3秒，按照伤害值的10%，加成额外: On Dark Smash's hit, decreases dark type resistance by 30% for 3 second(s), and generates a shield by 10% of the inflicted damage upon enemies.
text.跃起后，向下劈砍双手剑，对目标敌人造成近程范围伤害并附带击倒效果。: Leaps in the air and slams the two-handed sword on the ground to inflict melee AoE damage around the area. Puts enemies in a(n) Downed state.
text.黑暗扣杀和黑暗球命中目标时，降低30%暗属性抵抗并持续5秒，按照伤害值的10%，:
On Dark Burst's hit, decreases dark type resistance by 30% for 5 second(s), and generates a shield by 10% of damage dealt.
On Dark Orb's hit, reduces the target’s Atk by 10% for 5 seconds.
text.向敌人投掷装有炸弹的礼物盒，按照每秒伤害的420%造成伤害。: Throws a gift box filled with bombs to inflict 420% of DPS.
text.暂时释放阿红族力量，按照每秒伤害的400%造成近程伤害，我方人员土属性攻击提升3: Temporarily unleashes the power of Red Weredeers to inflict 400% of DPS damage as melee damage, and increases Earth type Atk of allies by 30% for 5 second(s).
text.发动突进技能，承受伤害减免30%并持续4秒。: When Charge is used, reduces the damage taken by 30% for 4 second(s).
text.攻击命中目标时，英雄的暴击伤害倍数提升30%，除英雄以外的我方人员攻击提升10%: On hit, increase her own Crit Hit Multiplier by 30%, and increase Atk of allies by 10% excluding herself for 4 second(s). This effect overlaps up to 2 times.
text.抵近射击命中3格以内目标敌人时，按照每秒伤害的10%造成额外伤害。: When Point Blank Shot hits a target within 3 tiles, increases damage by 10%.
text.请求火力支援，对目标敌人造成范围伤害，并附带击倒效果。: Calls for Air Support to inflict damage to a wider range. Puts enemies in Downed state.
text.佩戴武器时，英雄的职业技能随着武器而变。\n- 暴击率调整为2倍，暴击伤害倍数减:
On equipping, the Hero’s abilities will change to fit the weapon.
- Crit Hit Chance will be doubled, but the Crit Hit Multiplier will reduce by -20%.
- Normal Atk will change to Weredeer Striking Technique.
- Chain Skill will change to Final Warrior.
- Special Ability will change to Sharp Horns.
text.驾驶雪橇突进，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Charges a sled towards the enemy to inflict melee damage. Puts enemies in a(n) Injured state.
text.按照每秒伤害的230%，对敌人造成伤害，防御减免20%并持续5秒。: Inflicts 230% of DPS, and decreases enemies' Def by 20% for 5 second(s).
text.发动怒吼技能，普通攻击速度提升60%，并连续进行跃进攻击；该效果持续10秒。: When Outcry of Rage is used, the speed of Normal Atk is increased by 60% and she leaps continuously for 10 seconds.
text.神圣雷电攻击目标敌人，按照每秒伤害的300%造成伤害。\n按照恢复能力的30%恢:
Strikes holy lightning to inflict 300% of DPS.
Restores all allies' HP by 30% of Heal, and removes all negative Effects.
text.天籁之声命中目标时，按照恢复能力的50%恢复生命最少队员生命，攻击提升30%并持: On Sound of Heaven's hit, restores HP of the Party member with lowest HP by 50% of Heal and increases Atk by 30% for 5 second(s). Activates once every 5 second(s).
text.神圣雷电攻击目标敌人，按照每秒伤害的340%造成远程伤害。\n按照恢复能力的40:
Strikes holy lightning to inflict 340% of DPS as ranged damage.
Restores all allies' HP by 40% of Heal, and removes all negative Effects.
text.天籁之声命中目标时，按照恢复能力的50%恢复生命最少队员生命，我方全部人员攻击提: On Sound of Heaven's hit, restores HP of the Party member with lowest HP by 50% of Heal and increases all allies' Atk by 20% for 5 seconds. Activates once every 5 seconds.
text.天籁之声命中目标时，每2秒按照每秒伤害的30%造成伤害，光属性抵抗减免效果立即生: On Sound of Heaven's hit, inflicts 30% of DPS every 2 second(s) and immediately reduces light type resistance. Restores allies' HP in the Sanctuary by 100% of Heal.
text.形成神圣领域，对敌人造成伤害，并附带击倒效果。: Summons holy sanctuary. Puts enemies in Downed state.
text.天籁之声命中目标时，每2秒按照每秒伤害的45%造成伤害，光属性抵抗减免效果立即生: On Sound of Heaven's hit, inflicts 45% of DPS every 2 second(s) and immediately reduces light type resistance. Restores allies' HP in the Sanctuary by 100% of Heal.
text.掷出刀器，按照每秒伤害的320%，对目标敌人造成近程伤害。: Throws a dagger to inflict 320% of DPS as melee damage.
text.充满气力或正在恢复气力时，所受敌人伤害减免35%。: Damage taken is reduced by 35% when energy is full or while restoring energy.
text.喷火功的威力提升至每秒伤害的150%。\n命中目标时，燃烧敌人，并按照每秒伤害的:
Flame Martial Art's damage increases to 150% of DPS.
On hit, sets enemy on fire and inflicts 140% of DPS of injury damage. Activates once every 4 second(s).
text.舞刀攻击周围敌人，对其造成近程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Performs a sword dance to inflict melee damage to nearby enemies, and put them in a(n) Downed state.
text.形成神奇激光气场，按照每秒伤害的400%，对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害。: Forms a Magiton field to inflict 400% of DPS as ranged damage around the target.
text.利用突击步枪进行普通攻击时，以50%概率，子弹伤害提升50%，并穿透敌人。强化弹: Rifle Normal Atk penetrates the enemy and inflicts 50% increased damage by 50% chance. On hit, reduces basic type resistance by 30% for 3 second(s).
text.命中目标时，有30%概率爆发神奇激光能量，按照每秒伤害的50%造成远程伤害，使目: On hit, Magiton energy explodes by 30% chance to inflict 50% of DPS as ranged damage and reduce the target's weapon skill regen speed by 30% for 2 second(s). 1 second(s) cooltime.
text.以极限威力发射神奇激光能量，对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害并附带击倒效果。: Shoots out magiton energy at full capacity to inflict ranged damage around the target and puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.佩戴武器时，英雄的职业技能随着武器而变。\n- 队伍能力切换为防御提升；\n-:
On equipping, the Hero’s abilities will change to fit the weapon. 
- Party Effects will change to increase Def.
- Normal Attack Master of Weapons’ effect will change.
- Chain Skill will change to Disassemble.
- Special Ability will change to Critical Scar.
text.向前方斩出划破地面的电波伤害，并附带击飞效果。: Fires an earth splitting sword wave to inflict damage. Puts enemies in an Airborne state.
text.借用神圣光芒，按照每秒伤害的180%，对目标敌人造成伤害，我方全部人员暴击率与攻: Inflicts 180% of DPS on target with the holy light and increases the entire allies' Crit Hit Chance and Atk by 30% for 5 second(s).
text.按照武器技能恢复速度增加量的50%，提升对敌人造成的伤害，并减免自身承受伤害。: Increases damage and decreases damage taken, by 50% of increased weapon skill regen speed.
text.勇士祝福将按照每秒伤害的150%，对敌人造成伤害，并恢复15%周围我方人员生命。: The Blessing of the Chosen one inflicts 150% of DPS damage on enemies and restores nearby allies' HP by 15%.
text.借用神圣威力，对目标周围敌人造成伤害，并刻上天雷烙印。经过一定时间之后，天雷烙印: Damages and imprints a lightning shape on enemies around the target with holy power. The lightning explodes after some time to inflict damage and put them in Airborne state.
text.众多灵魂攻击敌人，按照每秒伤害的250%，造成远程伤害。召唤黑暗灵魂之后，按照每: Inflicts 250% of DPS ranged damage to the enemy with a myriad of spirits. When Dark Spirit is summoned inflicts 250% of DPS extra melee damage.
text.黑暗灵魂攻击提升40%，按照黑暗灵魂伤害值的40%，恢复诺克希娅生命。: Increases Dark Spirit Atk by 40%, and restores Noxia's HP by 40% of damage inflicted by Dark Spirit.
text.诺克希娅攻击命中目标时，以40%概率，按照每秒伤害的40%，造成远程伤害。黑暗灵: On hit, inflicts 40% of DPS ranged damage with 40%, and Dark Spirit taunt inflicts 100% of DPS melee damage.
text.将目标敌人拖入地府，造成近程伤害，并附带击倒效果。: Pulls the target underground and inflicts melee damage, and put in Downed state.
text.发射灵光，按照每秒伤害的450%，对路径上的敌人造成远程伤害。: Shoots a ray that inflicts 450% of DPS as ranged damage to enemies in its way.
text.暴击伤害命中目标时，移动速度提升5%，并使目标敌人的土属性抵抗降低5%；该效果持: On crit hit, increases moving speed by 5% and reduce earth type resistance by 5% for 5 second(s). This effect can overlap up to 4 time(s).
text.释放武器中凝聚的能量，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Bursts out the concentrated energy in front to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.用光剑穿透敌人，按照每秒伤害的525%造成近程伤害。: Cuts through the enemy with a light blade to inflict melee damage that's 525% of DPS.
text.光束麦林的爆破范围与伤害提升25%。\n光束加农能量炮的尺寸与伤害提升25%。:
The explosion range and the damage of Beam Magnum increase by 25%.
The size and the damage of Beam Cannon’s energy bomb increase by 25%.
text.发射能引起爆破的能源弹，造成远程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Fires an exploding energy bomb to inflict ranged damage. Puts enemies in a(n) Downed state.
text.魔界之手握紧敌人，按照每秒伤害的390%造成近程伤害。命中身上刻有魔王图案的敌人: The Hand of Demon World grasps the enemy to inflict 390% of DPS as melee damage. If an enemy marked with the Demon Queen's emblem is hit, restores all allies’ HP by 20%.
text.使用黑暗利刺，攻击提升20%并持续6秒；黑暗利刺的威力提升至每秒伤害的133.3: When using Darkness Spike, Atk increases by 20% for 6 second(s), and Darkness Spike’s damage increases to 133.3333% of DPS.
text.启动承受伤害减免20%的保护效果。\n黑暗利刺恢复时间减免至5秒，防御减免效果提:
Activates a protection effect, which reduces damage taken by 20%.
Reduces skill regen time of Darkness Spike to 5 second(s), and Def reduction of enemies increases to 20%.
text.伸出蕴含魔王之力的手，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Stretches a hand imbued with Demon Queen's power and scratches enemies to inflict melee damage. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.变出旋风纸牌魔术并按照每秒伤害的300%造成远程伤害，我方人员暴击伤害倍数提升1: Inflicts 300% of DPS as ranged damage with a hurricane card trick. Increases allies’ Crit Hit Multiplier by 100% for 6 second(s).
text.命中目标时，移动速度提升25%，暴击伤害倍数提升50%；该效果持续3秒。: On hit, moving speed increases by 25% and Crit Hit Multiplier increases by 50% for 3 second(s).
text.变出旋风纸牌魔术并按照每秒伤害的320%造成远程伤害，我方人员暴击伤害倍数提升1: Inflicts 320% of DPS as ranged damage with a hurricane card trick. Increases allies’ Crit Hit Multiplier by 100% for 8 second(s).
text.使用时按照每秒伤害的475%造成远程伤害，我方全部人员的攻击提升20%，持续24: Upon use, deals 475% of DPS as ranged damage and increases all allies' Atk by 20% for 240 seconds.
text.命中目标时，以40%概率引发纸牌爆炸，按照每秒伤害的30%造成额外远程伤害。\n:
On hit, a card explodes and inflicts additional 30% of DPS as ranged damage with 40% chance.
When using Royal Straight Flush, increases Def by 30% for 3 second(s).
text.依次飞出5张魔术纸牌，造成远程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Throws 5 magic cards sequentially to inflict ranged damage. Puts enemies in a(n) Airborne state.
text.命中目标时，以50%概率引发纸牌爆炸，按照每秒伤害的40%造成额外远程伤害。\n:
On hit, a card explodes and inflicts additional 40% of DPS as ranged damage with 50% chance.
When using Royal Straight Flush, increases Def by 30% for 5 second(s).
text.制造波浪并按照每秒伤害的400%，对路径上的敌人造成远程伤害；且按照被命中敌人数: Creates a wave to inflict 400% of DPS ranged damage to the enemy, and restores all allies’ HP by 10% to 30% maximum depending on the number of enemies hit.
text.按照失去生命的一定比例，承受伤害最多减免50%。生命为20%，伤害减免值达到最大: Damage taken is reduced by 50% maximum in proportion to lost HP. When HP is at 20% the maximum damage reduction applies.
text.乘风破浪命中目标时，每3秒发射神奇激光能量，按照每秒伤害的100%造成额外伤害。:
On Ripping Rush’s hit, fire Magiton energy once every 3 seconds and deal additional 100% of DPS damage. 
Attacks maximum of 4 enemies, and damage dealt will be decreased by 10% each time when dealing damage.
text.召唤海豚，对目标敌人造成范围伤害，并附带重伤效果。: Summons a dolphin to inflict damage around the target, and puts enemies in an Injured state.
text.电击敌人心脏，按照每秒伤害的375%造成近程伤害。: Applies shock to the enemy’s heart to deal 375% of DPS as melee damage.
text.使用漩涡时防御提升30%并持续3秒。\n漩涡持续时间越长，移动速度与攻击速度越快:
While using Aqua Whirl, increase Def by 30% for 3 seconds. 
Maintaining Aqua Whirl increases movement speed and Atk speed upto a maximum of 30%. This effect only applies while using Aqua Whirl.
text.漩涡的有效范围提升30%。\n位于安全地带的我方人员恢复10%生命，同时该地带我:
Increases the range of Aqua Whirl by 30%.
Increase Atk of all allies within the safe zone by 30% for 5 seconds and heal their HP by 10%.
text.向目标敌人跃进，在其周围形成安全地带，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Jumps towards the target to inflict melee damage to enemies and creates a safe zone. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.天籁般的演奏使我方全部人员攻击提升30%，并使敌人光属性抵抗减免30%；该效果持: With a heavenly performance, increase all allies' Atk by 30% and reduce light type resistance of enemies by 30% for 5 seconds.
text.当与光属性英雄处于同一队伍时，承受伤害减免30%。\n队伍中每有1位光属性队员，:
If a Light type hero excluding herself is in the party, damage taken is reduced by 30%.
For each Light type party member, increase Atk of all party members by 7.5% up to a maximum of 30%.
text.琶音伤害提升20%，被琶音击中的敌人身上刻有音符并持续3秒。若下一次琶音没有击中: Increases damage of Arpeggio by 20%. On hit, marks enemies with a musical note for 3 seconds. Marked enemies will be damaged by the musical note’s explosion if not hit by the next Arpeggio.
text.发出声波，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Uses sound waves to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.使出集中烈火力量的踢腿，并按照每秒伤害的290%造成近程伤害，我方全部人员暴击率: Inflicts 290% of DPS as melee damage with a concentrated flame kick, and increases allies’ Critical Hit chance by 10% for 10 seconds.
text.烈焰闪电命中目标时，防御提升25%并持续5秒。\n使用“燃”技能，防御提升25%:

On Claw Sharpening's hit, her Crit Hit Multiplier increases by 50% for 3 second(s). 
When using Sheathe, her Def increases by 30% for 5 second(s).
text.向敌人突进并挥出斩击，按照每秒伤害的400%造成近程伤害。: Attacks with her sword to inflict 400% of DPS as melee damage to enemies.
text.命中目标时，按照每秒伤害的60%造成额外近程伤害，使敌人虚属性抵抗减免30%并持: On hit, deals an additional 60% of DPS as melee damage and reduces basic type resistance by 30% for 3 second(s). Activates once every 2 second(s).
text.挥出足以撕裂空间的剑气，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Fires waves of sword aura that can even cut through dimensions to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.使用充满圣洁力量的盾牌砸向敌人，按照每秒伤害的360%对其造成近程伤害。: Smashes her shield full of holy power down onto the enemy to inflict 360% of DPS as melee damage.
text.在天界回音状态下，天界剑刃命中目标时，为被命中的目标刻上天界纹章，使其防御减免5: On Heavenly Blade's hit in the state of Heavenly Echo, enemies are marked with Heaven's emblem, reducing their Def by 5% for 6 seconds. This effect can overlap up to 4 times.
text.降下神圣光芒，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Uses holy light to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.倾泻能量，按照每秒伤害的320%对目标敌人造成近程伤害。: Draws power to inflict 320% of DPS as melee damage to the target.
text.命中目标时，使敌人感染细菌，生命恢复效果减免70%并持续5秒。\n受到被细菌感染:
On hit, infects enemies with bacteria and reduces their ability to restore HP by 70% for 5 second(s).
When hit by enemies infected by the bacteria, damage taken decreases by 25%.
When using Operation, Def increases by 25% for 3 second(s).
text.“手术”的伤害值提升20%，剑气的速度与射程提升20%。\n“手术”命中目标时，:
Operation’s damage increases by 20%, and the attack range and speed of the sword waves increase by 20%.
On Operation’s hit, inflicts 10% of DPS as additional melee damage to the enemies’ shield, and decreases the enemy’s Def by 20% for 2 seconds.
text.制造追踪敌人的细菌风暴，对目标敌人造成近程范围伤害并附带击倒效果。: Creates bacteria that follows enemies and inflicts melee damage around them. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.召唤数把巨型镰刀，按照每秒伤害的300%，对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害。: Summons massive scythes to inflict 300% of DPS as ranged damage to nearby enemies.
text.驱灵的最后一次攻击命中目标时，改为恢复我方全部人员的生命，而不是生命最少队员。\:
On hit of Exorcism’s last attack, the HP of all allies is restored instead of the party member with the lowest HP.
Restores the HP of allies within Guidance to the After World by 50% of Heal.
text.开启冥界之门，对周围敌人造成远程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Opens the gate to the After World to inflict ranged damage to nearby enemies. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.利用空气中的水分形成透镜，聚集并反射阳光，按照每秒伤害的350%，对敌人造成近程: Refracts sunlight to a single point and reflects it to inflict 350% of DPS as melee damage.
text.生命为0时，立刻恢复5%生命，并在3秒内额外恢复45%生命。超速再生每30秒启动: When HP hits 0, recovers 5% HP instantly and an additional 45% in the span of 3 second(s). Ultraspeed Regeneration activates once every 30 second(s).
text.命中目标时，有50%概率按照每秒伤害的40%造成额外近程伤害，使敌人水属性抵抗减:
On hit, inflicts an additional 40% of DPS as melee damage with a 50% chance, and reduces water type resistance by 30% for 3 second(s).
When using Gluttony, increase allies’ Atk by 30% for 5 second(s).
text.吸取敌人的力量，对其造成近程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Drains enemies’ power to inflict melee damage. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.受到朱菜攻击耐性效果的影响，战斗中，英雄的承受伤害减免30%。\n魔力花瓣在最高:
Shuna’s tolerance to attacks decreases the damage taken during battle by 30%.
When Magic Petal is fully charged, on hit, her Atk increases by 20%, and she silences the target to prevent them from using Weapon Skill for 2 second(s). Activates once every 5 second(s).
text.魔力花瓣命中目标时，我方全部人员防御提升30%并持续5秒；该技能每5秒启动1次。:
On Magic Petal’s hit, increases all allies' Def by 30% for 5 second(s). Activates once every 5 second(s).
Enemies hit by Magic Petal are marked for 3 second(s). Enemies marked by Magic Petal will be damaged by the Magic Petal’s explosion if not hit by the next Magic Petal.
text.展开对魔属性结界，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Creates an Alignment Field to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.凝聚并释放出巨大能量，按照每秒伤害的575%，对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害。: Charges and releases massive energy to inflict 575% of DPS as ranged damage around the target.
text.开始战斗时，米莉姆的暴击抵抗提升20%。\n使用“米莉姆踢击！”时，英雄的防御提:
At the start of the battle, Milim's Crit Hit Resistance increases by 20%.
When using Milim Kick!, her Def increases by 20% for 4 second(s), and on hit, the enemy's Weapon Skill regen speed decreases by 30% for 2 second(s).
text.对生命高于30%的敌人造成的伤害值提升20%。\n使用“我生气了！！”过程中，英:
To enemies with 30% or more HP, damage dealt increases by 20%.
When using Now I'm Mad!!, damage taken decreases by 60%.
text.释放能量，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Releases energy to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.发射以元素精灵之力制作而成的箭，按照每秒伤害的385%造成远程伤害。: Shoots arrows created with elemental power to inflict 385% of DPS as ranged damage.
text.森林之箭的第一次攻击得到强化，命中目标时，英雄自身的攻击提升30%并持续5秒；\:
Buffs Sylvan Arrow's first attack, and upon hit, increases her Atk by 30% for 5 second(s).
Applies the effect of Sharp Senses to all allies.
text.发射森林净化能量，造成远程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Fires forest purification energy to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.发射灼热子弹，按照每秒伤害的320%，对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害。: Shoots powerful searing bullets around the target to inflict 320% of DPS as ranged damage.
text.队伍中每有1位火属性队员，火属性队员的连锁技能攻击与恢复能力提升15%，最多提升: For each Fire type party member there is, the Atk of Chain Skill and Heal of Fire type party members is increased by 15% up to a maximum of 45% and the Crit Hit chance of Chain Skill is increased by 10% up to a maximum of 30%. The Crit Hit chance of Chain Skill does not affect the stats increased by Crit Hit chance.
text.炎火射击命中目标时，使敌人火属性抵抗减免20%并持续3秒，黑山羊纹章持续时间增加:
On Flame Shot’s hit, fire type resistance is reduced by 20% for 3 seconds and the black goat emblem’s lasting time is increased by 6 seconds.
Upon maximum overlap of the black goat emblem, Atk is increased by 20% for 8 seconds. This activates once every 6 seconds.
text.迅速来回冲锋发射剑气，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Quickly charges back and forth firing waves of sword aura to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.释放龙形水柱，按照每秒伤害的285%对目标敌人造成远程伤害；同时我方全部人员的水: Erupts a geyser at the target to inflict 285% of DPS as ranged damage. This increases the water type Atk of all allies by 20% for 10 second(s).
text.每有一位战斗中的队员，英雄自身输出伤害提升10%，最多提升30%；每有一位队员死: The damage dealt increases by 10% for each party member in battle, up to a maximum of 30%, and the damage received decreases by 10% for each dead party member, up to a maximum of 30%.
text.当激流命中目标8次时，引起爆破，按照每秒伤害的40%造成额外远程伤害。\n命中目:
Upon 8 hits of Riptide, triggers an explosion to inflict 40% of DPS as additional ranged damage.
On Riptide's hit, it increases the Crit Hit Multiplier of Water type party members by 10% for 5 second(s). This effect overlaps up to 5 times. Upon maximum overlap, the ranged damage additionally increases by 25% for 4 second(s).
text.制造波涛，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Throws a tidal wave to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.投掷巨型水果，按照每秒伤害的280%对目标敌人造成远程伤害。: Throws a giant fruit at the target to inflict 280% of DPS as ranged damage.
text.“请求帮助！”启动后，命中附有黄色蝴蝶的敌人时，英雄攻击提升30%并持续5秒；黄: After Requesting Help! is activated, if the enemy is hit while the yellow butterfly is tagging them, Atk increases by 30% for 5 seconds. When it returns to Cornet, Def increases by 30% for 5 seconds.
text.“尝尝水果吧！”命中目标时，有60%概率按照每秒伤害的25%造成额外远程伤害，并:
On Take the Fruit! hit, deals 25% of DPS as additional ranged damage with a 60% chance. The Def decrease effect also applies immediately.
The green butterfly's protection effect reduces the amount of damage she takes during battle by 25%.
text.放飞蝴蝶幻影，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Fires butterfly phantoms to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.引爆创建的星座，按照每秒伤害的280%造成远程伤害，同时，英雄自身的远程伤害值提: Creates a constellation and then detonates it to inflict 280% of DPS as ranged damage and increases her own ranged damage by 40% for 8 second(s).
text.获得星星碎片时，英雄自身的攻击与防御提升10%并持续5秒；该效果最多叠加3次。\:
Upon obtaining a star fragment, increases her own Atk and Def by 10% for 5 second(s). This effect can overlap up to 3 times.
When hit by enemies, Star Bit is generated to track them. Activates every 4 seconds. On Star Bit hit, deals 80% of DPS as additional ranged damage and obtains 3 star fragments.
text.星光之路的伤害值提升20%；使用超新星时，承受伤害减免30%并持续4秒。\n按照:
Star Road’s damage increases by 20%, and reduces the damage taken by 30% for 4 second(s) when using Supernova. 
When Supernova is enhanced, its damage increases by 3%, 5%, and 7% respectively for each star fragment.
Upon Star Rain hit, obtains 2 star fragments.
text.流星划落天空，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Drops meteors from the sky to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.发射强劲的炮弹，按照每秒伤害的360%，对目标敌人造成远程伤害，我方全部人员攻击: Fires a powerful cannonball to inflict 360% of DPS as ranged damage and increase all allies' Atk by 20% for 10 seconds.
text.队伍中每有1位土属性队员，全体土属性队员的暴击率提升5%，最多提升20%。\n使:
For each Earth type party member, increases the Crit Hit chance of Earth type party members by 5% up to a maximum of 20%.
Allows the firing of an additional cannonball after using Skyward Cannon. If the additional cannonball is a hit, deals 130% of DPS as ranged damage to the target and deals 20% of DPS as ranged damage to nearby enemies.
text.发射强劲的炮弹，按照每秒伤害的420%，对目标敌人造成远程伤害，我方全部人员攻击: Fires a powerful cannonball to inflict 420% of DPS as ranged damage and increase all allies' Atk by 20% for 10 seconds.
text.使用时按照每秒伤害的450%造成远程伤害，我方全部人员的攻击提升23%，持续24: Upon use, deals 450% of DPS as ranged damage and increases all allies' Atk by 23% for 240 seconds.
text.“开炮！”命中目标时，敌人土属性抵抗减免20%并持续5秒。\n炮火支援额外炮弹命:
If Fire! is a hit, Earth type resistance is decreased by 20% for 5 seconds.
If the additional cannonball of Fire Support is a hit, for 5 seconds, the damage of Fire! increases by 20% while damage taken decreases by 20%.
text.向空中发射一连串炮弹，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Fires a barrage of shells into the sky to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.用赛艇撞击敌人，按照每秒伤害的420%造成近程伤害。: Slams target with a boat to inflict 420% of DPS damage as melee damage.
text.如果反击失败，下1次普通攻击的伤害值提升50%并持续5秒。\n受到攻击时，英雄自:
If the counter fails, the next Normal Atk's damage increases by 50% for 5 second(s) 1 time.
When hit by enemies, Def increases by 5% for 30 second(s) every 1 second. This effect overlaps up to 6 times.
text.回击的威力提升至每秒伤害的170%，并适用异常状态数值。\n使用夺旗竞速时，攻击:
Increases Payback’s damage by 170% of DPS, and Ailment will be applied.
When using Flag Race, Atk increases by 30% for 5 second(s).
text.向旗帜突进，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Charges toward a flag to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.一鼓作气斩杀敌人，按照每秒伤害的500%造成近程伤害。: Sharply cuts target in one swift move to inflict an additional 500% of DPS as melee damage.
text.驱魔斩命中目标时，使目标敌人的攻击减免10%并持续2秒。\n当领域内敌人少于2名:
On Exorcist Slash’s hit, decreases the target’s Atk by 10% for 2 seconds.
If there are less than 2 enemies in the field, Exorcist Unsheathing’s damage increases by 30% and damage taken decreases by 15%.
If there are more than 2 enemies in the field, Exorcist Unsheathing’s damage increases by 15% and damage taken decreases by 30%.
text.驱魔拔刀必定造成暴击伤害；驱魔拔刀命中目标5次，攻击提升25%，连锁技能暴击率提:
Exorcist Unsheathing’s attack always results in a Crit Hit. If Exorcist Unsheathing’s attack hits 5 times, Atk increases by 25% for 7 seconds and the Crit Hit chance of Chain Skill is increased by 25%.
On Cherry Blossom Frenzy’s hit, Flower Shadow’s recharge time is reduced by 0.5 seconds.
Increases the cherry blossom emblem’s lasting time to 6 seconds and Def decrease effect is increased to 20%.
text.快速斩出剑气，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带击飞效果。: Swiftly fires sword slashes to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Airborne state.
text.飞跃至空中撑开枪伞，向目标敌人投掷威力强大的炸弹，按照每秒伤害的420%对其造成: Rides an umbrella into the air and throws a powerful bomb to inflict 420% of DPS as ranged damage.
text.若队伍人数多于或等于4名，对敌人造成的伤害提升40%，自身承受的伤害减免20%。:
If there are 4 party members or more, damage dealt to enemies increases by 40% and damage taken decreases by 20%.
If there are less than 4 party members, damage deals to enemies increases by 20% and damage taken decreases by 40%.
text.阿德拉式武术最后一次攻击增强。\n命中目标时，在敌人身上附着炸弹，炸弹在3秒后爆:
Enhances Adelan Martial Arts’ final attack.
On hit, sticks a bomb to the enemy that explodes after 3 seconds and inflicts 100% of DPS. Activates once every 5 seconds.
Inflicts 150% of DPS to enemies with HP lower than 50%.
text.使用枪伞对敌人扫射，造成远程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Fires a barrage of bullets from an umbrella to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.掉落无数礼物，按照每秒伤害的300%对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害，使我方全部人员光: Showers donations to deal 300% of DPS as ranged damage to enemies around the target, and increases all allies' Light type Atk by 20% for 10 seconds.
text.快照命中目标时，为被命中的敌人刻上拍摄对象纹章，使其受到的光属性伤害提升40%并: On Snapshot's hit, engraves target with a camera focus emblem, and increases Light type damage by 40% for 6 seconds.
text.“直播中”命中身上刻有拍摄对象纹章的敌人时，按照每秒伤害的20%造成额外远程伤害:
Upon On Air's hit on an enemy marked with a camera focus emblem, deals 20% of DPS as additional ranged damage. 
Upon Snapshot's hit, increases Def by 20% for 6 seconds.
text.无差别地使用闪光灯，对目标敌人造成远程范围伤害并附带重伤效果。: Unleashes indiscriminate flashes to inflict ranged damage. Puts enemies in a(n) Injured state.
text.召唤圣鸟，按照每秒伤害的230%对敌人造成远程伤害。: Summons a sacred bird to inflict 230% of DPS damage as ranged damage to enemies.
text.按照技能伤害值的10%提升魂灵玉的伤害值，最多提升100%。\n队伍中每有1位虚:
Soul Sphere's damage increases by 10% of Skill Damage up to a maximum of 100%.
For each Basic type party member, increases the Crit Hit Multiplier of Basic type party members by 5% up to a maximum of 20%.
text.魂灵玉每次攻击造成3次伤害。\n在灵魂爆发状态下，魂灵玉命中目标时，为被命中的敌:
Soul Sphere changes into a 3 hit structure.
On Soul Sphere’s hit while in Soul Blast state, marks enemies with a four leaf clover emblem and decreases their Def by 20% for 6 seconds.
text.释放力量，对敌人造成远程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Unleashes power to inflict ranged damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.与水分身一起攻击，使用体术和水遁之术按照每秒伤害的420%对敌人造成近程伤害。: Uses martial arts and water techniques with water clones of herself to inflict 420% of DPS as melee damage.
text.体术命中目标时，英雄自身攻击提升10%并持续5秒。该效果最多叠加2次。此外，当叠:
When a martial arts skill is a hit, her Atk increases by 10% for 5 seconds. This can overlap up to 2 times. Upon maximum overlap, her Crit Hit Multiplier increases by 40% for 5 seconds.
When her kunai throw or water technique is a hit, the target's Atk decreases by 10% for 2 seconds.
text.水刃手里剑变为由水分身攻击，使用后使我方水属性队员的攻击提升20%，持续7秒。\:
When Hydro Blade Shuriken is used, it increases the Atk of water-type allies by 20% for 7 seconds and the water clones use it in their place.
For each water-type party member excluding herself, the Melee Defense Reduction Effect increases by 5%, up to a maximum of 20%.
text.投掷巨型手里剑，对敌人造成近程伤害并附带重伤效果。: Throws a giant shuriken to inflict melee damage to enemies. Puts them in a(n) Injured state.
text.从地面升起翡翠玉柱，按照每秒伤害的300%对目标敌人造成近程范围伤害，并重新召唤: Jade spikes shoot up to deal 300% of DPS as melee damage to enemies near the target and resummons the Beast Warrior.
text.野兽战士已被召唤时，塔莎的承受伤害减免10%。\n野兽战士的攻击命中目标时，塔莎:
While the Beast Warrior is summoned, the damage Tasha takes is decreased by 10%.
When the Beast Warrior's attack is a hit, Tasha's Atk increases by 25% for 5 seconds.
text.翡翠面具纹章持续时间提升至5秒，防御减免效果提升至20%。\n塔莎或野兽战士的攻:
The duration of the Jade Mask emblem increases to 5 seconds, and its Def Decrease Effect increases to 20%.
Targets with the Jade Mask emblem take an additional 150% of DPS as melee damage when hit by Tasha or Beast Warrior. This activates once every 4 seconds.
text.挥舞玉矛，对周围敌人造成近程伤害并附带击倒效果。: Swings her spear with full force to inflict melee damage to nearby enemies. Puts them in a(n) Downed state.
text.落下毁灭性的闪电，按照每秒伤害的430%对敌人造成远程伤害，我方全部人员光属性攻: Strikes down bolts of destruction to inflict 430% of DPS as ranged damage, and increases all allies' Light type Atk by 30% for 5 seconds.
text.受到攻击时，有25%概率使承受伤害减免40%。\n魔力解放状态结束时，为我方全部:
When hit by enemies, there is a 25% chance to decrease damage taken by 40%.
When her mana is no longer unleashed, creates a 15% shield for all allies that stays up for 4 second(s).
text.战斗中，芙莉莲造成的伤害值提升25%。\n在魔力解放状态下，普通攻击魔法命中目标:
During battle, Frieren's damage increases by 25%.
On Ordinary Offensive Magic (Zoltraak)’s hit while mana is unleashed, the enemy’s ranged Def is reduced by 20% for 5 seconds.

stories.knight_captain:
Eva is the 19th captain of the guardians.

Born weak but talented in magic, everyone expected Eva will become a wizard. However, she chose to become a guardian against the odds. With exceptional leadership and chivalry, she quickly rose to captain. She completely transformed the guardians into the strictly merit based hierarchy where anyone, whether he/she is a noble or a peasant, can rise to higher ranks. The reform evolved the guardians into the most competitive and powerful knights in the world. She is dedicated to keep the guardians strong, to protect Kanterbury from any threat.

Such loyalty to the kingdom has earned her immense trust from queen Camilla and the royal family. She is not only a trusted servant but also a good friend to them.
stories.redhood:
Elvira is a rising star in the notorious crime syndicate, Reservoir Snakes.

Reservoir Snakes was founded by Elvira's grandma, who survived a traumatic wolf attack with her granddaughter. Traumatized by the incident, the grandma recruited private contractors armed with illegal weapons to protect her family. In such process, the grandma discovered her talent as a mafia boss and quickly evolved the small army into the biggest crime syndicate in Kanterbury. Elvira, longing for grandma's affection, became the member of the syndicate and hunts down anyone that came in its way. 

The syndicate is ruthless to failures. Any member who fails is disavowed and no one knows what happens to them. Naturally, Elvira's always bit on the edge. Her basket is no longer filled with delicious foods for her grandma. Instead, deadly explosives and firearms fill the void.
stories.pet:
Guardian wolves are powerful mystical creatures that live in snowy lands.

When invaders made their debut to the world, they hunted down guardian wolves. The young wolf got stranded from its pack and was forced to survive alone. During its journey, it was befriended by two men. One was a poacher who wanted his skin, and another was a gambler who was knee deep in dog fighting. After escaping these two "friends", it became extremely skeptical of humans.

But if you land him a sincere and patient hand, he might still be your most loyal friend.
stories.vampire_noble:
Karina is a mischievous young vampire.

Vampires no longer hunt human blood in modern society. Any vampire with grace and manners will buy blood from blood banks at fair price. However, born in a precious vampire household, Karina wanted to have little fun with her food.

She disguised herself as an innocent lost girl in forest and took little bits of blood from unsuspecting adventurers. She did it because it is "very sweet and lots of fun". If you are to accompany her, you better prepare some iron supplements.
stories.maiden:
Loraine is the owner of the Katerbury inn which is well known among adventurers for its high quality services. She will always greet you with a smile full of kindness but with a hint of darkness.

No one knows much about her. Her past, age, where she is from, what race she is - nothing. Even when you witness her die right in front of you, she'll be ready to greet you back at the inn.

There is one rule when you stay at her inn. Never look up while you are eating.
stories.demon_sister:
Lavi is a demon attending the magic school as an exchange student. The queen of devildom sent Lavi and her twin brother Favi as a part of a talent exchange program between the human world and devildom, hoping they would learn the delicate ways of human wizardry.

While she is exceptionally talented at defense spells, she technically doesn't understand to cast them. She just intuitively uses them for brawls she often gets into. She hopes to become the ultimate fighting champion of the world much to the dismay of the devil queen (who is, by the way, funding her tuition).

She loves her brother but gives him a hard time because... well, because it's her brother. But she won't think twice to risk herself to help him in any situation.
stories.demon_brother:
Favi is a demon attending the magic school as an exchange student. The queen of devildom sent Favi and his twin sister Lavi as a part of a talent exchange program between the human world and devildom, hoping they would learn the delicate ways of human wizardry.

Ever since he can remember, Favi had to look after his sister who constantly got into brawls. Naturally, he became expert at healing spells.

He lost the ability to speak after a certain incident in his childhood. He can still telepathically communicate with his sister, but has hard time interacting with anyone else. Unlike his sister, Favi is timid and easily scared.
stories.leaf_fairy:
Aoba is a leaf fairy that protects flowers of Kanterbury forest.

Half an hour of her touch does more wonder to flowers than hours of work from any other fairy. She would be the greatest leaf fairy of her generation - if she was not a natural born slacker. Instead of taking care of flowers all day, she invented magical sprinklers and automated her entire job. She now spends time taking naps and reading comic books from the human world.

By her own account, she is not lazy per se. She's just efficient.
stories.mad_scientist:
Gremory is a research scientist from the devildom. Her life is solely dedicated to researching magic.

Her mind largely deviates from that of an ordinary person. She often gets trapped in her own thoughts in any time and place. She would start talking to oneself in middle of conversations or burst into endless ravings about her crazy research ideas.

To Gremory's eyes, everyone is an experimental subject. No one can predict what will happen to a subject in her lab or whether the subject will be able to see the sun again for that matter.
stories.pirate:
Rachel is an ambitious pirate wanna-be.

No one knows which comic book gave her the idea, but to Rachel, pirates enjoy endless adventures and help the weak. She aspires to one day become a pirate queen of the world and already gave herself a nickname, "Crimson Rose". She is nowhere near to realize that dream yet, but she's ready to take on any adventure - preferably on the sea.
stories.sniper:
Hekate is a veteran freelancing sniper.

The only thing that matters to her is money and money alone. She finds pleasure in lavishly spending the money she earned. She is proudly obsessed with luxuries. After all, what is life without spending? She loves her job as a sniper. She's good at it. It earns good money. And she's a person who can forget the guilt with luxuries.

She is cynical as a result of spending too much time in warzone, but not too cynical to repel people. In fact, the right blend of cynicalness and wit typically makes her popular. Young girls especially tend to look up to her.
stories.innuit:
Coco is an innuit girl from Mt. Shivering.

Inheriting the cursed bloodline of the ice witch, she is gifted with powerful magic. When she realized her power, she decided to live by herself away from the people. It was to protect herself from people and people from herself. Her only friend is her loyal sleigh dog.

She may seem cold and quiet but holds deep passion and love for people. She loves watching rain on sea, as dances of running water lets her forget about her power for a moment.
stories.teatan_hero:
Marianne is a famed exoskeleton engineer in Teatan kingdom. Teatans are known for their wits and adorable appearances - with cute animal ears and child-like height. Marianne isn't exactly a fan of her size. But instead of sulking over it, she builds weapons bigger than anyone. 

She is a one-in-a-billion genius and she knows it. She is a perfectionist and a workaholic. It's not unusual for her to be stuck in her workshop for days without responding to anyone.

She is arrogant, but knows when to admire others. What she'll never do is admit someone is smarter than her.
stories.ghost_buster:
Sohee is a gifted student of magic school.

She actually doesn't have a shred of talent in magic, but understands the inner workings of magic better than anyone. By combining her understandings of magic and science, she has pioneered a new field of study called "magitech".

Although no one can deny she is smart, she isn't exactly the most sociable person around. She openly expresses how less evolved other people are and loves to correct other people. These actions are not rooted in bad personality - it's just that she doesn't know how to be honest and helping in a friendly manner.

She once petitioned for "a department dedicated to sending typo claims to Magi Times" which was immediately rejected.
stories.china_hero_boy:
Fei is an apprentice of master Tao in school of Shen Mountain Fist.

Before meeting master Tao, he was a member of a famed Tiger Clan. However his lowly eventually got him rejected from the clan. Despite all the hardships and unfairness he firmly believes that good nature and strength lie within every person.

He goes extra miles to treat people fairly, never to make anyone feel like he once did. He is well mannered and calm, but shows his soft sides when he is talking to animals.
stories.china_hero_girl:
Mei is an apprentice of master Tao in school of Shen Mountain Fist.

Once prestigious, her family was destroyed by false treason accusations by its political rivals. She started training martial arts to get her revenge, but eventually got attracted to level of depth, both physically and spiritually, that lies within the art.

She has natural gift in martial arts. Before mater Tao took her, she already trained herself into a competent martial artist. She is hot headed and impatient, but she is starting to learn to control herself through meditation.
stories.desert_slave:
Marvin is a ruthless mercenary active in Desert Kingdom.

His body is as if it was engineered for pure destruction. With his inhumane strength and toughness, he was feared even among the fellow mercenaries. He was never welcomed into any place and has given up on getting close with anyone. He is harsh and jaded. But if he were to find something precious to him, he wouldn't stop at anything to protect it.

As he's been through myriads of battles, he's never agitated by one. In fact, many would say he seems more relaxed and comfortable in battles.
stories.tanker:
Craig is a D-list warrior in Dungeon Kingdom.

For 20 years he's been training to win the infamous dungeon race - the race held every 5 years to defeat resurrected archfiends at the lowest level of the dungeon. He never had any luck with the races and works as a bouncer in a local pub. The thought that his life will never amount to anything gives him the worst nightmare. But despite everything, his eyes never cease to gaze into the future.

He is a natural born tank. He can take damages. He can take tons of damage - fire, ice, thunder, swords, hammers, you name it. When equipped with good armors, he is a very hard man to hurt.
stories.akayuki:
Akayuki is an ancient wandering swordsman.

She's been petrified for 500 years and is a bit out of touch with the modern world. When faced with entirely new technologies and cultures, her solution was simple. Nothing. She'll live the way she always has and figure things out on the go.

She has dedicated her life to challenging strong opponents. She will stop at nothing when there is any chance of a good fight and will fight with everything she has no matter who the opponent is. And if she loses, she will admire the foe and laugh it off. She simply enjoys good fights.
stories.doll_girl:
Ranpang is a boss of Dragon Talon Clan rooted in the city of Shen.

Ranpang's stuffed dragon costume is not for kids. The dragon costume not only intimidates the most brave opponents but serves as a perfect armor to deflect any attack. Or that's at least what Ranpang thinks.

Dragon Talon Clan aims to conquer Shen and eventually dominate the world. This ruthless clan brainwashes the poor by distributing food for them or raises people's blood sugar level by slipping candies into their supplies. People of Shen tremble at the cruelty of the clan. Or that's at least what Ranpang thinks.
stories.succubus:
Yuze is a succubus adventurer.

It is customary for a succubus to take a career in dream therapies or show business these days. After all, they need men's energy to survive. However, Yuze always held unmatched curiosity towards the outer world. The stories of dragon slayers always excited her more than that of a popular actress. Despite concerns from those around her, she made a bold choice to become an adventurer.

Despite having a pure adventuring soul, she still is a succubus. She often says things that may make others' faces red without realizing. Her innocent actions are often misconstrued as being seductive.
stories.plitvice:
Plitvice is a goddess of war.

She controls fire at will. She isn't at her full power as the tree of life was burnt down 500 years ago. But she is still a formidable warrior that can make any foe tremble. She appears authoritative. In fact, she's obsessed with looking that way. Perhaps, it's an over compensation for being a young goddess who is actually quite sloppy. She was sealed away in Heavenhold, waiting for the arrival of a worthy champion.

In her long life, she lost many loved ones. She even lost contact with her faithful servant, Angie, while she was sealed away. Making new friends is exciting but also terrifying to her. After all, it is highly probable that she'll outlive most of them.
stories.steam_princess:
Aisha is a 7th princess of Rah Empire, the most powerful rival to Kanterbury Kingdom.

She is considered to have the best chance at the throne among her siblings. Many questioned the emperor's favoritism towards his seventh daughter, but she ended the controversy by displaying unmatched political finesse and intelligence. She excelled at leadership training and was well versed in the empire's situation inside out. Most of all, she had a very clear vision of the empire's future.

She is relatively small, but has a very strong and charismatic voice despite her size. It may sound cold, but it has power to attract the mass.
stories.uptown_lancer_girl:
Lapice is a lady knight from a noble family.

Despite being raised in a conservative family, she was always concerned with social/economical equality. She often got in trouble for her progressive views during her knight training.

Although she wanted to travel around the world to expand her knowledge, that was one thing her parents would never allow. To circumvent this, Lapice started her adventures by disguising herself in a fancy dress as if she's attending snobby social events. She also developed an unique skill of masquerading weapons as harmless accessories. Because she is tall and has long arms and legs, she can attack unsuspecting enemies at distance.
stories.steam_knight:
Shapira is a knight of Rah empire and a servant to its princess, Aisha.

She swore her life to protect the princess and always stood by her. Shapira can be a bit overprotective, as she still sees Aisha as a fragile baby. Aisha hates this, but Shapira can't help it. Shapira's face is always ice cold since her smiles are reserved for the princess and the princess only.

She is strict, stern, and always serious about everything. If someone makes a joke about her, she'll throw him a gauntlet for a duel. If someone makes a joke about Aisha, she'll make sure there is a new entry in Rah's graveyard.
stories.swindler:
Dolf is a mercenary and a con artist.

He disguises as a prominent court wizard and charges an expensive fee for his service. In reality, he dropped out of the magic school when his former noble family fell to poverty. Some may say he's a victim of circumstances, but even they can't deny how talented Dolf is as a con man. His natural charm and fluent talking skills produced many blissfully ignorant customers for him.

Although he dropped out, Dolf is still an exceptional wizard. Perhaps, if he was given enough time he would have made a great court wizard. He travels with his mercenary partner, Amy.
stories.maid:
Amy is a mercenary and a berserker, dressed as a maid.

It's not a fashion choice. Her mercenary partner, Dolf, asked her to wear it so that he can better disguise himself as a high class court magician. Amy hates the ploy but plays along since Dolf gets them great deals that Amy could never get. 

She is usually quiet and timid. But when it comes to battles she is a formidable berserker. She wields two handed weapons like it's a children's toy and roars like a dragon. The face she makes alone can give her foes nightmares.
stories.dragon_boy:
Girgas is a mischievous young dragon.

It is unclear where he came from. He ran away from home because he wanted to use magic without getting scolded by his mother. "I'm a dragon. I can do what I want!" is what he said, right before his incomplete transformation magic got him stuck in a half-dragon half-human form.

He looks down on humans as they are weak and small. But it should be noted that Girgas himself is young and naive, completely new to the world. He tries to pretend nothing ever surprises him but that unfortunately fools no one.
stories.survivor:
Catherine is a dimensional travel survivor.

Originally from Canada, she was hit by a truck one day and was thrown into the world of Kanterbury. She was initially excited in the hopes of becoming a hero, like many other dimensional travelers in comics do. But all she ever faced was threats after threats - monsters, dungeons, and humans. She miraculously survived, but has grown paranoid to, well, everything.  

She's proud to say her favorite TV show "Surviving wilderness" really saved her life in the new world. She misses the culture of her homeland a lot. She often mutters she would die for a greasy piece of cheeseburger and a coke.
stories.guardian_linda:
Linda is a senior member of the Guardians.

She learned how to shoot a bow from her father, who was a hunter. She is strict to junior guardians, but she doesn't hesitate to help them in need. She likes to take care of others secretly. Guardians often talk about that one holiday when Linda secretly put little boxes of cookies in lockers of every single member. Linda still denies it was her to this day.
stories.guardian_bob:
Bob is a member of the Guardians.

Everyone will tell you Bob is one fine knight. What they'll also tell you is that he gets scared easily. Bob trained himself hard in hopes of becoming brave. He did get incredibly strong in the process and made it as a guardian, but he couldn't fix his personality. When in battle, his biggest challenge is getting over his fear. Once he does, he fights like a beast.
stories.hyper:
Hyper is the hero of Byrule, the legendary elven kingdom.

She is playful and innocent, but also considerate at the same time. She is good with swords and can't stand injustice.

She rescued prince Elda from an evil pig monster and saved Byrule multiple times. But for some reason, the pig monster kept coming back and somehow succeeded in kidnapping Elda every single time. Now Hyper is once again on a journey to save the prince, but she asks herself, "Does it ever end?"
stories.caravan_maria:
Maria is a merchant who runs a traveling caravan shop along with her friend, Lisa.

Maria and Lisa have been friends since childhood. Maria is a bit short and chubby, but she is smart and quick. She's jack of all trades. When Lisa makes a mistake in the books, Maria will secretly correct it for her. 

Sometimes she has to go on an extra adventure to save their investor, Prince Beach, from a mischievous turtle queen. It's tiresome, but with Lisa's help, Maria can overcome any challenge.
stories.caravan_lisa:
Lisa is a merchant who runs a traveling caravan shop along with her friend, Maria. She takes care of managing products and finances.

Lisa and Maria have been friends since childhood. Although they love each other to death, Lisa always felt there was a bit of a rivalry between the two, a rivalry that she always lost. To Lisa, Maria is someone who she depends on but would like to surpass one day.

Lisa doesn't like their investor, Prince Beach, and often wonders what Maria sees in him.
stories.elf_archer:
Leah is an elven protector of Kanterbury forest.

No one knows where she came from or when she started to protect the forest. By her own account, she was just passing by the forest when she saw animals cornered by a poacher. She saved the animals, then she saw another poacher, kicked him out, one thing led to another and she realized she was several decades late to her appointment.

Because most poachers are humans she developed hate towards them. Maybe someone with a good heart can change her mind someday.
stories.teatan_ninja:
Jay is a Teatan ninja.

He is small, flexible, and is good at hiding his body. From early on he enjoyed ninja-like activities such as surprising his parents' from behind or hiding under the bed before someone came to wake him up. He is also good at not getting noticed and can sneak away without anyone noticing.

His biggest decision was whether he should choose a career as a ninja or a private detective. Although the latter had better financial perspective, Jay chose the former, as he gets to say more badass lines.
stories.teatan_fighter_a:
Dragon is a Teatan fighter who mastered Ultra Rationale.

Ultra Rationale is a technique that connects every single muscle cell to its user's consciousness. It allows the user to plan actions and have muscles move exactly according to the plan, leaving no room for instincts or spontaneous movements. Because he needs to plan everything beforehand it requires some time for him to do anything, but when he does, he carries it out with perfect accuracy. He is the only Teatan known to master this technique.
stories.teatan_fighter_b:
Blade is a Teatan fighter who can transform into Super Teatan 2.

Only a pure minded Teatan triggered by extreme anger can transform into Super Teatan. Blade first transformed into Super Teatan at 12, when he was grounded for failing geology. While grounded he enhanced his spirit through meditation which allowed him to transform into Super Teatan 2, an even higher form of transformation.

Blade is small, even among the Teatans. That allows him to maintain his speed even after the transformation.
stories.ms_student_bad_female:
Mina is a troublesome student at the magic school.

She thinks she's imprisoned in school for being a student and is waiting for a release in the name of graduation. She's always angry with her parents. They spent every penny they had to send Mina to the prestigious school, but she feels left out. Even though she loves them deep down, it may take some time for her to resolve the issue with her parents. She's also obsessed with being popular among her peers.
stories.sapa_dragontalon_minion:
Hoshida is an underboss of the Dragon Talon Clan, a secret organization located in the city of Shen.

He has no doubt that the Dragon Talon will conquer the world. He's always eager to recruit new members.

He thinks Ranpang's dragon costume is marvelous and wishes he has one like it. He has a lot of ideas for his own costume. The most recent one was inspired by a raccoon trying to wash cotton candy in a river.
stories.succubus_researcher:
Peggy is a researcher from the Succubus town.

Her research focuses on the ecology of rare monsters. She is known for a bold investigative method - she descends dangerous dungeons herself to observe monsters. She is also a prolific writer and has published multiple books which became must-read among adventurers.

She wears thick glasses on purpose as she doesn't want to accidentally seduce her colleagues.
stories.dungeon_ailie:
Ailie is a scavenger in Dungeon Kingdom.

She collects items from fallen warriors and sells them. Scavengers and warriors are not exactly on good terms, but she has a special bond with Craig.

She's small and fast. She is smart in using environments to hide herself and search fallen warriors. It's a risky job but it's the only job that a kid like her can take to feed herself in Dungeon Kingdom.
stories.ghost_guard_female:
Oralie is a guardian spirit of Kanterbury ruins.

After spending eternity guarding ancient Kanterbury relics, she began to look for new purposes of life, and fell in love with a fellow guardian spirit. She is one of few spirits who can cherish her own life (well, afterlife). She does occasionally check back on the relics, since she still gets nervous if she stays away for too long away from them.
stories.whitetiger_baby:
Kang is a white tiger cub in Shen city.

He is still small and young. He smiles with his tongue out when he's happy. He initially had a hard time among his siblings due to his small size, but with his strong claws and cute yet savage roars, he proved himself to his mother.

He loves to pass time in boxes. No matter how small a box is, he always finds a way to get in.
stories.shop_girl:
Agatha is a traveling merchant.

The large kitchen knife strapped to her back is not a weapon. It's a keepsake from her grandmother who was a great cook. People do get frightened by the huge knife though. As a result, no hagglers dare to bargain allowing Agatha to maintain a high profit margin.

She has a long hair that almost covers her eyes, which makes her look creepy. It's not a fashion choice - she simply doesn't have time to get a haircut.
stories.doctor_bear:
DaVinci is an inventor of Dragon Talon Clan, a secret organization located in the city of Shen. He is in charge of weapon development.

He takes great pride in his inventions, and considers himself and his inventions indispensable to Dragon Talon. He considers himself first in line to the boss' seat. He has never told anyone about this, but he thinks his weapons are stronger than Ranpang's dragon costume. He hates it when other people call him a bear.
stories.ms_student_president:
Kate is a president of the student council at the magic school.

She is infamous for being strict and stern. Some students think she is too rigid. But even they can't deny how compassionate and calm Kate was during the school's ghost crisis. Deep inside, she is always thinking of ways to improve the school for students. Needless to say, she makes it into the dean's list every year.
stories.dungeon_succubus_a:
Zoe is a tour guide of the Succubus town.

Ever since childhood, she loved to venture every part of the town. She knows and loves every inch of the town - from crowded tourist attractions to her own personal quiet place for meditation.

She is easy going and kind. She can help any nervous tourist to have a time of his life in the town. However, her kindness should not be construed as weakness. She knows her way in battles and when customers get rough, she is more than capable of taking them down.
stories.monk_disciple:
Rio is an apprentice of the famed monk, Li.

Rio's parents left her at the doorstep of a small temple and never came back. She grew up in the temple studying martial arts. She never resented her parents. She believes that they will reunite someday and trains hard so she can make them proud when that day comes. When she feels down, she goes to a lake and skips stones.
stories.admiral:
Marina is the youngest admiral of Adela Navy, a trusted ally of Kanterbury kingdom.

She lost her ship, Irmina, along with her crew to the invaders the day Kanterbury fell. The agony of losing her crew made her leave the navy and start  a one-woman crusade against the invaders.

Marina's fleet was known to be the best of Adela Navy. Her precise and quick directions allowed the fleet to release deadly barrage to any enemy. She is also well known for her powerful swordplay. Despite her small body, she wields swords almost as big as herself with incredible strength. With her signature hookshot, she can even throw ogres around.

She may look aloof and cold, but that doesn't mean she lacks passion. She's just selective when it comes to what she actually wants to focus on. In other words, don't expect any attention from her unless you can make yourself her priority.
stories.villain_redhood:
Arabelle is the youngest caporegime of the crime syndicate, Reservoir Snakes.

She is both revered and feared by her crew. She is the most skilled soldier and at the same time the most unstable killer.

Arabelle holds deep hatred towards humanity and the world. As a baby, she was abandoned by her parents. As a kid, she was sold off to the crime syndicate by her step parents to pay off their gambling debts. The Great Grandma, the boss of Reservoir Snakes, made sure she was getting her money's worth. Arabelle spent her teenage in agony and pain, going through cruelest trainings and surgeries to replace body parts with machines.

Arabelle appreciates the Great Grandma for giving her power to take down the world. She cherishes the red hood that the grandma gave her. She is fiercely jealous of Elvira and competes with her every moment.
stories.teatan_zaco:
Private Nyan is a loyal member of TDF (Teatan Defence Force).

Even though he is still young, he is known to be one of the most dedicated soldier of the corps. He has two big brothers who also serve in TDF. He loves writing to family but because Nyan is often involved in classified missions, his letters keep piling up under his bed.
stories.idol_captain:
Idol captain Eva is the 19th captain of the guardians, who sings and dances in a cute diva dress.

Contrary to her usual strict and stern voice, her singing is nothing short of an angel. This is because she flows mana into her voice which also makes it deadly to her enemies. Even though she likes to sing, she is worried that it will make her look weak as a knight. She therefore puts on the diva dress and accessories to disguise herself as a mysterious idol before she sings. Of course, everyone in Kanterbury knows that the beautiful idol is captain Eva. 

Her singing has built a cult fan base. She sometimes announces a small concert for her fans, which always turns into a massive fan gathering. Free from her duty as a knight for the moment, she presents the fans, or rather, her companions beautiful songs & dances full of smiles.
stories.flower_girl:
Bari is a disciple of the god of harvest. Her mission is to resurrect the burnt world tree by collecting happy memories from people.

Bari grants you one wish and takes your happiest memory away in return. The greater the wish, the bigger chunk of memories it'll cost. Bari always tries to remain distant to her clients to avoid getting involved with humans but often fails due to her compassionate nature. When she sees someone desperately in need but does not have enough happy memories, she chips in her own memory to grant the wish. You should not get frustrated if she doesn't remember you - it just means she cherished the memory with you and passed the happiness to another in need. 

She has two rules when granting wishes. One - if her client becomes greedy and attempts to exploit her, she will make sure the client pay for the sin whether it's by her own hand or by curse of mother nature. Two - she won't bring anyone back from dead. It always made clients' lives worse.
stories.witch_coco:
Lupina is the legendary ice witch of the innuit tribe.

She is notorious for her cruelty and fickleness. She appears every once in decades and hunts people for pleasure. When she invades, the land suffers endless blizzard and snowstorms. If you dare to go out hunting in that weather, believe me, it will be you who gets hunted. She treats her victims in a variety of ways. Sometimes she would simply let them go. But most other times, she becomes very creative with killing the victims slowly and painfully. Every innuit folklore includes Lupina as a villain in some form.

She enjoys her infamy very much. She carefully calculates her reappearances so that her name will be never forgotten among people. She searches her name on web everyday. Her favorite keywords are "Lupina witch," "Lupina hot," and "Lupina cosplay."
stories.battleball_girl:
Rie is the cleanup hitter for the best Heavenhold battleball team, Purple Sox.

She is a passionate ace solely focused on battleball and practice all the time. The blazing desert is her battleball field, the freezing snow mountain is perfect to hone her battle sense for harsh weather and her batting power. Impossible is nothing, practice makes perfect are her slogans.

She is a connoisseur in steak. The perfect way to end a harsh training with sweat and exhausted body has to be a grilled juicy steak.
stories.librarian:
Lahn is a scrivener of the ancient scriptorium that records the history of the world.

Her family has been observing and recording the world since its beginning. They write in an ancient language whose letters channel powerful waves generated by the world's memory itself. As the latest of her bloodline, Lahn masterfully wields the letters both as a talented historian and as a powerful protector of the scriptorium. 

She uses archaic dialects and often talks as if she is writing poetry. Because people often misinterpret the trait as being smug, she secretly practices talking normally but has hard time grasping the concept of urban slangs.

She recently discovered her letters emanating unusually powerful waves. Sensing something drastic is occuring in the world, she ventured out of the scriptorium to witness the event with her own eyes.
stories.eugene:
Eugene is a movie star in Burywood.

Before she made her way into the stardom, she endured long and arduous period as a stunt double. She got her lucky break when the quirky director Vale discovered her for the action film "Bat Queen." The movie was an instant box office hit. She continued to work with Vale on "Queensman" which was another instant hit. 

Her career dwindled when she signed a contract with the infamous Invader Pictures, Inc. She had constant clash with the studio while shooting the film "War of Stars." The movie was eventually cancelled and her streak seemed to be over as well. Her career revived when she rejoined with Vale for the indie film "Guardian Story" where she played a young aspiring guardian.

Due to her roles as heroes, she has cemented her image as an honest and righteous hero. However, Eugene mentioned in one interview that she actually enjoys B rated gore/kaiju films and that she would love to play a villain.

She is known to be a very positive and hard working person. Because of her prolonged stunt career she is extremely durable, a master of various weapons, and an expert bike rider.
stories.dancing_archer:
Tinia is a dancer/assassin active in Desert of Madness.

She works as a dancer by day but moonlights as one of the most effective assassins with her favorite bow. Her white hair and dress makes her shine as a dancer but also allows her to hide in moonlight when waiting for her target. She tries to keep her night job secret from her mother.

She has one rule - she'll only kill bad people. However, it doesn't take a lot of effort to convince her someone is bad due to her inherent naiveness. One time, she was convinced her target is evil because he uses twice as much toilet paper. In her own mind, she is a righteous superhero who punishes bad guys.

Tinia's parents separated when she was very young. Tinia went with her mother, and her sister went with her human father. Tinia misses them, but her mother never allows her to talk about them. She can't even remember what her sister looks like, but she often daydreams about having a miraculous reunion with her sister.
stories.fire_bishop:
Vishuvac is one of many avatars of the Fire Dragon King.

Following the treaty with humans, the Fire Dragon King sealed herself to suppress her powers while letting other fire dragons roam free. The successor of the king must isolate oneself from the world, which is Girgas, the son. Vishuvac and other avatars are looking for the runaway Girgas in the human world. Vishuvac is the only avatar who wants to free Girgas of his destiny. Unlike other avatars who are cold and rational, Vishuvac is filled with pity and isn't willing to push Girgas into the endless seclusion. Though she is in search of Girgas as her duty as an avatar, it's why she must find him before anyone else does. 

She loves and is loved by mortals. Her cordial and genuine character attracts humans, though it's considered an odd trait for dragons. Wherever Vishvac stops by, she leaves a trail of friends who remember her. She's obsessed with food, especially the goods and delicacies of human food. She favors exotic and spiced-filled foods but avoids all types of greens and raw foods.
stories.eight_tail:
Nari is an eight-tailed fox sage.

She is born missing a tail and uses her bead to use magic. She grew up training with the nine-tailed fox, Garam. Because of her missing tail, she lacks magic powers and trained with the help of Garam. While in a long sleep in the form of a stone statue, she was awakened from desperate rituals and prayers from villagers asking for help.

She does want to allure everyone with her cute and adorable looks but detests being treated like a child. She bluntly plays the role of a cute kid, but when the opponent falls for it and treats her like one, she becomes instantly angry for thinking of her as a naive kid. Because of her short temper, she tends to be unexpectedly frank.

She may look like a child, but she has lived long ages. She speaks plainly to everyone and tends to blow on her own trumpet, which often makes her appear like a repulsive child. She's very wise and acts as the sage, helping humans in trouble. She also has old-fashioned taste compared to her looks. She likes "sweet and savory" butterscotch candy and prefers "hot" tea than cold drinks that make her tummy cold.
stories.succubus_noble:
Bianca is a succubus lady from a prominent high-class noble family. 

She was raised like a princess at home. The high-quality private education from her family, along with her natural strength and intelligence, made her an outstanding elite with both the brains and battle skills. She is extremely beautiful. She always wears tailored clothes, showing off the look of a perfect combination of a gentleman and a lady. She has extravagant taste and has a knack in "aesthetics."

Unlike normal succubi that seduce humans and absorb their energy, she summons and throws ice, pushing the enemy to move away from her. Due to this, although she aced her school subjects, her grades for the "Seduction" class were close to failure. It's very fortunate of her to have been born into a rich family, where she still can live without gaining human energy by herself.

She's from the same class as Yuze. She graduated second place after Yuze, who aced the mandatory Seduction class essential to the succubi. After having a tough time accepting her defeat, she thinks of Yuze as her rival—so much so that she changed her future career job from "an orchestra maestro" to "an adventurer" after seeing Yuze exclaim her dream to become one with such enthusiasm. In contrast to all this, Yuze considers Bianca as a smart and pretty friend. Bianca can't help herself sulking and pouting at Yuze, who is so undesigningly kind to her.
stories.robot_tanker:
Oghma is a giant mecha robot.

2.1m tall and weighs 527kg. A gnome inventor created by renovating an invader's armor. Nobody except the inventor and the invaders would know exactly what basic materials have been used. It can attack with a giant sword, and it can equip up to 6 missiles in the magazine behind its head. It can also create a vibration field and convey pressure on specific targeted areas by vibrating its body.

The pilot of Oghma is a gnome boy named Aidan. When the invaders invaded the Inn, Aidan almost gave up his life to protect Lord Smiley Face. More than half of his bones were broken after the malicious attack but was revived by the gnome inventor with the technology from the invaders' armor. Parts of his body parts were replaced with machines, transforming Aidan into a half cyborg. This made him the one and only pilot that can become one even to the soul with Oghma as he can control the mecha by connecting parts of his body to it.

Before becoming the Oghma pilot, Aidan was a boy with nothing but exaggerated heroism, acting as a self-appointed 'the hero of the Inn.' But after the battle with invaders and gaining a second chance in life, he has awakened to the real meaning of his life. That is to be the one to protect Lord Smiley Face, Loraine. Now, Aidan pretends to be a human to perform his sole duty to protect the world of Loraine the Smiley Face from the evil and the invaders.
stories.golem_rider:
Alef is an alchemist who makes golems out of woods. 

An aesthetic who covets beauty. Though it's not quite easy for other people to understand, he has his own sets of "philosophies" on appreciation of beauty. Not only does he appreciate the outer beauty but he also recognizes the inner beauty that's "reflected on" one's looks. He has his own "Lady Radar" and believes one that is ugly on the inside cannot make the radar ring, however beautiful on the outside. When he finds "the real beauty," he willingly becomes a loyal servant of it. 

Though he looks like a child, he's actually 38 years old. He made a potion to make him younger because some women didn't care for older men. Yet he accidentally made the potion too strong, and turned himself into a child. It's not impossible to turn him back, but he chose to live on as he is, after seeing women become less cautious with him. 

His full name he used back at home was Alefiod. He was the smart one in the prestigious alchemist family, but he always made some trouble with his laziness and fondness for women. His talents had been wasted on creating a gem as a gift for a neighborhood sweetheart, or creating a golem to do all his chores, and such. When a war broke out with a neighboring country, he created the ultimate golem out of birch woods at the request of the royal family and successfully protected the country. Thinking golem's powers as an opportunity, the royals tried to start another war. He persistently refused to use his golem for war and was eventually exiled eternally. After leaving his country, he vowed to start a new life and named himself Alef.
stories.festival_girl:
Miya is an exorcist who fights evil spirits with her dutiful souls.

She was born in a distinguished exorcist family, with a destiny to eradicate the foul and make the world a purer place with her innate spiritual powers. She can see things that are not visible to other people. Either by gently soothing them, or by conducting an exorcism, she leads the lost spirits to heaven. Though she has to constantly face the dark, she never loses her high spirit and kindness. She is affable to everybody, and willingly helps those who suffer from the evil deeds of demons and spirits.

Yet she has an issue, which is that she is very addicted to entertainment, especially to the festivals and gambling. Miya's family had the custom to hold a festival after a successful exorcism. It was to please the living, comfort the dead and to give a proper conclusion to everyone, so the elders said. Miya used to love these festivals. Perhaps a bit too much. Young Miya was greatly captivated by festivals filled with bright lanterns, music, fireworks and games.

Miya played three-card monte as her first gambling game. Until she was dragged home in her neighborhood's hand who ran into Miya having too much fun, she won two times and lost six times in a row and nearly lost everything she had. She couldn't just forget the excitement, though. She secretly ran around playing games with her family treasures at stake, and ended up losing all her family's dutiful souls to all over the world. Her grandmother and the elders kicked her out of the house and ordered never to come back home unless she was with all the spirits she lost. Yet she still can't quit gambling, for she believes she can "make it big with one shot" and bring all of the lost spirits home. She often loses all her money earned from her exorcism, and always blames the ghosts saying "they constantly tell her what to do and confuse her."
stories.future_princess:
She was the little princess of Kanterbury. You'll meet her on Heavenhold after 10 years have passed. The little princess who used to dash around the Heavenhold now became an adult.

You, the Guardian took the adventure to the Rah Empire then never came back. It made the little princess anxious. She remembered leaving cheerful message to you when you called through the Rah Empire's payphone. You seemed fine to her back then. Whatever happened to you worried the princess. As she was very sure that the Emperor and the people of Rah Empire did some horrible stuff to you, Aisha arrived at the Heavenhold announcing the alliance between Rah Empire and Kanterbury Kingdom. Aisha and Shapira replied that they thought the Guardian already returned to Heavenhold.

The little princess couldn't possibly understand this sudden farewell. No one taught her that you have to accept the things you cannot understand. So the princess just waited and waited. Her knight always came back and greeted her first. There's no way her knight would have forgotten the duties they have promised to fulfill. The mischievous kids in Heavenhold bullied the princess telling her that 'Your knight ran away,' or 'Your sister and the Knight ran away cuz they hate you.' She drove those kids away, with such great vigor, and then got back to the Inn to shed the tears. The sound of her sorrow made even Loraine sad. Rumors spread among the champions. Some said you have died. Some said you have run away. Some said you were still fulfilling the duty as the Guardian. The princess trusted no one. Only the princess was confident that the astray Guardian would come back. The moment her long and the most strong conviction was shattered, the princess couldn't possibly handle the pain.

Princess' tears for the missing person slowly turned into tears of hatred over the years. There were so many tragedies that could have been prevented if you was there. Heavenhold now became the last line of defense for humanity. Friends struck down leaving only names and graves, and the enemies never gave chance to mourn their death. Princess is now a soldier protecting the remaining humans and also the leader of the Resistance to bring back the forsaken world. Through the training of Knight Captain Eva, the little princess grew up to be a resolute leader. Yet how tragic it is that her innocent smile is now replaced with such strictness and a little bit of fatigue.
stories.garam:
Garam is a nine-tailed fox sage.

He became a sage after a long, long training in the fox cave. As Nari's old friend, supporter, and competitor, he wields more powerful magic than Nari since he has one extra tail than her.

While Nari was in a deep, long sleep inside a stone statue, Garam travelled the world with Dallae, who had nowhere to go, and nurtured those in need. However, the greedy humans, who got help from Garam, pulled a scheme to steal Sage's magic which ultimately led to Dallae's death. Garam got engulfed in sorrow and rage and went on a frenzy. Nari, awakened from her sleep, alleviated Garam's frenzy and reminded him about the duty as a sage, and Garam finally calmed himself down and went on a path of training to once again uphold his duty as a sage. This time, he hopes to learn to control himself and his power through archery, and he aims to nurture a wider world with his warm heart without settling at one place.

After training for ages in the mountains, Garam had no idea what was going on with the world. It's a shock that there are now so many people wielding magic. So many things are incomprehensible or seems without obvious purposes, no matter how much he looks at them. Magic is the only conclusion Garam can come up with when encountering all these advanced technology. He is especially sure that Sohee is a some kind of ill-tempered sage.
stories.invader_knight:
Beth is a magician within the invaders, a high ranking priest of the invader order.

She is a drama queen strategist. War is brain before brawn. She crafts her plans while predicting and reacting to her opponent's move as if she is playing a game of chess. Beth likes to add some dramatic elements to her plays, especially when she is planning her grand entrance. It probably would have been better to pose as a nobody to infiltrate the Rah Empire's Kanterbury refugee camp.
