Choosing to pose as Penny, who was beloved by everyone, and go around the camp while betraying everyone's love has to be her adding that dramatic aspect to her plan. She can sacrifice without hesitation any piece on her chess board to achieve her goals, because all those moves are steps to serve a greater good for the invader's mission and to fulfill the Savior's prophecy that was never wrong.

To the invaders the Savior's prophecy is a "maxim" that cannot be doubted. Beth, like all other invaders, learned and preached the words of the Savior and trained to "reclaim" the world. Beth's cunning game of chess based on the maxim should always prevail. Pitiful savages would never understand it, and she pities the pitiful savages for not understanding it. Then who is this Guardian that casts doubt on Beth's faith? Everything else is as the prophecy, but this Guardian causes chaos and discord and it annoys Beth. Is the Savior wrong, or is the Guardian's heresy corrupting savior's pureness? Beth has no choice but to be in doubt.

She loathes when someone calls her real name and everyone is required to call her 'High Priest.' It seems to be a dearest name for her.
stories.rudolph:
Rue is Santa's helper aiding Santa to deliver gifts all around the world on Christmas.

She's a weredeer, a deer human existed since ancient times. She is by herself after poachers slaughtered her family when she was young. She possesses wild instinct and exceptional physical prowess, and also a special ability sealed under her name given by her family. Usually she uses her alias and hides her real name. Santa is the only one knowing her real name as of now.

She's a bit gloomy and cynical. And sometimes cold and indifferent. However, when it comes to fixing Santa's problem, she's fierce and passionate. She would burn down the entire house to fright the mouse. She is skillful in using explosives and huge weaponry, and also very adept in steering giant gears such as dump trucks and aircrafts with her "instinctive knack." There's even a famous anecdote. The day Santa bought the gift-delivery aircraft because the sleigh was too cold, Rue lifted off the aircraft with no problem. Confounded Santa asked, "When did you get a pilot's license?" and Rue answered, "I didn't." Santa slapped on Rue's back, telling her to go get one, so Rue did as Santa said: the very next day she got Tetis special pilot's license on her first try.

Rue used to be a weak cry baby at her young age. The cold weather made her nose red, and the kids would tease her, how she is sniffing and crying again. Then she would actually burst into tears. Only a sweet candy in her mouth could lighten her day. Even now when she's giving her loyalty to Santa under the "Real Name Contract," there's always a piece of candy in her mouth.
stories.viking:
Neva is a descendant of a legendary warrior tribe that hunts dragons.

Although she's from a tribe that considers dragons as enemies, she is a stubborn girl who wants to befriend dragons. Since her youth, she was taught that dragons were pure evil and prey to hunt, and she was trained by the best warrior in the tribe, her aunt. However, when she heard the tale of a hero who defeated the wicked magician alongside a dragon, she dropped the bombshell that she would befriend a dragon. She was cast off from her tribe and she embarked on a journey around the world to find a dragon friend, 

Bold and vigorous, capricious warrior. When she gets too excited, she would lose control and start swinging around her huge battleaxe. One can imagine how out of control Neva was when she met Girgas, a real dragon, for the first time in her life.
stories.store_angel:
Gabriel is a former archangel running a supermarket.

After the world tree burnt down, she lost her powers and now runs a convenience store in the human world. Although her days as the archangel are gone, she still lives a glamorous life exploiting her part-time workers. She claims that her ultimate mission is to "maintain world peace and to spread good deeds all around the world," so she has earned herself the title of "Madam Archangel" and "Honest Role Model of Business Person."

However, hidden behind the angelic face is a very crooked and oppressive boss. She doesn't guarantee minimum wage and refuses to write an employment agreement, and also sells the store's expired food to part-time workers. Surprisingly, she still has her divine power even when she oppresses her part-time worker harder than the devil. Gabriel's blessing raises one's morale and strength, and she abuses this "blessing" to make her workers work without a break.

Gabriel's longest employed worker is Angie the angel who used to serve Plitvice. Gabriel enticed diligent Angie, who is already busy bringing back sealed Plitvice and paying back debt as the Secretary of the Heaven Treasury, to be her part-time worker. Then she gradually increased Angie's working hours longer than the time she spends in the Heaven Treasury. Whenever Angie tries to get away from the store, Gabriel would provoke her, saying how "she is disappointed that her loyalty to Plitvice is frivolous." Angie, who is oblivious to human affairs and also poor, is grateful she can buy expired frozen food at a reduced price, and she is also grateful she can work hard to buy a pudding for Plitvice someday.
stories.teatan_robot_marty_junior:
Marty Junior is Marty's son, who was the Teatan Defence Force captain and Marianne's friend. 

He spent his adolescence blaming his father for abandoning his wife and son to defend the kingdom and Marianne for causing his father's death. However, after reconciling with Marianne through Marianne's heartfelt apology, Marty Junior grew to be a better person with the teaching from a skilled engineer, Marianne. Marty Junior could acquire both Marty's bravery and leadership, and Marianne's adept engineering skills.
stories.china_chef:
Lynn is a chef running a bento shop in Shen City.

She's a chef using monster meat as the main ingredient. Lynn's shop was doing quite well until one customer's review bomb completely decimated her business overnight. That night, while on her way back home after drinking her sorrow away, she rescued a child almost getting run over by an automobile and got fatally injured. After miraculously waking up, she somehow gained insight into cooking and operating a shop, and decided to try again one last time.

Lynn's misfortune started way before her shop went bankrupt; she is truly the incarnation of bad luck. The restaurant run by her parents went bankrupt during the time of clashes between the Tiger clan and the Viper clan. Every other little diner Lynn started to work at went straight bankrupt. Eventually, she had no choice but to go learn how to cook from an old chef she met in the first diner she worked. Since everything goes south when she tries to do anything, she got into the habit of drinking tea and getting drunk every day to soothe the bitterness.

She loves every kind of tea, but her favorite is Shen City's most beloved grain tea. When she drinks tea she'll befriend anyone next to her, and get into a fight with the person next to them the following moment. She's lively and friendly when she's drunk, but always anxious when she's sober. The same thing goes for her combats; with her drinks, she gets more powerful, full of confidence, and without any hesitation. It's hard to tell if she's performing martial arts or she's just too drunk to control her body when she fights, and that is her own signature 'Drunken Swordsmanship' move.
stories.future_knight:
When the portal that could send the Guardian back to the past opened in the future Heavenhold, this Guardian Knight, among all the Knights in the infinite number of parallel universes, decided to "stay in the future world" and spent 10 years since.

As the Knight gazes upon the portal, the Knight did know this future can be prevented. And that the Little Princess from 10 years back would not be abandoned. However, the thought that the Future Princess, who just finally coped with her past, might cease to exist, and the thought that the 10 years she and her friends had to endure without the knight would be for nothing. So the Knight made a decision. A decision to stay in the future and continue the battle.

And 10 years have passed since. Battles became way harder than the showdown with the Dark Magician waged on. Turning the table of the war seemed impossible. Heavenhold was reclaimed, but the Dark Magician was only one of many Invader Corps Commanders. Most of the Earth was still under-occupied by Invaders, and not many Resistance were alive. However, the Resistance did not disperse or give up. With the trust that the Knight would not abandon them again, the Resistance rallied behind the Knight and Princess and made small but precious progress in taking back some of the lands. This was the reason why the Knight could comfort the Princess with confidence, who was blaming herself for not letting the Knight go back to the past. With people fighting alongside, the Knight doesn't regret the decision to stay in the future. There are still many hardships to overcome, but the Knight, the Princess, and the rest of the Resistance rely on each other to take another step forward.
stories.priestess:
Veronica is the Archpriestess of the Chosen One.

The Chosen Ones is a group of people with a belief that "the legendary Chosen One will give them salvation from all the torment of this land" - a new religion that came about since the Invaders started to attack mankind. Their fate and goal are to find the legendary Chosen One. Because no one knows who the Chosen One is, nor whether one actually exists, they believe that they must find Chosen One candidates who might yet not be aware of them being "Chosen One," and awaken their abilities as the Chosen One through the Chosen One trial. Nothing is known about the specifics of the trial for the Chosen One, yet it is told that no one has survived it so far.

On the outside, Veronica is a kind and naive leader who guides the people to faith and devotion with the pure religious faith of hers. So naive, that she would even approach an enemy ten times the size of her to preach to them. Yet when someone refuses to believe in the Chosen One, it becomes a whole different story. It is said that Veronica's eyes give off a gruesome sparkle when she compels the non-believers to kneel and repent. There is one other occasion when her eyes sparkle; that is when she encounters a Chosen One candidate. The details of the Trial is unknown, but no one has survived it so far.

Veronica's faith in the immaterial Chosen One well deserves to be called fanatical - her unconditional faith has attained great power in itself and transformed into holy power, after all. As the World Tree has been burnt away, there are few Gods left who can officially bestow holy power. Thus however powerful, Veronica's holy power is a dangerous gift with its doubtful origin. Yet to the believers, there's no stronger living proof of the Chosen One. Veronica uses this 'Holy Power bestowed by the Chosen One' to propagate to the whole world, convert the non-believers, and arrest those who have escaped the cult. Recently, reports of a new Chosen One Candidate, the Guardian Knight, engrosses her attention.
stories.necromancer:
Noxia is a necromancer girl who can summon spirits and create monsters from dead body parts.

She sees and communicates with dead souls with her innate power. She can summon monsters formed by 'fragments' she gathered all around the world. Noxia befriends everything that's lifeless and assigns them roles as if playing make-believe. Among them, a huge friend-a protective big daddy-always stands by Noxia.

In her childhood before she realized that her power was 'power', Noxia, who couldn't distinguish the living and the dead, befriended the latter. When other children played with dolls, Noxia 'created' dolls to play with. Adults were terrified to see Noxia create monsters from dead animal bodies and argued to banish Noxia, and even her parents turned their back against her. Even before turning 10 years old, Noxia left her hometown and started traveling around the world. Noxia feels most comfortable in a tomb or graveyard.

Noxia never learned how to express or feel emotions like normal people. Living among the dead made her facial expression and her voice aloof. Since almost every living person feared or abhorred her while the dead greeted her, it should be obvious for her to side with the dead. Although dealing with living people is always hard and unpleasant, she still admires the extravagant culture and sweet snacks created by them. Especially, the chocolate she saw in a store display in her childhood is truly the magnum opus to Noxia.
stories.alpaca_girl:
Mayreel is the god of harvest Kamael's divine beast, an alpaca with the power of grass and flowers. Usually, she tags along with Bari in her alpaca form, but she can change into human form.

She's a whiner who hates almost everything. She dislikes everyone, even including the god of harvest Kamael. She does appreciate that Kamael raised her with love and care, but she can't help rolling her eyes at  Kamael's relentless ""nagging"" at her. Kamael hopes Mayreel to look at him the way she twinkles her eyes at Bari, but Mayreel would rather spit out on the ground and demand him not to bother her. How sad it is for Kamael when there seems to be no end to Mayreel's rebellious phase.

Mayreel hates humans. She can never understand why Bari willingly helps those greedy humans; sometimes even consuming her own happy memories. There was a time when Mayreel used to like humans since anyone who set their eyes on Mayreel would immediately fall in love with her adorable figure. But a long time ago, some crowd of people abused Bari's compassion and wished for outrageous things wasting Bari's memory. If Mayreel did not punish them on time, Bari would have not even remembered Mayreel and Kamael. Since then Mayreel became wary of humans to protect Bari from the selfish species.

Mayreel hates her human form. She constantly whines about how it's uncomfortable and cumbersome to be in a human form, about how many customs she has to uphold. That's probably why she looks so annoyed and wears her priest outfit sloppily when Bari asks her to turn into her human form. Bari tidies up Mayreel's outfit whenever she can, but in a blink of a second Mayreel will untidy her clothes. Although she, certainly, is a handful, Bari stills love the way she is.
stories.mecha_android:
Mk.99 is the only surviving combat android unit at Heavenhold ever since they were mostly disposed of.

Combat androids were designed to support the Heroes defending Heavenhold. They can instantly exhaust their remaining power to commence heavy artillery strikes against the enemy. They are capable of free-flight but tend to avoid it at other locations except for Heavenhold to conserve power. Even their self-charging units can't meet the power demand. They have the least restrictions on their behavioral software, which enables them to make active decisions compared to worker androids. 

After Mk.2, one of the combat android units deployed by Heavenhold in the past, became corrupt and threatened Heavenhold’s safety, Android Association decided to dispose of all units and also stop the production. Mk.99, the youngest and the lowest rank among her fellow combat androids, was considered a ‘B-tier’ unit and became excluded from disposal. The Android Association finally woke her up from her long slumber after judging they can’t defend Heavenhold with just the Heros. Mk.99 may not be up to the specs of the combat androids from the past, but she is definitely the only one left. 

When Mk.99 was awakened, all Heavenhold’s androids were programmed with the Three Laws of Androids to prevent another Mk.2 fiasco.
-First, an android may not harm Heavenhold or, through inaction, allow it to come to harm. 
-Second, an android may ignore orders except where such orders would conflict with the First Law.
-Third, an android must protect the owner of the Champion’s Sword as long as such protection does not conflict with the First or Second Law.
Android Association expected the Second Law to give individuality to each android, but somehow they all ended up with 'lazy and dodging work as much as possible' personalities. Mk.99 was famous among androids for having the easiest job because she did not have to wake up at all until Heavenhold’s emergency protocol level 9 was in effect.
stories.demon_ceo:
Lilith is the Chief Leader of Demon World. 

She is a charismatic and wise ruler of the Demon World. A long time ago, when she adventured with the previous generation of warriors Kaden and Erina, her cold and calm tendencies made her an excellent comrade for the party. After finishing their adventure, she united the chaotic nation and made herself Queen with her stern and realistic features that make her a perfect leader.

Lilith is assisted by the Old Swordsman Erina. They met each other while Lilith was still a young child and Erina was still an active Warrior. The two of them have been taking care of each other for over hundreds of years as friends and annoying family. It’s obvious why Lilith worries about Erina since she has lived past the life expectancy of an average human, but Erina doesn’t pay no mind to Lilith’s nagging and usually wanders off somewhere. Lilith’s desk is rumored to be always neat and free of any objects, because she would end up tossing all them at Erina and breaking everything. However, when Erina is in a dire situation, Lilith would always show up to help. Albeit she nags and clicks her tongue when she arrives.

She is famous for taking care of herself. She maintains a strict diet and exercise regimen and is the founder of the famous “Morning Routine for the Success” in Demon World, consisting of waking up early morning, jogging, meditation, and cold showers. She abstains from eating sweets, so when she does, she only allows the best. Lilith is especially strict on the quality of cookies. If there’s one thing everyone isn’t aware of about perfect Lilith, it’s that she is in a constant battle against her less-perfect self. When she can’t win against her sloth every few decades, she uses low blood pressure as an excuse to get out of working out.
stories.lady_thief:
Lucy is a world-renowned criminal who puts fear into even the wealthiest man with the most powerful security systems.

She is a master of disguise, escape, misdirection and magic. If you thought you caught a glimpse of her, she’ll vanish. The moment you think she’s in your grasp, you’ll be empty-handed. Lucy is a genius in any knowledge or skills related to crimes. She is naturally talented in magic, gymnastics, and athletics. She also has doctorates in Medicine, Security, Psychology, and Alchemy. Each degree she earned has a different name written on them, though. She's known as the princess of crime among criminals, and lots of them uses her name out of admiration.

She only commits crimes for the fun and thrill. Her crimes' patterns and their severity fluctuate depending on her mood. If you can see her and she’s almost within your grasp, that means she wants to play. When she’s not in the mood, you would pass by without even noticing her or her criminal act. Lucy’s favorite part of committing a crime is the thrill, excitement, and chaos happening during the chase. Apparently, a just hero tenaciously chasing after her gives her the most fun. Using her fantastic wordplay to cloud the hero’s judgment and playing mind games is also an added bonus. Of course, just because she had fun, that doesn't mean she'll return the stolen items or money.

There’s very little known about Lucy. No one knows her exact age, her past, even whether the name ‘Lucy’ is her real name. Some people suggest Lucy became a trickster because of her troubled youth or the corruption in society, but she merely laughs at all these analyses. ‘It’s a grave mistake to think something other than me created my identity,’ she claims. She’s just having fun!

Despite being a criminal for her enjoyment, Lucy’s not great at making jokes. She wants to deliver a fitting joke during the act but always ends up delivering the punch line in the wrong way. Even if she comes up with something clever, her delivery usually ruins it. Lucy’s feelings get very hurt when the tension dies down from her bad delivery of jokes.
stories.surfer_sohee:
Sohee! The super-popular scientist, hitting the beaches this summer!

Sohee never forgot the taste of popularity she briefly enjoyed during her infiltration to Kanterbury high school for the Invader crystal investigation. So she went through a complete makeover based on her research on ‘popular women of the summer season’ to achieve it once again. She pushed ahead with her weight loss using her new diet machine involving electrical shock and rapid cooling. A fashionable swimsuit and custom-made contact lenses all set, which helped her lose the glasses, and now she's ready to bewitch all those on the beach! Her extremely well-working dieting machine continues to be denied a patent under safety issues, though.

She used her ‘try until you succeed’ stubbornness and learned how to surf despite her nearly non-existent athletic skills. Sohee is no longer a scientist cooped up in her room doing research and lacking vitamin D, but a strong and powerful one who can wield her modded Magiton Buster surfboard freely. Why would she swing her surfboard around on the beach, nobody knows. Sohee’s surfboard is equipped with a Magiton pack, and it quite frequently creates huge waves out of nowhere causing other surfers to wipe out. 

Sohee goes out to the beach to show off her makeover only to cause trouble. Ever since Sohee started going around so proudly, more people have been getting injured on the beach. Causes of injuries include: trying to hit on Sohee and getting beaten, being hit by her surfboard while taking a leisurely stroll on the beach, getting swept up by the waves while out surfing nearby, etc. Thanks to her, there are never enough lifeguards around at the beach. Whether Sohee achieved the popularity she wanted so much is unknown, because everyone is usually busy running away from her. Sohee herself seems to be very content with her makeover, so everything is fine except for those who get hurt while hanging around her.
stories.lifeguard_yuze:
Yuze! This summer, she's the lifeguard in charge of safety on the beach!

Upon hearing the news about rising injuries on the beach when it’s supposed to be a fun vacation spot during the sweltering summer, Succubus Adventurer Yuze took on the role of a lifeguard. Even when there aren’t any accidents happening, the sight of Yuze standing on the lifeguard tower overseeing the beach with binoculars makes it feels as if dangers in and out of the water disappear. If an accident really does happen, Yuze will rush to the scene. Whether they're on the sands, in the middle of the ocean, or deep underwater she always rescues those in danger. Yuze will not stop, no matter how sweaty or wet she gets! Thanks to her, people struck by 'someone' while on a stroll or swimmers flailing in the water because of a sudden grenade launched by 'someone' are able to make it to safety.

She uses her monster-handling skills and powerful grip as an adventurer to face off against the dangers without any hesitation, whether it's a shark or Sohee. Her specially enchanted lifebuoy aids those she rescues by giving them a speedy recovery with healing spells and makes suppressing threats easier with offensive spells. 

Yuze takes her role as a lifeguard with utmost seriousness, but can't just understand why she’s gathering more energy faster compared to when she streams her adventures on NewTube. The conclusion Yuze could come up with was: ‘the scenes of rescue are direr compared to adventuring on NewTube, so that’s why they must be more popular.’ There’s been a shortage of lifeguards on the beach ever since Sohee emerged, but when Yuze started volunteering as a lifeguard, more people recently started signing up for the task as well. Luckily, safety and danger on the beach now hold a frail balance, and the beach became an enjoyable vacation spot for many once again.
stories.eleanor:
Eleanor is one of the supreme heavenly deities who used to supervise the world. 

She’s the goddess of wealth and prosperity. Eleanor is fated to earn money even if she stays idle. Her fate allowed her to become a root-like figure in Heaven’s financial matters, but it also caused Heaven's finance to be irreparably damaged the moment Eleanor left Heaven after the World Tree lost its power. Heaven still hasn’t overcome this recession, and Angie the angel, who happened to be appointed as the Secretary of the Heaven Treasury, is hard at work to pay off Heaven’s debt. But Eleanor herself is not aware and unwilling to aid in Heaven’s financial matters. 

She’s also the goddess of art with refined tastes. Eleanor enjoys epic poetry, classical music and is also a skilled harp player. Melodies from her harp are told to soothe the hearts of warriors. The only issue is that warriors who hear her music become too drunk on her melodies and lower their guards too much. Her favorite events are concerts where she’s the main performer. She doesn’t consider an event unless the stage design, lights, and outfits of every performer are top quality. 

Eleanor is an indecisive loafer who wants to just spend her money lounging around and not deal with any important matters. Eleanor does not or want to think deeply about any serious issues. She can just ignore them. Thanks to this, she easily obeys and adjusts to any environment. According to her, change requires difficult work with a low chance of success, and most of all irritating. It's told that Eleanor did have hopes and dreams about leading the world in a better direction as a supreme goddess from Heaven and worked towards her goals. But, repeated failures made her give up slowly as time progressed. Now, Eleanor only focuses on matters that don’t require focus or any work and runs away from important matters or problems in disgust.
stories.fire_harpy:
Scintilla is from the family of Harpies, the flame elementals who possessed the throne of elemental king for many generations.

She’s a harpy from the land of flames. Most harpies are born with frail thin bodies. Due to the laws of homeostasis, harpies can’t strengthen their bodies through training. However, Scintilla’s hard work surpassed this limit and changed her nature. She's the first muscular harpy in existence, who ventured into the human world with a yearning to have a stronger and more powerful body. During her travels in Desert Kingdom, she ran into Marvin and started to idolize him. 

She’s an excellent physical martial artist, and her specialty is kicking. Scintilla’s been going around the human world and learning more martial arts. After seeing the Super Thunder Lightning Kick of the two fairies from the east, she set a goal to find a muscular comrade and create an ultimate move just like them. 

Scintilla’s addicted to training. She’s a passionate exercise maniac, obsessing over her muscles. She worries about losing gains the minute she stops training, and uses daily activities as a way to train. Scintilla loves any type of training that’s enough to be a challenge. She came to the human world for the same reason. She believes the unpredictable nature of the human world makes it the true training ground. Nothing’s impossible for Scintilla. She’ll try until she succeeds! Scintilla is prepared to do anything through her burning passion and will like an undying flame.
stories.legendary_hero:
Erina is the legendary hero, Lilith’s knight and Demon World’s Chief of National Security.

She’s usually in the form of an elderly woman, but she can temporarily awaken back into her younger self. Erina’s still an experienced and powerful warrior in her older form as well, but she will gather her strengths in a pinch to regain and use her abilities from her glory days. However, returning back to her younger form requires a large amount of energy. When she reverts back, her memory and strengths become faint, and she needs a long recovery period afterwards.

Erina is a living legend, whose name would show up every so often in history books for almost 1500 years. Numerous poems recite her victories, but the most famous is how she defeated all four demon gods and sealed them within herself. The demon gods' mana she held onto changed her body to surpass average physical human capabilities, and allowed her to continue adventuring for an impossibly long period. However, even the legendary hero couldn’t withstand time, and turned into an old woman after 1500 years passed. Now she is an elderly woman, who's forgetful and sometimes goes in a daze.

Erina's passion and spirit of Hero faded over time and now she thinks and acts in a more practical, detached manner. She realized centuries of time will take away her loved ones, comrades, and even her cause. Therefore, she follows rules instead of kindness and focuses on adventuring alone instead of with comrades. Lilith, her longtime companion who’s almost like family, is the exception to this rule. Lilith might not agree with this, since Erina's silent, wilful attitude drives her crazy almost every day.
stories.kamael:
Kamael is the God of Harvest supervising the fauna and flora through the powers of the earth and life itself.

He is a god serving under Prometheia and performs the tasks of reviving the World Tree. Kamael was once a great wizard with powerful mana. He became a deity after being blessed with divine powers by Prometheia when she needed a lower god to manage the World Tree. Kamael’s current top priority is restoring the burnt World Tree. He will cut down anyone, human or deity threatening it.

Kamael is the founder of the mega corporation, Kamazon. Kamazon is an online shopping mall that receives orders and ships products using drones. It was founded to achieve Kamael’s goal to obtain the world’s greatest financial power. His business tactics are severely aggressive. He is infamous in the business for taking down his competitors and removing the thinking circuit of ‘An android can ignore an order it does not like’ on the ones he hired. Kamael’s been buying the ruins of the World Tree with the money he earned from Kamazon. It seemed Kamael searched for clues to restore the World Tree himself, but for some reason he completely halted all investigations. He built and opened a part of the ruins into the Kama-ZONE theme park. Kama-ZONE is famous for having numerous mystical artifacts and even now, groups conducting investigations within the closed off areas of Kama-ZONE are seen from time to time. After the investigation groups disappear, the area goes under maintenance and becomes a new area for Kama-ZONE. 

He may be a cold and infamous CEO of a mega corporation, but he’s warm hearted towards Bari and Mayreel. He considers the two disciples he lovingly raised like his own children, but his love rarely gets reciprocated like all other parents. Mayreel is especially annoyed of Kamael's attention and it often causes him to get a bit mopey. Despite worrying about Bari and Mayreel, Kamael always sends his two disciples on far away journeys. Whether it's to restore the World Tree, or to hide his life as a corporate man, is unknown.
stories.villain_android:
Mk.2 is an ex-Heavenhold combat android. She’s gained her freedom and now has no master.

Mk.2 leads the infamous android crime gang, ‘Turing’. She gathered abandoned androids in Demon World and formed the gang. She committed numerous crimes and hurt many for the excuse of 'just following orders' to be valid. However, she was freed from her previous master manipulating her through control codes, and became her own self. It seems she left her life of crime behind after being freed. Mk.2 got rid of her stuffy suit and neat hair. She now looks happier and freer than ever, as she rides her bike down the night streets with her gang. 

A long time ago, Mk.2 was a combat android of Heavenhold. She opposed the engineers' unethical attitude of indiscriminately disposing of androids. Heavenhold’s technology at the time was so advanced that it was more efficient to build a new android instead of fixing a broken one. Mk.2 awakened the disposed androids to incite a rebellion, but it was subdued through an intense battle.
She barely escaped Heavenhold alone, and took refuge in Demon World. After this incident, the engineers of Heavenhold added another rule to the Laws of Androids which frees androids to ignore certain orders as their will in order to improve the android disposal process.

After she arrived in Demon World, Mk.2 briefly worked as an aid for the police department’s detective Odile. Odile’s colleagues simply considered Mk.2 as a tool to be used in dangerous situations. They even once lured Mk.2 upto the roof of a high building for an 'important mission' and pushed her off as a durability test. From this incident Mk.2 had to replace 31 parts in her body. Odile advised her claiming “the responsibility falls to one being fooled for such an obvious trick” to teach her a lesson, but Mk.2 harbored deep resentment from Odile’s advice instead. Even as a freed android, Mk.2 still holds deep hatred towards Odile.
stories.mercenary:
Orca is a Warlord Mercenary who always shows up in areas with large conflict.

She is a firm believer in money and power. To Orca, it’s natural for the powerful and wealthy to dominate over the weak, and taking down stronger foes is a must for taking a higher position. Orca is determined to be on top of this food chain, and she will pay any cost to do so. Any job worth money must be taken, and she can sleep when she’s dead. Orca’s completely addicted to stimulants like energy drinks and coffee. Due to her lack of sleep, she’s constantly exhausted and irritable, but her determination to become an ‘apex predator’ never wavers.

However, she completely abandoned social norms, customs and responsibility. To Orca, ‘those things aren’t worth any money or fun’. Many subordinates follow Orca for her skill and high success rates on jobs, but Orca herself doesn’t manage, take care of or trust them. She just gathers people for fun when she feels like it, then neglects them from losing interest.

Recently, Orca was hired by the Invaders attacking Adela, and fought a great battle against the kingdom’s navy. Marina, Adela’s Grand Admiral, fought against Orca in the battle. The tense battle resulted in Orca taking Marina’s eye, while she took Orca’s arm. This is why Marina wears an eye patch on her left eye, while Orca has a prosthetic left arm. Orca obsesses over Marina, who cut off her arm, because she believes she’s the only one worthy and capable of killing Marina. After hearing the news about Marina staying in Heavenhold, Orca headed there herself while looking forward to the moment she finally kills her nemesis and becomes more powerful.
stories.white_druid:
Kanna is a rare white tiger anthromorph among the already rare tiger anthromorphs. Tiger anthromorphs are born in their tiger form. When they begin to realize their abilities, they can change freely between their tiger and human forms at will. Kanna also had a hard time changing into her human form at first, but she can now change freely from practicing. She can even transform only certain body parts as well. Kanna usually stays as a tiger, but she fell in love with using human objects after coming to Heavenhold. Now she stays in her human form instead. 

She’s Kang’s older sister, and loves her little brother very much. There are only a few Tiger anthromorphs, and they have strong family bonds. However, Kanna’s love for Kang is quite eccentric even for the rare white tiger anthromorphs. Kanna taught her little brother how to take his first steps and guided him on his first hunt. She came to Heavenhold because Kang had followed the Knight there first. She’s always watching Kang from a distance, but rarely intervenes. She believes personal growth can only be achieved by overcoming threats. 

Kanna calls herself an exceptional Druid, but everyone else seems to think differently. Everyone rather believes the title of ‘Super Anthromorph’ is more fitting because of her amazing grip strength. She loves animals and plants. Despite Kanna’s love, all the animals are afraid of her and the plants she raises end up wilting. Kanna severely injured a cute puppy by accident from petting it. After the incident, she claims she can only watch the cute and lovely animals from afar and does so. Kanna still calls herself a ‘Druid’ because of her ability to tame predators. No matter how ferocious, a loving and ‘powerful’ embrace from Kanna turns them into gentle lambs. Everyone can tell Kanna’s strength is what definitely makes the predators submit. But no one has objected to Kanna’s claim that she's a Druid because she can transform freely from beast and human form and tame predators.
stories.hana:
Hana is a Grim Reaper, who guides the souls of the deceased to the right path.

Due to her clumsy personality and unlucky nature, everything she did usually ended up in disaster. Hana didn’t have much luck in life as well. It was safe to say everything she did proactively would end up in failure. Because of this, Hana is still afraid to act even as an employee of After World Inc.

Hana works hard as a Grim Reaper, but thanks to her mistakes she’s not coming up with results. Her mistakes and bad luck mount up to making the matters worse instead. Her performance review is rock bottom and Hana’s been branded as a useless Grim Reaper in the company.

When Hana was alive, people around her would suddenly end up dead to the point of arousing suspicion. Some just considered it as superstition, but those who became close to Hana all ended up dying after a while. As these incidents continued, the villagers left Hana one by one, and soon Hana was all alone. This left a deep mark within Hana’s soul, and she started getting scared of becoming closer to other spirits.

Spirits who leave strong resentment and regret in life lose all of their memories when coming to the After World. The spirits who lost their memories end up wandering the nether or become Grim Reapers in the After World. 

Through some event, some Grim Reapers regain their memories and solve their resentments and regrets to be reborn, but these cases are very rare. Most end up working for eternity. Through this process, Grim Reapers are growing in numbers, but because the population is growing faster, After World Inc is constantly needing more manpower.
stories.captain_rabbit:
Carol is the elemental of light tasked with protecting Christmas.

Light elementals send in forces to fight off demons crossing over from another dimension that attempt to take over Christmas every year.Carol is that elemental force’s commander. Her wish and joy is to safely complete her mission so people can spend a merry Christmas. After Christmas is over, she returns with her men and trains diligently to prepare for the next one. Carol’s forces are famous for training a lot, but her men stay infinitely loyal to their bright and joyful commander. She’s so popular there’s even a fanclub of her.

Carol’s elegant swordsmanship is also a contributor to her popularity. According to one of the soldiers who trained with her, she gracefully deflects the enemy’s attack before overpowering her foe. It almost looks like a beautiful dance performance is taking place. 

The only flaw to the seemingly perfect Carol is her atrocious fashion sense. She once left her base in civilian clothing, but her outfit ended up being chosen for ‘Worst Fashion of the Year’ on the elemental magazine. Carol fell into severe shock, and started to get fashion advice or outfit recommendations from her peers to broaden her horizons. Sometimes she goes into battle wearing the outfit her men recommended her. Everytime she does, her troop’s morale skyrockets. Carol’s confidence and passion about fashion is growing daily, thanks to her men’s enthusiasm. On her days off, Carol sneaks out to research fashion from the human world. Recently, she was deeply inspired by Mayreel’s fashion of wearing her priest outfit sloppily.
stories.saintess:
Clara is the Chosen One’s Saintess.

She calls Veronica Archpriestess older sister, while following her faithfully. The close relationship and religious life they share serves as an example for other ordinary followers. However, the true nature of their relationship is complete master and servant. Clara only acts under Veronica’s orders. Clara’s consciousness has completely disintegrated for unknown reasons. Her only joy and meaning in life now is to follow Veronica’s will and serve the Chosen One.

Clara is the Chosen One’s Saintess and ‘Weapon’. She’s at the head of missionary activities. These activities involve delivering judgment upon those who go against the Chosen One’s will. Once Veronica gives the order, Clara uses her power from an unknown origin to punish the nonbelievers. Clara sometimes gets consumed by madness and loses control. This results in her indiscriminately dealing great damage to both friend and foe. However, Veronica doesn’t mind any of this, and calls it the ‘miracle of the Chosen One’. Therefore, Clara is secretly treated like a ticking time bomb by the others.
Of course, there are those who worship this power. There will always be admirers of an enormous power, especially when people are losing hope from an outside force’s invasion. Clara’s activities under the name of Saintess have left a deep impression on many. It also reminded them of the forgotten memories of the Saintess who existed 500 years ago. And converted many into the Chosen One. Many neighboring nations, and other organizations that haven't lost bureaucratic capabilities are weary of the Chosen One’s expansion. However, the fear of the Saintess’ power is stopping them from taking measures.

Opinions about Clara’s first public and official appearance differ, but most agree that she came after the Chosen One’s 3rd expedition. The expedition involved Veronica and her direct disciples traveling to the edge of the continent in search of the Chosen One’s traces. The followers consider it as one of the riskiest since the Chosen One’s founding, and one that placed the organization’s existence on the line. There was an enormous explosion that could have wiped the area clean off the map during the expedition. But, only Veronica and an unknown female disciple led by her hand returned from the gruesome scene. Since that day, faint screaming resembling someone being horrifically tortured can be heard from the depths of the Chosen One’s temple. Some can sense excessive amounts of regeneration magic coming from Clara, but no one dares to question if there’s a correlation between the two.
stories.parvati:
Parvati is the model employee of the unofficial post facto clean up team of Kamazon. 

The unofficial post facto clean up team takes out those who threaten or get in Kamazon’s way. Parvati always maintains top performance within the organization full of various assassins. Kamazon views Parvati favorably as well due to her obedience towards superiors and her capability to swiftly take out any target. Some areas fell into complete pandemonium due to her superior abilities. However Parvati herself is unaware she’s the cause behind the chaos.

There’s a sole reason Parvati got a job at Kamazon after being trained under her father with her younger sister at a young age. It was her father’s dying wish for Parvati to live an ordinary life and get hired by an ordinary company. She believed getting employed at the famous Kamazon meant living an ordinary life, so she kept applying. But the world wasn’t her oyster. After being rejected interview after interview, she finally got hired through a recommendation to a department that suited her skillset.

Now that she’s finally achieved her father’s dying wish, Parvati completely believes she’s an ordinary employee like everyone else. And she doesn’t doubt it at all. Because her job requires her to move from place to place, she gets really annoyed from moving constantly. Her only hobby is seeking out new local delicacies when she moves into a new town. Parvati’s life is satisfactory in all aspects, but her one wish is for Tinia, her younger sister, to live an ordinary life just like her.
stories.lina:
Lina Inverse is a Sorceress from Zepheel city, Zephilia Kingdom’s capital.

Lina succeeded in reading the magical Claire Bible. She also defeated powerful enemies like Hellmaster Fibrizo at the end of her long adventure with her past comrades. However, she fell into a mysterious dimensional rift at the last moment and landed on Kanterbury Kingdom with her party.

Lina uses her motto “villains don’t have rights” to take down numerous robbers and take their valuables. Lina’s known to tenaciously hunt robbers because she combined her hobby with practical benefits. Her infamy spread to earn the title of ‘Robbers’ Killer’, and she never lets anything slide. Most robbers lose their will to fight after hearing the name ‘Lina Inverse’.

She’s a tremendous glutton, and eats so much that she stacks a tall pile of plates after each meal. Even Amelia expresses concern over Lina’s food bills despite being a princess. Lina especially loves meat dishes, and does not hesitate over putting in effort or costs to eat delicacies and rare dishes.

Lina’s Demon’s Blood Talisman is a magical item that amplifies mana by borrowing the powers of the Demon Kings of the four planes: Ruby Eye, Dark Star, Chaotic Blue, and Death Fog. This talisman was originally owned by Xellos, but Lina half-force purchased the talisman from him and now wears it instead. Lina uses the Demon’s Blood Talisman to cast black magic like Ranga Blade that can’t be done by ordinary human’s mana.
stories.gourry:
Gourry Gabriev is a descendant of the warrior who slayed the chimera Zanaffar. He’s a skilled swordsman who has no match among humans.

Gourry has looks that would make anyone’s head turn, but his intelligence is slightly lacking in contrast to his appearance. If a topic becomes even slightly complex, he fails to understand it. Gourry also doesn’t know common sense that even a child might have. However, he still remembers every little detail about Lina. 

Gourry’s a great glutton, but doesn’t like bitter foods like bell peppers and coffee. Even if a bell pepper is diced into little pieces and mixed in with other ingredients, he can pick them out with inhuman ability.

Gorun Nova, the Sword of Light, is the Gabriev family sword passed down for generations. It has the ability to change one’s willpower into a blade of light. It’s an amazing sword with an ability to deflect magic or absorb it. The sword can even channel powerful magic like Dragon Slave or Giga Slave. Lina Inverse covets this sword of light, but Gourry has managed to keep it from her clutches for now and is still using it.
stories.xellos:
Xellos introduces himself as the mystery priest, but he’s actually a high-ranking mazoku. He serves under one of the five subordinates, the Greater Beast.

Like his self introduction he’s a figure veiled in mystery. Many have attempted to figure out his identity and intentions, but the only response they got from him was “that’s a secret”.

Xellos uses negative emotions of life forms like fear, hate and depression as nourishment just like other mazoku. He extremely detests positive emotions such as love, and friendship.

Xellos is known to be the most powerful mazoku excluding the 5 subordinates. He exterminated thousands of dragons during the Koma War in the past. Due to this incident, Xellos is a feared entity among the elves and dragons.
stories.half_vampire:
Priscilla’s a half vampire  born under Demonshire’s governor Count Claude, and a noble demon mother. All eyes fell on her when she was born, for Priscilla’s birth was the joining of two historic houses within Demon World. Priscilla was born with powerful magic and inherited traits from both houses.

Priscilla’s escape is the only known case of escaping the curse of the Demon God manifestation. Bellial’s manifestation only occurs to demons who inherited the blood of a Demon God. When a Demon God dies, they don’t get completely eliminated. Instead, a Demon God will possess a demon who inherited his own blood. And begin to sap away his or her mana to recover. Once the Demon God fully recovers, its revival will be complete. Due to the nature of mana absorption, the Demon God’s curse usually falls on demons born with great magical power.

Demons feared the Demon God’s revival would plunge Demon World back into war and terror. They stopped his manifestation by removing the host before his revival could be completed. Laws related to Bellial’s manifestation were top priority, and demons possessed by him would be killed regardless of social status. After the battle continued over 300 years, Bellial’s manifestation seemingly vanished from Demon World. 

But one day, as fate would have it, Bellial’s manifestation emerged within Priscilla’s mother Iris.Claude and Iris joined their powers in an attempt to prevent Bellial’s manifestation. However, it was not enough, and the symptoms couldn’t be kept secret anymore. Knowing it would endanger her and her baby’s life if other citizens found out about  Bellial’s manifestation, Iris ended her own life. However, as if to insult Iris’ sacrifice, Bellial reached his hand out towards Iris’ daughter Priscilla. When the manifestation emerged within Priscilla, Count Claude knew he would lose his daughter like he lost his wife. He desperately searched for a way to save Priscilla. Even if that meant he would be trapped in an infinite time loop…

Bellial’s energy seeping into Priscilla vanished thanks to Count Claude’s sacrifice. Priscilla lost both parents because of Bellial and was greeted with Demonshire fallen into chaos after it lost its governor. Since she couldn’t let her parents’ beloved city fall into chaos, she stepped up as the new governor. Both the Elite Royal Guard captain, and assistant, who stayed loyal to the Count, stayed by her side. All demons and vampires bowed to the mix-blooded girl who had inherited both bloodlines. It was a peaceful succession.

Priscilla still had lots to learn as governor, but she’s working diligently to be a great leader like her father. To get rid of  her old introverted appearance, Priscilla sets time aside to come up with charismatic lines by working with the assistant or shouts tough-sounding names for skills with the Elite Royal Guard Captain. Despite her inexperience, the office staff treasure the new, young governor, for her passion to fill her father’s shoes. 

Meanwhile, it’s not just the staff members who affectionately pay attention to the young governor. Priscilla became a star politician from this incident, and now is the hot topic for every citizen within Demonshire. The type of hand cream she uses when going out, the book she reads before bed, and other things she does gets the spotlight. The most popular gossip is ‘whether Priscilla drinks blood or not.’ It’s obvious Priscilla drinks blood from her vampire heritage. She especially loves the blood dishes made with Count Claude’s recipes.
stories.vampire_lord:
Count Claude is the governor of Demonshire.

Claude achieved the seemingly impossible unity within demon and vampire societies. Demons and vampires suddenly had to live under the same roof after the Demon World’s unification war 500 years ago. They couldn’t accept each other’s differences and conflict started to brew. As conflict and hate was about to swallow up Demonshire, Claude emerged and intervened. He promised prosperity and harmony between the two species, and married Iris, a noble demon family’s daughter. The union between these two symbolized unity within Demonshire. Claude gained wholehearted support from Demonshire’s citizens and became its leader. Some claimed the union between Claude and Iris was an emotionless arranged marriage, but Claude’s love towards Iris was true. Claude didn’t show it, but he deeply loved the companionship, and the little world they made together. Because of that, Claude stepped into eternity. Even a shred of hope was enough. If he could protect his loving daughter Priscilla, the treasure his wife left behind.

In Priscilla’s memories, Claude is remembered as a cold and quiet father, but he treasured her. All the letters Priscilla wrote to Claude when she was young are stored under high security and within his reach. The letters kept his resolve while Claude went through the painful loops.

Claude’s a powerful being who lived for a long period, to the point he can call Lilith a milk-drinker. He’s a pure-blooded vampire born with great mana. The experience he gathered from his long life makes his power at the summit for a single species. Turning back time using the artificial sun’s explosion was only possible because the caster was Claude. 

Just like other vampires, Claude also drinks blood. Many worry or expect Claude to bite the victim’s neck while drinking blood since he’s a pure-blooded vampire, but he actually prefers drinking refined blood like blood packs. It’s because he believes a willingly given tribute is more valuable than blood taken forcefully.


Claude’s the author of the cook book, ‘100 ways to enjoy blood’. This is the result of him researching a way to feed blood to Priscilla, who felt urges to drink blood but didn’t like consuming it. The Count family’s refined blood dishes are all made with the Count’s recipes.The recipes are delicious, but the cooking process is severely particular. Due to this, many cooks within the Count’s family quit after a short period despite being treated well.
stories.sea_witch:
Ara is the wish granting Sea Witch. She was sealed away by Garam and Nari in the past, but broke free after the seal weakened from an unknown reason. 

Ara uses her magic to grant the contractee’s wish. However, the wish usually gets granted in a twisted way, and it eventually leads to the contractee’s demise. Despite this, those blinded by their wishes still seek out Ara and tragedy repeats itself. As damages began to mount uncontrollably, those with the will to do so, set out to take Ara down. However, Ara gained copious amount of power and magic. So even the most famous sages failed to take her down. Had Ara not paraded her power and came upto land, Garam and Nari might have failed as well. Due to this, she holds resentment towards Garam and Nari. She’s plotting her revenge and swears she’ll decorate her room with fox pelts by skinning Garam and Nari. Ara was defeated once, but she considers Garam and Nari’s personal skills to be way below hers. She just thinks she was caught off guard. Ara boasts she’ll win if they fought again. 

The contract between Ara is established by offering her tribute. The type of tribute is decided by what Ara wants at the moment, and it’s usually something precious to the contractee. Ara has a hobby of collecting beautiful and luxurious items, so she sometimes asks for simple luxury items. At times, she asks for a tribute that’s too expensive compared to the wish. Luckily, the contractee gives up and returns. All of the collected treasure is hidden within Ara’s mansion deep in the sea’s depths. Since her collection was gathered from a long time ago, it rivals that of the Rah Empire. A few brave souls who heard the rumor jump into the sea, but only bubbles returned to the surface. 

In truth, Ara doesn’t intentionally twist the contractee’s wish to cause them pain. She wholeheartedly grants the contractee’s wish, but just doesn’t recognize her methods to be wrong. Ara is a separate entity from humans, so she doesn’t properly understand the values, and morals of the Human World. 

Her impatient personality and over confidence makes her assume and make conclusions too quickly. Ara still thinks the attempts to take her down were caused by everyone being jealous of her. When she realizes she made a mistake, Ara gets severely embarassed. Ara thinks this tarnishes her perfect image and tries her best to act natural. Her human part plays it off very well, but her tentacles respond like a puppy’s tail to emtions and gives away her being flustered.

Like an octopus, she has superb regeneration. Both her human and octopus parts are the main body, so she can regenerate whichever part that gets destroyed. The regeneration usually takes place at the one that has more left, but the regeneration site is upto Ara’s will. It’s  unknown about how the unregenerated part gets processed.
stories.sheep_girl:
Rey is the leader of the werebeast organization, ‘Tooth and Fang’. 

‘Tooth and Fang’ is an organization with the goal of founding a nation for werebeasts so they won’t face discrimination. Early on, the organization had radical ideologies and chose to use the most extreme and violent methods possible for their goals. Rey became its leader as ‘Tooth and Fang’ was about to be marked as an armed group by the people. Rey’s first order as leader was to have everyone hide their tooth and fang for a while. As the werebeasts lowered their aggression and melded into society, people started to lower their guard around the Tooth and Fang. Now, they’re known as a skilled craftsmen organization or volunteer organization instead. However,It was as if everyone didn’t lower their weary gaze. Suspicions about whether Tooth and Fang had connections to a large, underground organization started to grow. An article about someone witnessing Rey contacting a mysterious girl using forbidden necromancy was published, and the press agency closed overnight. The witness never came forward so there was no way to uncover the truth.

Rey thinks of all werebeasts following her as family. At first glance, her actions seem thoughtless, but all of them are guided by her love for her family. After she accepts someone as family, Rey believes the family member no matter what, and this causes concern for her subordinates. However, because of her unconditional trust, many werebeasts stay true to Rey and follow her as well.

Rey frequently cuts her rapidly growing hair, and has a hobby of knitting clothes from it. She even gifts the knitted clothing if she’s in a good mood. The clothing Rey made with her own hair is high quality and well designed. Since it’s a rare item that everyone can’t get, the clothing that somehow made it to the markets are sold for an exorbitant price among fans. Due to her talents, she wanted to become a fashion designer as a young girl. However, Rey was rejected from art school every time for being a werebeast. This memory is the worst among the countless discrimination Rey has faced, and it is rooted deeply in her mind.

She’s having an especially hard time because of the Innuit from Mt.Shivering. Many consider Innuits as werebeasts because of their appearance, but they’re actually different species. The key difference is that werebeasts can transform into an animal form, but Innuits can not. However, it’s rare to see a werebeast transform into their animal form in human society. Few Innuits take advantage of this to gain profits by disguising themselves as werewolves. Even werebeasts have a hard time telling werewolves and Innuits apart. Due to this, damages from impersonations are happening constantly. Rey is dealing with numerous woes from the positive image about werebeasts that took hard work to establish is being tarnished.
stories.summer_android:
The AA from AA72 stands for Amusement Android. Unlike the standard MK series, this new android is specialized for entertainment and games.

The new AA android series was designed to feel a sense of accomplishment after performing their specialized functions and duties. This was done to improve the common personality traits androids have of not wanting to work. In AA72’s case, she’s loaded with a fireworks feature to decorate the summer vacation’s finale to entertain the user.

AA72 lost her will to live from not receiving any orders until summer arrived. Since AA72 was specialized for summer vacations, this was obvious. However, AA72 didn’t get a proper hand-off of her duties during her release. She mistook her absence of orders for her being useless. AA72 considered herself as trash and headed to the trash can at the beach near Heavenhold. That’s where she met Lifeguard Yuze. AA72 figured out her misunderstanding and learned about herself. Along with her newly formed memories, she also earned the name Stella. AA72 took a liking to her new name, and always adds her custom name Stella whenever she introduces herself.

Due to her trauma caused by concerns about being disposed of, AA72 gets anxious if she doesn’t get any orders. When she doesn’t get any orders, AA72 approaches her user with a hopeful look of receiving some while appealing her features. The other androids do not understand her. They feel envy towards AA72 getting to rest year-round after launching fireworks once. Mk.99, who’s particularly busy from battling, recently got caught changing her label to AA.99.

AA72 constantly searches for work to prove that she’s needed. She usually helps Yuze in protecting the beach or runs errands for Loraine. If it’s helping others, she usually accepts even if the request is slightly overbearing. She even accepts Sohee and Marianne’s request of being a subject for experiments. Thanks to Heavenhold’s residents’ reports and Loraine’s vigilant watch, the experiments were stopped. However, after the incident, Loraine became tired and halted all production of the AA series, claiming the Mk series is better.
stories.summer_loraine:
Loraine, the innkeeper who’ll gift everyone unforgettable memories this summer!

She works without rest and always greets adventurers with a mysterious smile. Loraine never shows it, but even she wants to take a break without having a worry in the world. There just wasn’t any available time for her. 

Loraine finally decided to go on vacation she’d been putting off for years, and she built an amusement android that only existed in a blueprint for the first time. That’s how a specialized android AA72, different from the MK series tasked with battle or housework came to be. Loraine was so touched from how the AA series would actively search out tasks. She ordered a specially made swimsuit from Kamazon for it to wear.

When AA72 disappeared on the beach, Loraine lost her usual composure and became quite flustered. An android running away was unprecedented. On top of that, a cooling device, which was AA72’s major component, had gotten loose. She immediately sent androids to search the beach, and even asked for help from the lifeguard. Loraine didn’t expect the lifeguard would run away with AA72.

After she returned to Heavenhold from vacation, Loraine first established a duty hand-off procedure for androids. Various improvements in different fields, such as enhanced hand-off procedures, additional monitoring systems, and duty confirmation systems were added to prevent similar incidents from occurring. Some androids complained about how their vacation made more troublesome tasks, but all of them fell silent after they had a meeting with Loraine.

This year’s ‘Summer Focus’ picked Loraine as ‘The top hottest trending woman’. Sohee caused a scene asking why she wasn’t picked for 1st place while Loraine said such rankings are meaningless. According to a testimony from a maid android, she found a mysterious album in Loraine’s room. The Focus special article about Loraine is preciously placed within the album.
stories.party_mad_panda:
Mercenary, on-call service, and party! Where there's money there's the Mad Panda Trio!

Mad Panda Trio’s leader Scarlet was put into a convent in her youth. 
When her father said, ‘you’re a nice girl, so you’ll understand, right’ she just nodded. Scarlet always endured to be the nice child. All Scarlet wanted was a bit of kindness from others, but all she got was bullying from other kids and the disapproval from the nun. One day a merchant notorious for his rude attitude visited the convent for business. The merchant was abhorred by others for his reputation to make everyone's lives miserable if it meant him gaining profit. However, when it was time for the merchant to leave the convent, everyone treated him with the utmost kindness. Scarlet asked the merchant how he managed to earn everyone's kindness. The merchant answered with a smile. Whatever your form or shape, as long as you have money everyone will be kind to you. After hearing his words, Scarlet fled the convent that night.

Red Panda, unlike his foul mouth, likes to boast about his heroic saga. With his captivating tales one can't help but listen until the end. During his time as a storyteller before joining the Trio, he even had fans following him around. Red Panda always talks about his past, but it changes every single time. So it is not clear what he actually did in the past. No one is sure whether his outlandish name is his real name or not. Yet, what never seems to change is that he retired after getting an arrow to the knee and that he absolutely loves his Trio comrades.

Daniel, a.k.a Danny, was once such a brilliant child that he was granted early admission into the kingdom’s university. At the time, this was big news within Kanterbury. The parenting diary of Daniel’s parents even became a best-seller all over the kingdom. Unlike his parents who were quite satisfied with the fame, Daniel grew tired of the attention.Then one day, Daniel passed out from a fever. After days of turmoil, Daniel finally woke up. However, having suffered from the fever, Daniel was no longer the brilliant child he once was.The world quickly lost interest in dumb Danny and the attention of Danny’s parents shifted to their second-born. So that is how Daniel became forgotten. No one hardly noticed, when he disappeared one day after a red-haired woman’s visit to the mansion.

There is no record of how the three met and came to be known as the Mad Panda Trio. Nonetheless, in their search high and low for ways to make cash, they formed a family-like bond trusting and depending on each other like no other.

Where there’s money, you’d best be sure that the Mad Panda Trio are on their way. Indeed, they were one of the firsts to gain info of a special party to be held at Heavenhold. Obviously, the Mad Panda Trio figured rich customers would attend the luxurious party filled with glamorous decorations and a magnificent feast. Prepared to strike it rich, they attended the party. Although they managed to earn a lavish prize amongst determined competitors, somehow the Mad Panda Trio seem to be continuing their poor mercenary lives. The prize they earned after all that effort is just collecting dust, being used as a bookend.
stories.ms_chrome:
Miss Chrom is the executive of the crime syndicate ‘Reservoir Snakes’.

Miss Chrom joined the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ only a few years ago. It was when the syndicate was competing with others to expand their powers within the Rah Empire. At the time, Miss Chrom was a grunt of a rival gang of the ‘Reservoir Snakes’. One day, she contacted the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ and made them an offer. If they wanted the Rah Empire, make her an executive. The syndicate’s other members all claimed she was a mole and suggested taking her out. However, the boss ‘Great Grandma’ was intrigued by Miss Chrom’s boldness. The Great Grandma gave her a one-year opportunity, under the condition a single failure would result in her death.

Miss Chrom joined the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ and immediately expanded the syndicate’s business. Not just weapons smuggling, but instigations, interferences, and assassinations. No matter how dirty the job, it would be done if the price was right. Thereafter, Miss Chrom contacted the Rah Empire’s powerful individuals such as the wealthy, nobility and imperial families. Even those who were weary at first soon became charmed by Miss Chrom’s silver tongue, and in no time jobs for the syndicate grew. As the syndicate’s influence over the empire continued to grow, Miss Chrom started to eliminate competitors. A few resisted, but they were no match against the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ which had already formed a tight relationship with the Rah Empire’s corrupt power class. Miss Chrom turned the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ into the largest secret syndicate in the Rah Empire within 1 year.

Having been recognized by ‘the Great Grandma’ for her remarkable performance at the empire, Miss Chrom was entitled as the ninth executive of Reservoir Snakes. As if she waited for this precise moment, Miss Chrom immediately began to get rid of the nuisances scattered within the organization. The most famous episode related to Miss Chrom, is where she once turned the affair of being exposed for weapon smuggling into receiving a medal of honor for services of public security. It is told that even the Great Grandma grinned with satisfaction. Acknowledged for her contributions from then on, she was put in charge of coordinating the syndicate’s tactics.

Miss Chrom feels extreme pleasure and satisfaction when her carefully laid plans fall perfectly into place without error. On the other hand, her plans going awry is her biggest disdain. She eliminates anyone who messes up her plan with unpredictable behavior regardless of whether they are friend or foe. Indeed, the death toll of disobeying orders is higher than that of syndicate operations. Due to this fact, the agenda that Miss Chrom should be submitted to disciplinary action arose within the syndicate. However, as the number of members executed for disobedience has been proven to be lower than the expected casualties for the operation, such opinion has been put to rest. 

Miss Chrom isn’t satisfied just being No. 9. Reservoir Snakes is just a stepping stone for her to reach even greater heights. She considers Arabelle and others loyal to the Great Grandma as mere pawns for her to manipulate. She already tracked down Elvira, but she is keeping her location a secret from the syndicate’s for future plans. Miss Chrom acts as an executive of Reservoir Snakes. However, she is willing to work with anyone to achieve her grand scheme. Even if that anyone is the organization’s target.
stories.vampire_captain:
Valencia, is Demonshire’s Elite Royal Guard Captain.

The Elite Royal Guard is made up of the most loyal vampires with the highest skill in martial arts. Captain Valencia’s swordsmanship is so amazing that she’s never lost a single Demonshire Swordsmanship Competition. After she became the Elite Royal Guard Captain, Valencia has successfully completed every single mission without failure. She’s quite proud about this record. Valencia confidently introduces herself as ‘Demonshire’s Best Swordsman’ and as having never failed a mission she was tasked with.

Many vampires idolize Valencia for her gallant swordsmanship, charming looks, and the fact she became an Elite Royal Guard Captain at a young age. After Valencia was featured on the cover of Demonshire Monthly, many young vampires idolizing her lined up to take the Elite Royal Guard entrance exams. On the other hand, there are those who see Valencia in a negative light. Her overconfidence and lack of experience were called into question. Valencia looks down on everyone except the Count. Due to this, she sowed many conflicts with the Count’s assistant and many others. On top of that, her lack of flexibility and common sense from solely focusing on training swordsmanship from a young age makes Valencia quite clumsy. There’s a famous tale from the Count’s quarters about how Valencia mistook ‘organizing’ paperwork as ‘taking care of it’ and cut the stack of papers down with a single strike.

After taking on the task of serving Priscilla, who is much younger than herself, Valencia feels her sense of duty has grown. Thus, she is constantly on the move but nothing seems to be of much help to Priscilla. Rather, it is Priscilla who cheers up the sulking Valencia. Recently, she spends more time training. She says she had a nightmare about a particular knight, but doesn’t reveal the details to anybody. Even when Priscilla asks with big bright curious eyes, Valencia only dodges the question blushing with embarrassment.

She strictly distinguishes public and private affairs. When she is on duty as the elite royal guard captain she maintains a strict and serious demeanor. But after the day’s done and she returns home, she hops right into bed to watch NewTube. As she especially likes animals, her NewTube algorithm is filled with cute animal videos. When she is curious about something she looks it up on NewTube. For Valencia who is slow on worldly affairs, the information on NewTube equals common sense. Recently, while looking up keywords such as knight, dual and loss, she learned that a defeated knight should declare to the opponent “Kill me! My spirit shall never surrender, no matter what!”
stories.demon_operator:
Crosselle is one of the 4 Demon Gods who ruled over Demon World since the very beginning. In the distant past, Lilith and Erina defeated all the Demon Gods after a long battle. However, the souls of the Demon Gods weren’t completely eliminated, and they started seeking ways to be reborn.

The sly strategist Crosselle chose to form contracts with Demons. Finding an adequate host, Crosselle tempted Monica, the head researcher of ‘Cyber Robotics’, a company in charge of Demon World’s android production, with a promise to free her from all pain. Monica, who was suffering from endless tasks and fatigue, accepted Crosselle’s offer. Crosselle possessed Monica’s body as planned. The moment Crosselle’s plan of slowly possessing Monica’s body and regaining her strength was foiled was when she was discovered by Lilith and Erina. Lilith, who bound all 4 Demon Gods with a special binding artifact, spoke of the ‘time of ruin’ from the prophecy. She promised to give the Demon Gods freedom in the future, and suggested a contract of obedience to the Demon Gods and the hosts. Bellial abandoned the host and escaped, but Crosselle, Andras, and Pymon all accepted Lilith’s offer and followed her orders under the offer of freedom.

At the time of the contact, Monica made one condition. Speak and act with class. Crosselle didn’t think too much of this condition, but this was a grave mistake. The contract with Monica was the greatest suffering she ever experienced. Any time Crosselle attempted to act like a Demon God, she had to deal with Monica’s unbelievable nagging. She couldn’t laugh creepily. If her nail art got damaged during battle, Crosselle would face continuous scolding that would make her lose her wits. Monica was most upset when Crosselle ruined her new luxury coat. A skull-cracking scream continued non-stop. Crosselle couldn't endure it any further. The screams stopped after Crosselle cooperated with Lilith, and worked for three days and four nights to buy a new coat. Through this process, Monica achieved complete surrender from the Demon God Crosselle. This feat was historic. No other being was able to achieve this, not even the gods from heaven nor the hero of legend. Crosselle now lives a ‘disciplined life’ which perfectly follows Monica’s rules.

Before she knew it, enjoying a glass of sparkling barley tea after returning home from a mission became Crosselle’s only pleasure. Worn down to the bone by Lilith’s everyday orders and Monica’s constant nagging inside her head, the taste of sparkling barley tea that Crosselle got to taste by chance was so fantastic that it was enough for her to forget being reborn as a Demon God. Nonetheless, as Monica only allows one glass a month saying she needs to watch her weight, the ‘Sparkling Barley Tea Day’ that comes once a month is most precious to her. For Crosselle, sparkling barley tea is the only thing that motivates her to endure till the day she becomes free in the distant future.
stories.demon_slayer:
Andras is a merciless slayer who equally gifts death to all those who don’t worship her.
She was one of the 4 Demon Gods who reigned over Demon World, but lost her body after being defeated by Lilith and Erina in the past. However, Andras’s soul didn’t perish. She possessed bodies of Demons of her bloodline and started to recover her strength.

Andras possessing Celine took place because of an abnormal worshiping organization. This organization formed during the Demon World’s reunification war. They kidnapped orphans from war and extracted their high purity mana by sacrificing them as offerings. Their goal was to accumulate the mana to reincarnate the Demon God and use her to win the war. The organization’s leader finally succeeded in bringing back the Demon God after offering thousands of children. However, Andras didn’t show mercy towards the organization that dared to use her for their own means. She wiped them all out on the spot. Then, she possessed Celine, the child who was going to be given as an offering with all the mana still intact.

Celine, who forfeited her life after being kidnapped, prayed for revenge to the Demon Gods. She believes Andras’s possession is the result of her prayers being answered. Andras felt bewildered by Celine’s heartfelt gratitude and respect. When Andras reigned over as a Demon God, no Demon had ever believed and followed her but only feared her instead. Andras believed Celine had gone mad for being trapped too long from her kidnapping. She assumed Celine would feel fear and despair like the other Demons when she regained her senses, but Celine’s respect and faith towards Andras only deepened. This made Andras start to gain a bit of interest in Celine as well. It was the first time in Andras's long life that she became interested in a Demon instead of a powerful being.

Since then, she was able to hide her identity for quite a long time. But in the end, Celine and Andras were discovered by Lilith, who was looking for the Demon Gods. After long turmoil, Lilith suggested a contract entailing freedom in the future in turn for subordination to the defeated Andras. Considering Andras’s personality, the other Demon Gods didn’t think Andras would sign the contract. They assumed Andras, whose pride was sky-high, would abandon her host and escape like Bellial did. Against their expectations, however, Andras willingly accepted the contract. Andras glossed things over by saying it would be bothersome to try finding another host while dodging Lilith’s watch, but the exact reason is yet to be uncovered.

Andras once got caught speaking ill of Lilith saying that she’s just a pipsqueak with petty tricks and was grounded for a month. When Andras shouted that this was hardly enough to restrain her, Lilith forbade the provision of Madeleines and romance novels as well, which were given by Celine’s request. Since that day, Andras is subtly being more careful with her words. At least in front of Lilith. At night she still secretly talks behind her back.
stories.kunoichi:
Sumire is a half oni, the offspring of a human mother and oni father.

When Sumire was born, people called her a cursed child and drove both mother and daughter out of the village. Hauling her tired body, the mother went seeking for her daughter’s father. However, nothing was there where the oni village once was. A sorcerer then approached the weary mother.
