Pleading that at least Sumire should have a chance at a good life, the sorcerer coaxed the mother into handing over Sumire. But contrary to what the sorcerer promised Sumire’s mother, the real reason why the sorcerer sought Sumire was to use her as a core for a spell. To the sorcerer, the powerful oni blood flowing through Sumire’s body was the best ingredient. The sorcerer sealed Sumire inside a wooden box and conducted the ritual. However, the power the child beheld was far stronger than expected and it began to overflow out of control. The sorcerer’s curse was let loose and it spread all over, taking the life of every living being, including the sorcerer. The area became a land of the dead with only lost souls left. Only Sumire, with the life force of the oni, continued to breathe shallow breaths inside the box. It was Akayuki and Aoyuki who saved Sumire from the sealed box, which not even the lost souls could approach. After purifying the land of evil souls, the two arrived at the core of the spell and found Sumire inside the box. Discovering the child, Akayuki and Aoyuki were dumbfounded at first, but recalling their own past, they decide to take her in as their pupil.

Sumire was raised by Akayuki and Aoyuki since then. The two cared for the child as if it were a competition and this extended to their teaching. Under their attention, Sumire learned various things from martial arts to mystical arts, basic common sense, and the kind of attitude a warrior should have. On the surface, their relationship was that of teacher and pupil. But as time passed, the meaning of their relationship became much more for all three of them.

Nevertheless, on the day of Sumire’s last graduation test, this relationship gets ruined. Sumire, who had come a long way, battled the Ancient Demon as a graduation test. At first, it seemed she would prevail. However, at the crucial moment, Sumire let her guard down at the thought of having to part ways with Akayuki once the test was over. The Ancient Demon seized the chance and gathered its last might to complete its Curse of Petrification. To save Sumire, Akayuki intervened and took the curse instead. Even as she was turning to stone, Akayuki didn’t blame Sumire. Sumire, on the other hand, who lost Akayuki because of her own mistake, sunk into a pit of guilt. The same went for Aoyuki, who was absent at the time because he had to control the Evil sword.

Sumire and Aoyuki did everything they could to bring Akayuki back to normal, but no existing method could turn her back. After a long period of trial, the two came to accept that Akayuki was really gone. Aoyuki and Sumire still cherished each other, but they couldn’t help but think of Akayuki when they were together. Every time they looked at each other they felt guilt towards one another. In the end, as the two couldn’t forgive themselves, they decide to part ways.

Sumire, who was now alone, honed the martial and mystical arts Akayuki and Aoyuki taught her, sought ways to turn back the petrification, and helped people around her along the way. Sumire had no particular intention. All she wanted was to keep her promise with Akayuki and reminisce about the precious times when the three were together. Hundreds of years passed like that. Before she knew it, the people she saved, those who admired her and those who emulated her gathered around her. Sumire accepted them and taught them as pupils. They then passed those lessons on and formed a new circle, calling themselves ninjas. As the circle was formed by followers of Sumire, the faith of the “ninjas” towards her was almost religious.

Having lost Akayuki once in the past, Sumire shows a tendency to overprotect her now that she is awake. This was directly passed on to the ninjas following Sumire. If Akayuki even mentions that she’s feeling hungry, Sumire and the ninjas go right into action bringing her all the dishes gathered from all the diners in the area. Nowadays, to avoid all this trouble, Akayuki is going out in secret more often. But no matter where she goes, she gets spotted by the ninjas and eventually Sumire tags along behind her.
stories.demon_powergirl:
Pymon destroys everything in her way and proclaims herself as the strongest Demon God.
Pymon was one of the Demon Gods who ruled over Demon World alongside Andras, Crosselle and Bellial. Although Pymon lost her body from being defeated by Lilith and Erina, she is awaiting the chance of rebirth by reincarnating in the body of demons.

The reason why Pymon, who proclaims herself as the strongest Demon God, possessed the fragile girl Reynai is due to her innate mana. As most demons who become hosts to Demon Gods do, Reynai was also born with an enormous amount of mana. On top of that, Reynai was also bright. She was considered a gifted child and everyone had high expectations of her. All because the adults said she should become someone great, she was educated strictly and rigorously. Such overbearing environment constrained her from expressing her opinions and made her a reserved, passive child. Reynai became the well-behaved, kind child her parents wanted, but everything completely changed when Pymon possessed her. 

As soon as Pymon reincarnated through Reynai, she began to destroy the center of Saul. Though Reynai trembled at the unaccustomed power and violence of a Demon God, at the same time, for the first time in her life she felt a sense of liberation. Lilith arrived immediately upon hearing the news and stopped Pymon, sealing her in Reynai’s body. From there on, as she did with the other Demon Gods, Lilith spoke of the ‘Time of Ruin’ and suggested a contract of obedience. However, she faced an unexpected obstacle. Contrary to her expectation that simple-minded Pymon would accept the contract without much thought unlike the other Demon Gods, Pymon who simply did not understand the content of the contract rejected it and started off. Even Reynai’s all-nighter explanations were of no avail, so she had to take charge and proceed with the contract instead. Pymon, on the other hand, didn’t seem to care what became of the contract.

Pymon thinks she and Reynai are the perfect team, a partnership of the strongest body and innate mana. Reynai seems to agree to a certain extent, but she becomes absolutely ashamed when Pymon starts flexing her muscles all of a sudden. The role of apologizing after vandalizing and causing harm is always Reynai’s job as well. 

There’s a part of Reynai that admires Pymon who always acts with confidence. Especially when Pymon easily says things that she can’t because of her timid personality, she feels vicarious pleasure and that she can depend on her. Now, as time has passed, she concurs with Pymon’s destructive way of solution although she doesn’t express it out loud. Sometimes she’s the one who first suggests to Pymon that she run amuck.  

Recently, to reduce the gap between Pymon and Reynai’s personalities, Lilith suggested that the two should switch hobbies. That is how Pymon came to start embroidery while Reynai learns martial arts. Perhaps the new hobbies were a good fit, Pymon surprisingly won the Artist of the Year Award at the Demon World Embroidery Exposition, and Reynai made Celine cry in a friendly sparring match.
stories.dai:
Dai is the Dragon Knight, born to bring balance to the world. Dai’s the hero who continued the will of hero Avan to defeat Dark King Vearn, and is also Avan’s fourth student.

In the past, he was separated from his parents and raised by Lump Shaman Brass in Dermline Island. Brass told stories of past heroes and taught him various magic spells. Brass wanted Dai to grow as a great mage who aids the hero, but Dai always dreamt of becoming a hero himself instead.

The monsters at Dermline Island became savage due to Hadlar being revived by the Dark King. Avan, the hero tutor from Papnica Kingdom, gets a request to train Dai and arrives on the island. After Avan subdues the rampaging monsters, he trains Dai to become a hero. Not long after, the reborn Hadlar attacks Dermine Island. At the end of a fierce battle, Avan attempted to defeat Hadlar by sacrificing himself. That was when the Dragon Crest emerged on Dai’s forehead. Dai used Avan’s ultimate technique, ‘Avan Strash’ to take down Hadlar. Then he goes on an adventure to defeat The Dark King Vearn.

Dai couldn’t sleep before his showdown against the Dark King Vearn. Hel falls asleep after consuming the dreaming fruit Merle gave him. Suddenly, a mysterious rift emerges. Dai and his companions were sucked into a rift and ended up at Kanterbury kingdom. 

Dai’s courageous and doesn’t back down no matter how powerful an enemy is. When his companions are in danger, Dai will never give up on the battle however hopeless it may seem. Despite being seriously outclassed, Dai courageously fought and stopped the Dragon Master General Baran, the leader of the Dark King’s greatest army, and his father multiple times.
stories.maam:
Maam is Hero Avan’s second student, and a Martial Artist with superhuman strength.

She was born under a Warrior father and a Monk mother and got both talents from her parents. While Maam was a Monk, she couldn’t use attack spells. After meeting Master Avan, she obtains the Magic Bullet Gun from him. Maam was hesitant at first, using a powerful weapon like the Magic Bullet Gun. However, she was deeply inspired by Master Avan’s words ‘Just as strength without justice is powerless, so too is justice without strength’. Maam surpassed using healing and support spells and can now use attacking spells using the Magic Bullet Gun. Later, Maam comes up with her motto of ‘One can’t protect others with only love and kindness’. She trained continuously and yearned for power. As a result, she got the strength to protect her own village, and graduated from Avan's lessons to become a disciple of Avan. 

After hearing about Avan’s death, she wanted to avenge her master, but couldn’t leave because of her duty to protect the village. However, thanks to encouragement from her mother and the rest of the villagers, Maam decides to leave the village, so she can carry on Avan’s will, and avenge him. Afterwards, she officially becomes a companion for Dai and Popp.

During their adventure, the Magic Bullet Gun ends up breaking. After much consideration, Maam decides to become a Martial Artist by using her new weapon, the powers she got from her father, instead of the Magic Bullet Gun. Later she seeks out the God of Martial Arts Brokeena, and becomes a true Martial Artist through limit breaking training. 

She has a confident personality and is usually seen as being headstrong. However, she has a kind heart and cares about her companions more than anyone. Maam will offer her kindness to those with emotional scars, even if it’s an enemy. Even when Hyunckel attacked Maam and her companions to avenge his father, she heard him out. Then Maam convinced Hyunckel to return as a disciple of Avan.
stories.popp:
Popp is Hero Avan’s third student and an excellent mage.

He received mage training as Avan’s student. Popp was born the son of an arms merchant in a small village called Lankarks. But upon feeling a sense of admiration towards Hero Avan who visited the village one day, Popp leaves his hometown immediately to become Avan’s student.

Popp began to gain courage after meeting companions. Before, Popp would usually avoid hard training and fights. However, seeing his companions Maam and Dai fight against the Dark Army, he also came to pluck up his courage. Popp, who wanted to become stronger, thereafter receives hard training from Matoriv, a former member of Avan’s party. He learns powerful magic and grows to the next level as a mage. One example is the Extreme Annihilation Spell, Medroa, which is an arrow-shaped form of magic that can wipe out an entire area.

He has a secret crush on Maam. Popp first met Maam in a forest after embarking on a journey from Dermline Island with Dai. He quarrels with Maam at first, but later falls in love with her kind and righteous heart. Though Popp tried to confess his feelings to Maam before she left to train as a martial artist, he fails. And after finding out that Maam likes Hyunckel, he becomes worried about their relationship and hides his feelings.

Popp, who admired heroes but was a coward himself, grew to gain almost as much courage as Hero Avan by overcoming numerous hardships while journeying with Dai. He usually behaves like a jokester, but in dire times he is shown to be serious and courageous. There was a time when they faced a crisis as the Dark Army continued to attack while Dai was in a state of memory loss. At this time, Popp used Megante, a self-sacrificing spell that turns all life energy into attack power, to protect his companions. Even the enemies saluted him seeing how he continued to use spells to save Dai even after losing consciousness due to Megante.
stories.desertelf_hunter:
Rosetta was the executive and founding member of the crime syndicate, ‘Reservoir Snakes’. But she left the gang to live the life of a wandering huntress.

Rosetta’s early life was full of pain from being in a place called ‘The Wolf’s Belly’. ‘The Wolf’s Belly’ was a facility that kidnapped abandoned children in slums and raised them to be combatants. It was called hell itself as the children were both tortured and forced into the cruel training practice of pitting each other to the death. Despite this, Rosetta waited for a chance to retaliate. When she met Olivia, who shared the same ideals, they decided to leave this hell together. They stole weapons and eliminated all members of ‘The Wolf’s Belly’. She and Olivia burned the facility down to eliminate all of its traces. Rosetta and Olivia didn’t want the hell they’ve been through to be repeated, so they formed the gang, ‘Reservoir Snakes’ to protect each other. 

As the ‘Reservoir Snakes’ grew, Rosetta and Olivia began to argue about the gang’s operations. Unlike Rosetta, who claimed even the weak should be protected since they are a part of the gang, Olivia considered them as useless beings who endangered it. To lead the gang down the right path, Rosetta challenges her close friend, and leader of the gang Olivia, to a duel. After a fierce battle, Rosetta was defeated, and she left the ‘Reservoir Snakes’. When Rosetta disappeared, Olivia started to change the gang without hesitation. The remaining humane side of the gang from when Rosetta was a member had been eliminated. The rule of ‘Members who fail their mission or lose to the enemy will be expelled immediately.’ was erected during this period.

One day, Rosetta, who roamed aimlessly after leaving the gang, saves Elvira who was being chased by that very gang. Pleading that she wants to become stronger, Elvira clung relentlessly onto Rosetta. The two end up living together under the condition that Elvira does whatever Rosetta orders for 3 days. At first, she tries to get rid of her by making her do meaningless tasks, but after realizing Elvira’s genuine yearning to become stronger, she leaves behind a weapon and letter acknowledging Elvira as her apprentice.
Rosetta is considered a legend amongst Sparkling Barley Tea maniacs. Every year she participates in the ‘Demon's Road’ pilgrimage held in Dungeon Kingdom. Although it’s the rule to participate in a group of 4, Rosetta has always participated alone saying that she can drink 4 people’s worth. It is said that the surrounding customers cheer and applaud when she drinks an additional glass to rinse her mouth after completing the pilgrimage.

As for the police, she’s famous for a different reason. Drunk from all the tea, Rosetta has a habit of falling asleep basically anywhere. The street, the rooftop, or even other people’s beds. On days Rosetta drinks too much, you can find her in the most bizarre places. They say if you try to wake her up, she starts firing her gun randomly causing a commotion. When the sun rises, Rosetta gets up and goes on to drink tea again as if nothing happened.
stories.white_beast:
The White Beast makes a wish for memories with a precious friend, and turns into White Snow!

The White Beast and the Princess are dear friends like no other. When the White Beast first arrived at Heavenhold, it was weary of everyone except for the Guardian. It even refused food Loraine gave and began to grow thin. The Princess made efforts for the White Beast such as offering her meat dishes or mimicking a puppy. Through the Princess’s efforts, the White Beast finally opened its heart, and became best friends with the Princess. 

There was an accident when the White Beast tried to hug the Princess to express affection, but ended up crushing her. The White Beast only attempted to express its affection like it did to the Guardian, but unlike the Guardian, the Princes couldn’t handle the White Beast’s heavy body and sharp claws. The White Beast was shocked after scarring the princess. It restrained itself and the accident never occurred again. However, the White Beast felt stifled since it only scarred the Princess instead of thanking her. For the first time, the White Beast felt remorse towards its own body, one that hurts the princess regardless of its will.

During the Snowflake Festival, the White Beast thought it could play with the Princess as much as it wanted all day if it turned into a human. So it went and made a wish to Bari. The pure-hearted wish from the White Beast was more than enough to motivate Bari who had been sick of granting greedy wishes. Bari taught the White Beast how to speak human and act like one, so it could spend time with the Princess. She also brought lots of clothes and gifted them to the White Beast. All the clothes Bari gifted were actually prepared for a family member who had turned into a child.

After turning into a human, the smooth hands, skin and everything else felt awkward for the White Beast. However, the fact it could play with the Princess as much as it wanted made the White Beast ecstatic. The most fun activity was making snowmen. The White Beast is a Guardian Wolf that inhabits the chilly Mt.Shivering region and likes the cold. The cold snow was the best toy for it. Touching and playing with the snow that it only ran on as a beast with its own hands was a whole new world. The playtime in snow for the White Beast and the princess continued, and they only stopped after the surrounding area near the inn was filled with snowmen.

After the festival was over, it returned to the White Beast form, but its bond with the Princess became stronger. The White Beast figured out how to play with the Princess without hurting her after being in human form. The White Beast is content not turning into the human form because of this. However, when it snows, the White Beast wants to roll snow balls again, so it contemplates making the wish again.
stories.fallen_queen:
Camilla is the 1st Corps Commander of the Invaders. As the former Queen of Kanterbury Kingdom, she succeeded Beatrix II in A.H.498. Though her whereabouts remained unknown ever since Kanterbury was invaded by the Invaders, it was revealed that she was engaged in the Invaders' 1st Corps, which invaded Demon World.

Camilla is recognized as a capable commander amongst the Invader commanders. When the Savior first appointed Camilla as the Commander of the 1st Corps, the other commanders were stunned to the point where their absolute faith in the Savior was shaken. However, through the operations entrusted to her, Camilla proved her competence as both a commander and a combatant. Especially during the Demon World assault, when the other commanders saw how she ‘acted as if she knew the future,’ they had no choice but to acknowledge her as one of their own. Being particularly aware of her abilities, the assistant commander was sent by the commander of the 4th Corps to monitor her. 

As a child, Camilla was known for her exceptional talents and was often referred to as the Hero Princess. She excelled in a variety of fields, but her skills in spearmanship and magic were unmatched. Beatrix II recruited distinguished tutors from all over the country for her, but it wasn’t long before she surpassed them all. All her tutors agreed that Camilla would have been the strongest warrior in all of Kanterbury’s history had she not been born of royal blood. Realizing the disparity in talent, even Captain Eva fell into a brief slump while teaching her.

Despite her exceptional talents, Camilla didn't have much affection for her life. Her strong sense of duty towards fulfilling the prophecy for the sake of humanity, created by her long education, made her numb to everything except the prophecy. Recreational activities, spearmanship and magic where she showed extraordinary talent, and even herself. However, everything began to change when she met Little Princess. It didn't take long for the cold Princess Camilla to become a warmhearted queen. Whether this change was because of Little Princess or because she realized that her fate could change, Camilla herself doesn’t even know. What is certain though is that the little princess became more precious to Camilla than her royal duties, and even her own fate.
stories.hero_ai:
H.E.R.O.S KAI, which stands for Heavenhold Emergency Recovery Operating System, is an android designed to recover the systems of Heavenhold in the event of an emergency.

When Heavenhold was built, to be prepared in case control fell into the hands of the enemy, an AI that would support the Hero in regaining control no matter the situation began to be designed. Designing an AI that could discern Heroes as well as handle all the controls of Heavenhold turned out to be rather a challenge, so, the solution was to create an AI based on the mind of Kaden, who was best suited to carry out the mission. In the process of implanting Kaden's memories into the AI, however, the memories beginning from the time of Heavenhold’s construction caused an error, leaving only the memories of Kaden's childhood intact. That is how the AI came to be code-named Kaden Artificial Intelligence, or KAI.

As a child, Kaden was overly enthusiastic and often shouted the word “Justice," associating everything with justice. These traits were directly transplanted to KAI. The first thing KAI did on his first run was to walk around Heavenhold and use its control to name the equipment so that they included the word Justice. For a while, this gave Heavenhold’s workers a tough time because the equipment wouldn’t operate unless they shouted Justice. KAI has since caused many other problems including preaching about justice and passion upon every encounter until the listener’s ears ached. Nonetheless, because he was already one with the control system and many considered him to be kind of charming, it was decided he would stay that way.

Like the young Kaden, KAI also desired to be a Hero. On the other hand, KAI was also well aware that he could not become one because he was created for controlling Heavenhold and helping the Hero in danger. KAI tried to push the desire to be a Hero out of his mind so that it wouldn't interfere with his mission. But in the end, he couldn't give it up completely, so he secretly devised the Hero’s pose that represented his ideal image of a Hero. Although the pose was somewhat embarrassing to some, KAI says striking the pose makes him feel like a Hero. He later described the pose as "a righteous and sacred posture that inspires courage and passion," and it is said that he always strikes the Hero's pose before operating an important equipment.

Following the completion of KAI's learning, KAI had to be put into hibernation at the lowest level of Heavenhold according to the original plan, for his purpose to be maintained and to prevent him from being modified. This was done in the presence of everyone at Heavenhold. It’s said that even those who had criticized KAI for being noisy felt a kind of sadness at that moment. Right up to the moment KAI was put into hibernation, he reassured everyone that he could handle it. Although everyone there agreed that they wished to see him again, they also promised one another to create a future where KAI would never wake up.
stories.cyborg_monk:
Chun Ryeo is a cyborg martial artist who reached enlightenment through extensive training.

He was previously exiled from the Just Heaven clan after being framed by the eldest disciple, whom he trained with. In the process, he was ordered not to use the clan’s martial arts ever again. His limbs were severed, and his energy core was destroyed. He also suffered from serious external trauma including major fractures throughout his body. An old master discovered Chun Ryeo, but it was too late for him to be saved by ordinary measures.

Chun Ryeo received surgery that changed most of his body into a cyborg. Since the cyborg surgery theoretically suggested immortality, many coveted it. But Kamazon was strictly reserving the chance for a selected few. Originally, the old master was to be the recipient after helping Kamazon’s Director Luiz, but he yielded the chance to Chun Ryeo after seeing him on the brink of death. The surgery was a success. Not only was Chun Ryeo able to carry on with his life, he could also continue practicing martial arts.

Chun Ryeo deeply respects the old master. This is because through him, Chun Ryeo was able to obtain a new body as well as find purpose in life when he wandered after achieving revenge. To Chun Ryeo, who believed he was alone after losing his parents at a young age, the always-righteous old master became his role model. The degree to which Chun Ryeo respects the old master is reflected in the martial arts he created, as the name itself is from the old master’s Dharma name, ‘Shen Mountain’.

The Shen Mountain Fist being called an unmatched martial art is due to its power as well as its broad application. The Shen Mountain Fist was created with the martial arts of the Just Heaven Clan, which deal with extreme yin, the teachings of the old master which deal with extreme yang, and Chun Ryeo’s own enlightenment. Thus, it can flexibly tackle any situation or enemy. Moreover, as Chun Ryeo himself is a human turned cyborg, it is said that both humans and androids can acquire the martial arts he created.

In the past, Chun Ryeo’s whereabouts could easily be tracked through his participation in various volunteer work. But after his master ‘Shen Mountain’ reached Nirvana, he vanished without a trace. As a result, rumors such as ‘He returned to civil society due to the grief of his master’s passing.’, ‘He secluded himself to gain deeper understanding.’, ‘He escaped in the middle of the night with a long, blue-haired woman.’, etc. have circulated, but the truth has yet to be revealed.
stories.dragon_daughter:
Ameris is the Earth Dragon King Amarok’s daughter. She received training to become an heir since a young age. Ameris often heard the future of Earth Dragons seemed bright since she showed talent in magic and acted more mature for her age. However, after she started studying abroad in the Magic School in human world, she started getting caught up in multiple small and large events. Which is causing concerns for the elders.

Ameris spent a lonely childhood because of her status as heir. Her life met a turning point after she ran into the adventurous and fiery Girgas, who snuck into the Earth Dragon realm. Girgas pulled pranks on her without any hesitation, and this influenced Ameris. It was enough stimulation to turn her originally quiet personality into a bright one. She was able to laugh and cry from the pranks Girgas pulled and she could enjoy being a child fitting for her age. The Earth Dragons and Fire Dragons conflicted with each other, so their friendship is a rare case.

One day, the two of them started talking about venturing into the human world, and they started concocting a plan. The most pressing issue was that they had to transform into humans, but they haven’t learned transformation magic yet. That was when Girgas mentioned transformation magic stored in the forbidden library of the Fire Dragons. He suggested they sneak in together and run after quickly learning the transformation magic. Entry into the Fire Dragon’s forbidden library was strictly banned, but the two of them had had set a clear goal, and they didn’t hesitate.

Ameris followed Girgas and snuck into the Fire Dragon realm, and they easily entered the forbidden library through a secret passage. Girgas flew around the forbidden library as if he was already familiar with it, and he picked up a rustic magic book. Ameris took on translating the transformation magic, and it wasn’t a difficult task for her. However, their happiness was short lived. A giant stone dragon statue began roaring at them as if it reacted to their intrusion The defense system of the forbidden library that subdues intruders began to activate.

Ameris fell into a panic. She knew, if the heir to the Earth Dragons was discovered sneaking into the Fire Dragon’s forbidden library, then she won’t just get a simple scolding. She couldn’t fathom what kind of disaster would take place. The two young dragons turned towards the secret passage. Ameris jumped in, and Girgas closed the door. Ameris came to her senses after seeing the closed door, and she heard Girgas telling her to run away first. Girgas was smiling brightly as if he was saying she doesn’t have to worry about a thing.

Ameris couldn’t see Girgas for a long time after that. She missed Girgas and her concern for him grew, but she couldn’t approach the Fire Dragon realm. Ameris waited for the day she reunites with Girgas. She imagined the day they would reunite, and repeatedly practiced expressing her gratitude and how much she missed him so much. That was when she realized that she considered Girgas more than a friend. It was an obvious result that Ameris rushed into the human world after hearing about Girgas. She used the excuse of studying abroad in Magic School to become the perfect heir and ran off into the human world to find him.

Ameris perfected her transformation magic, but she doesn’t hide her horns or tail to look like a couple with Girgas. However, everyone considers her a failing student in magic like Girgas because she shows off her half dragon half human appearance. Someone once said they saw her fixing up the wreckage caused by Girgas’s pranks, and claimed she might be proficient in magic. However, that claim was quickly considered as a rumor since there’s no way Ameris could cast such great magic spells when she can’t even properly cast a transformation spell.
stories.mermaid:
Sia is a vendor who collects and sells items while travelling all across the world.

She likes collecting rare items, from both land and sea. Ever since she was young, she liked searching the sea for hard-to-find pearls or unusually-shaped corals. From there, her interests spread to terrestrial items, and she realized that she needed resources to obtain the items she wanted. Sia started her business with items from her collection, and the rare items only found in the deepest parts of the sea sold out quickly. She felt fulfilled seeing people in delight after buying her items, and she decided business was her calling.

Because she wasn't interested in wealth or appearances, she wore modest clothes and spread her items out on nets and cloth. This led her to be easily picked on. Sia, who didn’t like conflict, tried to avoid it by selling items at a lower price and paying street tax despite experiencing losses. But as time passed, she experienced difficulty adapting to the rapidly changing trading posts of the city, and the amount of conflict that the the influx of people brought on started to get out of hand. In the end, Sia started to seek out remote places that allowed her to focus on her business. Soon, Sia became a kind of legend among tradespeople as someone who sells rare items but is difficult to meet.

Once a year, she stops by a beach town and does business there for a while. The town she visited after leaving the city was small and isolated, but the people there were so happy with the items Sia brought that they treated her to tea and snacks. Sia, who was moved by the kind treatment, visited the town every year. She became close to the townspeople, even helping them with town matters and having fun with them. To repay her for her efforts, the townspeople gifted Sia with a a giant cart in the shape of a shop. Sia, who always struggled to move her items, is said to have burst into tears by the gift. Because of this, that town became more important to Sia than any other big city.

Sia goes through great changes thanks to the town. As more people started flooding in with the passing of time and the town's advancement, Sia also began to get involved in various incidents. Sia, who couldn’t abandon this town like she did other places, realized that simply running away from disputes was not the answer. She began to dress herself up so she wouldn't be disrespected, employed the eloquence she mustered through years of business experience, and took advantage of her mermaid powers to confront conflicts that threatened the town's peace.
stories.summer_amy:
Dual-personality Maid Amy, who arrived this summer bringing special customer service!

As always, she travels and does mercenary work with her partner, magician Dolf. After getting used to taking over work for the lazy bluffer, Amy was overjoyed when one day, Dolf proposed going to the beach for the summer to get some rest. While on the outside she stonily nodded her head, on the inside she looked forward to it, even setting aside lots of things to take to the beach. 

However, it didn’t take long before Amy realized she had been fooled. Dolf’s real motive was to earn money from beach tourists, and soon Amy became a server dressed in an upgraded maid swimsuit at Dolf’s demand. ‘Once we rake it in at the beach, we can relax at a swanky hotel!’ Hearing Dolf say this, Amy sighed saying she was the dumb one for having believed him.

Like that, Amy took over waitressing, which she had never done before. She became stressed dealing with rude customers from day one, feeling especially baffled by male customers who made a move on her after seeing her dressed in a swimsuit. ‘Always put on a smile when dealing with customers!’ She tried to force a smile, as Dolf said, but after continuously holding back against worsening rude behaviors, her second personality erupting was inevitable.

Afterwards, the shop had to close after going through a commotion at the beach. Dolf apologized for treating Amy so badly and asked for her forgiveness in exchange for a special week-long vacation. Dolf expected Amy to forgive him and reject his offer as usual. But contrary to his expectations, Amy said she would take a day off to go sightseeing around the town with her friend. While she didn’t say who she spent time with, Amy was beaming. In her calendar, which Dolf peeked at, she had already marked the day next year she would visit the beach again.
stories.dokkaebi:
Eunha is a baby Dokkaebi with tremendous magical energy with great proficiency in shapeshifting.
 
Eunha was born under a red full moon. The elders were in awe and claimed she’d turn out to be the Dokkaebi king. The Dokkaebi king was the hero who led the Dokkaebi and founded their own nation in the past. The king had powerful magical energy that rivaled the sages, and had the strength to move mountains.  It’s said the Dokkaebi king had tremendous magical energy. For Dokkaebi, the amount of magical energy they have is determined at birth. Therefore, everyone had high expectations for Eunha becoming the next Dokkaebi king. This news spread across the Dokkaebi village, and even those that weren’t Dokkaebi started to take interest in Eunha.

At some point, evil spirits started to appear in the world of the living. They began stealing magical energy from magical beings and these instances began to happen quite often. It’s unknown why the evil spirits emerged in the world of the living, but there is a rumor that a certain entity is working behind the scenes. There was no way the evil spirits would let Eunha’s magical energy be. They tracked Eunha down and attacked the Dokkaebi village.

For the peace and joyful Dokkaebi disliking conflict, the evil spirits were too powerful. Eunha safely escaped the village because of her mother, but it was no easy feat losing the evil spirits chasing after her because of her vast magical energy. In the end, Eunha’s mother hid her daughter in the village’s alleyway. Then she promised her daughter she’d return before leaving Eunha. For months Eunha waited for her mother to return, and spent a long time being lonely. Eunha is deeply scarred from spending a long time in hiding and being alone from a young age. She’s cowardly and weary of dealing with others.

The gourd used by Eunha has been passed down for generations. It’s the shapeshifting Infinite Change. This magical item received great power from the sages long ago. Eunha’s vast magical energy allows her to wield the item better than any other Dokkaebi. While she’s using it, she can completely change her appearance and hide her great pool of magical energy as well.
stories.summer_shapira:
Shapira, the dragon knight who wants to give Aisha the best vacation this summer!

This sweltering summer, all the troops including Shapira were given time off. However, Shapira had to stay behind in Heavenhold on guard duty. Shapira, who wanted to spend the vacation with Aisha, had no choice but to make the most of her remaining holiday. She devoted all her heart and effort into planning the perfect vacation for Aisha.

The following day, as soon as the next shift arrived, Shapira headed straight to the beach. Changing into a swimsuit, she excitedly stepped onto the beach, where she was reunited with Aisha. Contrary to her expectations that Aisha would be enjoying a relaxing vacation, Shapira found her carrying out a coastal survey in full military attire. As soon as Aisha saw Shapira, she began to discuss military strategies, leaving Shapira torn between the sudden tactical discussions and her vacation plans.

Before they knew it, the sunset had disappeared beyond the horizon, and Shapira hadn't even started to implement her vacation plans. When the discussions finally wound down, Aisha proposed they get dinner after cleaning up. Shapira arrived at the agreed-upon restaurant, her mood deflated, and shortly after, Aisha showed up in beachwear. Shapira, accustomed to seeing Aisha in nothing but military attire, was strangely moved.

They enjoyed a cozy meal without any interruptions, spending their time watching the beach. Deep down, Shapira blamed herself, believing that if she had been a more capable lieutenant, Aisha could have enjoyed her vacation more. Then, Aisha told Shapira, 'Short as it was, this was the best vacation of my life.' Upon hearing this, Shapira blushed, and they both quietly watched the waves as the crashes echoed across the beach. After their short vacation, while tidying her home office upon returning to Heavenhold, Shapira discovered that the note with her vacation plans had been included in the report she submitted to Aisha. Since then, Shapira could not bring herself to meet Aisha's gaze for several days.
stories.demon_governor:
Morrian is the governor of ‘Saul’, the city with the greatest military force in all of Demon World. A former soldier, Morrian’s cool-headed judgment and decisiveness is the reason why Saul, a city once ridden with corruption, was able to attain the greatest military. The instant Morrian became governor, she eradicated all of Saul’s corruption in just one day, as if she had been waiting for the chance. Implementing policies advantageous to Saul, she walked a different path than those of past governors. Thus, it wasn’t long before the people and soldiers of Saul became enthusiastic supporters of Morrian.

Morrian’s unparalleled efforts are what has made her a respected governor. Spending her time researching policy, assessing Saul’s state of affairs and commanding troops on top of her own personal training, there was not a single day that she wasted. Her demonstration of persistent effort and tenacity, even as governor, earned her the trust of the people and soldiers alike.

That's not to say she didn't have talent. When she was a military academy student, though she participated completely unprepared, she came out on top in a competition with the best cadets from each city, never to be dethroned. She even excelled in a personnel evaluation that was riddled with corruption on merit alone, setting a record for the youngest person to receive a special promotion. Diligent and talented, Morrian was a paragon and source of pride for all of Saul. She received recognition from all, and yet she never stopped striving for more.

Her obsession with being number one was fueled by the one person she could not beat, her half-sister Lilith. As the second daughter, Morrian was compared to her elder sister Lilith her whole life. From an early age, the two were forced to compete in various contests set up by their grandfather, the King of Saul. Morrian could never beat Lilith, not even once. She did everything she could to win, but the outcome remained the same. The constant defeats left Morrian with a great sense of inferiority, which became an insecurity, and caused her to become obsessed with Lilith. Since becoming governor, Morrian has issued a steady stream of criticism and accusations against Lilith, which Lilith did not respond to. Some claim it to be a subtle display of inferiority, but for the most part, it is brushed off as mere slander.
stories.demon_engineer:
As Demon World's best engineer and archaeologist, Vinette was the Lead Scientist in the creation of Heavenhold. Not only is she the leading scholar in both archaeology and engineering, if Lilith is considered to have spearheaded the economic growth of Demon World, Vinette is considered to have trail-blazed the development of Demon World’s technology.

Vinette, who showed great promise in engineering from her youth, was the Principal Researcher of the Saul Engineering Lab. Although she was competent enough to solve questions nobody could answer, she held little interest in Saul's military engineering. Her sole interest was in ancient civilizations and her hobby was exploring ancient ruins. Vinette was thus considered eccentric by the other Saul scientists.

Based on her travels to the ruins, Vinette published multiple papers on ancient engineering. However, her works were rejected by academics who didn't understand the engineering of ancient civilizations. Vinette didn’t care much about academic recognition though because she genuinely loved doing the research. Eventually, she quit her job at the lab to focus more on researching ancient civilizations.

One day, Lilith, who is Vinette's long-time friend and also the Demon Queen, visited her for advice about the development of Demon World. Though those around Lilith were skeptical of appointing Vinette, who was not academically recognized, as a technical advisor, Lilith knew of Vinette's brilliance better than anyone. With Lilith's support, Vinette became the Technical Advisor for Demon World and established a lab as well as a university to educate more students. Conducting research together, she and her students gradually formed a strong bond. From then on, upon Lilith’s recommendation, she joined the enterprise of building Heavenhold as the Lead Scientist along with her team of students.

The 'nanoparticle' technology Vinette employs is an ancient technology no one could recreate. To utilize this technology, which is extremely complex to even make in the first place, the cerebral nerves had to be connected to the nanoparticles. Not only was the procedure life-threateningly dangerous, if you didn’t completely understand ancient technology's principles, it couldn't even be used. Yet, against all odds, Vinette successfully recreated the nanoparticles and even modified her own horns to enhance their functionality. This was a monumental event, as it was the first perfect recreation of ancient civilization’s technology in Demon World. However, academia refused to recognize her achievements, dismissing them on the grounds that only Vinette could utilize such technology and thus could not be commercialized. Lilith, who attended the nanoparticle technology presentation, was deeply disappointed by the narrow-mindedness of Demon World's academia. This prompted her to reduce the fundings of stubborn scholars and redistribute it to support younger and more innovative researchers.
stories.shuran:
Win Ling is Chun Ryeo’s first apprentice as well as a martial artist and pill refiner that had much influence in the establishment of the Shen Mountain Fist.

She was originally the successor of a pill refining family that could make a special pill with the ability to raise one’s level of martial arts. However, it was evident that her family would be targeted by both the Tiger Clan and the Viper Clan if its existence became known. So, her family kept their identity a secret and disclosed the existence of pill refinement to only a few of their most trusted family members. 

After inheriting the pill, which was made throughout several generations, and the knowledge on how to make it, Win Ling also lived as an ordinary apothecary. At the age of 23 though, she gets caught up in a big feud after someone seeking the martial arts treasure reveals her identity to the Viper Clan. However, in meeting someone in the midst of it, Win Ling not only escapes from danger but also begins a new life as a martial artist.

Like how she studied various medical texts and pill refinement methods, Win Ling also collected, compared, and studied various methods when it came to learning martial arts, and her excellence in learning martial arts allowed her to reach a high level of mastery. As time passed, the number of martial arts skills she mastered increased. She organized what she had learned and alongside Chun Ryeo, refined them into a single martial art, the ‘Shen Mountain Fist’.

Once Shen Mountain Fist was somewhat completed, Win Ling became concerned that its power may fall into the hands of someone unworthy. Thus, she wanted to make an empty scroll that would serve as a warning to miscreants who were only after the power of Shen Mountain Fist while teaching its true ways directly in person. This has much to do with the fact that she witnessed firsthand how if an 'unworthy person' obtains great power, they can destroy everything including themselves. 

Even after achieving great accomplishments, she, accompanied by her fluffy white rabbit, continues to devote all her efforts into studying martial arts while traveling with Chun Ryeo as they continue to train and help others.
stories.demon_inspector:
Odile is a private investigator who runs a PI office in Demon World.

Formerly a detective at the Demon World Police Department, she used to be a role model for her fellow officers for her excellent focus and ability to find evidence. She was even awarded a certificate of commendation by the central government for dramatically increasing crime arrest rates.

After leaving the police force and temporarily living a life of debauchery, Odile set out to pursue a new career. After much deliberation, she decided to become a private investigator where she could utilize her investigative skills. Odile spent all her money to set up a small office and began searching for a partner to work with. That is when she meets ‘Gremory’ again by chance, a five-time convicted felon whom she once met at the police department. Although Gremory was an ex-convict, Odile remembered how helpful Gremory was with her investigations and offered her the chance to become partners. Gremory willingly accepted under the condition that Odile funds her research. They later named the office "O&G PI Office" after their initials.

However, the PI business wasn’t as smooth sailing as they had hoped. While they had a steady stream of work, they were mostly errands like finding missing pet monsters or searching for evidence of affairs. This was hardly enough for Odile, who wanted to take on bigger cases. On top of that, between office rent and covering the cost of repairing the vandalism caused by Gremory's research, Odile was always short of funds. Thus, Odile often goes on business trips to places even outside of Demon World.

Though Odile is constantly tired from non-stop work, she feels rewarded when she sees how happy people are after their case is solved and when they thank her for it. Whether it's a major or minor request, she always takes on a great deal of responsibility to help people solve their problems.
stories.bakeneko:
Mikke is a Bakeneko with the aspiration of becoming a swordsman.

When Mikke visited a bounty office in the hopes of becoming a swordsman, the mercenaries there ridiculed her for her petite physique saying that she probably couldn’t even wield a sword. However, to avoid being exposed as a yokai, Mikke ignored their mockery and took on a simple delivery job as her first task. While she unexpectedly encountered a group of bandits on the job, she managed to defeat them all, sparking widespread attention and earning her the reputation as a remarkable kid.

Though Mikke always carries a sword called Chisui around her waist, since she never learned how to wield a sword, she usually relies on her physical abilities as a yokai to handle most situations. In demonstrating outstanding skills even without using such a good sword, rumors circulated that she might be the heir to a significant swordsman or exorcist clan. However, witnessing her occasional use of the sword as if it were a mere club, people shook their heads in disbelief.

While carrying out requests, there were times when Mikke came across other yokai, some of which recognized her true nature and attempted to recruit her. However, she refused as she longed to stay amongst humans. When requested to exorcise a yokai, she would sometimes secretly let them go depending on their circumstances but was unforgiving to those who harmed humans.

Mercenaries were curious about Mikke's pursuit of becoming a swordsman, especially since she was not driven by wealth or the desire to improve her skills. To that, Mikke explained that she had made a promise to live freely in this world without being burdened by any constraints.

Mikke, who has become somewhat of a mascot to the bounty office due to her erratic yet adorable habits stemming from her feline days, often treats herself to a grilled sweetfish at her favorite shop whenever she completes a request and gets paid. Mikke does this because in her memories from when she was a cat, money is something that is used as an exchange for grilled sweetfish. Although the shop owner himself was initially baffled to see Mikke bring an extravagant amount of money to order some grilled sweetfish, he now says he grills the best fish for her every time.
stories.guardian_angel:
Angie, an angel driven by righteousness, once served as the captain of Heaven’s order of knights, the 'Guardians', and now holds the position of Secretary of the Heaven Treasury.

As captain, Angie was feared by her enemies and revered by her allies. She won countless battles to defend Heaven, and believed that protecting Heaven equated to justice. In every battle, she actively served as the vanguard on the front lines to prevent her allies from being sacrificed. Upon witnessing her valor, some gods referred to Angie as the 'Sword of Heaven.'

When Kaden and his comrades headed to Heaven to stop the flames of destruction, Angie joined them in their journey. Along the way, Angie met Plitvice, who was grappling with amnesia. Angie diligently assisted Plitvice until her memories returned. Even after her recovery, Angie continues to follow her, and Plitvice considers Angie to be the only angel she can rely on.

As the power of the World Tree faded and Heaven’s finances crumbled, Angie unexpectedly found herself taking on the role of Secretary of the Treasury. Despite her lack of expertise in finance, Angie, driven by her sense of duty from her days as captain, tirelessly worked to restore Heaven’s finances. However, passion alone wasn't enough, leading Angie to take on various jobs. After trying out all sorts of work, she eventually found herself working at a convenience store.

Although Angie excelled at challenging tasks despite adverse conditions, working at Gabriel's convenience store was no easy feat. The unthinkable amount of overtime and overwhelming workload ignited her desire to quit. But every time she felt this way, Gabriel would mention Plitvice, extinguishing Angie’s thoughts of resignation.

Fortunately, Angie's experience as a knight proved beneficial in her convenience store duties. Her impeccable display of triangular kimbap and milk, always perfectly aligned, amazed the customers, while her resilient and patient demeanor helped her endure the relentless complaints from demanding customers. After finishing another challenging day at work, Angie usually returns to her home and ends the day imagining the joy of breaking Plitvice’s seal.
stories.plague_doctor:
The Plague Doctor is a mysterious figure renowned for granting one’s wish in exchange for their soul.

The Plague Doctor appears before individuals who are deep in despair, fear, or madness and offers them the power they yearn for. All those who were granted such power acted on their desires, which resulted in the destruction of not only their surroundings but also themselves. While some claimed that they were simply manipulated by the Plague Doctor who stood beside them, there have been no witnesses confirming the Plague Doctor's presence. Also, due to their mental instability, speculation among some people arose that the Plague Doctor's existence might just be an illusion.

The reason people accepted the Plague Doctor's power was not just because they were forced into a corner. Although records of the Plague Doctor are rare, one common narrative is that despite his unsettling and peculiar attire, the moment he speaks, he instills a sense of salvation in those he encounters. Even those who were familiar with the rumors say they felt compelled to follow him once they were in his presence. No one has ever found a good explanation for this, but it is speculated that it is part of the Plague Doctor's abilities.

Since the Plague Doctor neither sought money nor affiliated with any organization, determining his identity remains a challenge. While there are records suggesting he aimed to treat the plague, the only evidence linking him to the disease is the black bacteria he carries, which can mutate organisms and is believed to be the plague he talks about. After the invasion of the Invaders, there were claims that the Plague Doctor was an advance agent for the Invaders, sent for terrorist purposes. Yet, given that many Invaders were also victims of his experiments, his true identity and motives remain shrouded in mystery to this day.
stories.watcher:
Yuna is a grim reaper and inspector who works for After World Inc. 

Born an orphan, Yuna lived without a home, moving from village to village. Despite her hard life, she carried a kind heart. Though she met her unfortunate demise at the hands of a monster, in being guided by a certain grim reaper, she avoided becoming a wraith and embarked on the path of becoming a grim reaper.

Demonstrating remarkable skill in handling tasks even amidst the lack of staff at After World Inc., Yuna earned the title of Inspector. While the title of Inspector acknowledges her exceptional abilities, it also signifies that she takes on more work than the other grim reapers. Although Yuna tried to maintain a smile even during challenging times at first, as time passed, her face gradually turned expressionless. Eventually, her smile transformed into a permanent frown. Nevertheless, she explains that it is not out of anger but simply because she is tired due to the overwhelming workload.

Unlike her seemingly lethargic appearance, Yuna does her best to thoroughly handle the mountains of work she receives. Since she always calculates how she can get her job done in time, she hates when her workload is increased by poor execution. Because of this, she avoids any work that is more trouble than it's worth and hopes it isn't assigned to her. Nevertheless, it often seems to fall in her lap. Now, after hundreds of years, she has somewhat given up. She now draws up tight schedules, which include any potential work that may be assigned to her. 

She works with Hana, who recently earned the title of Inspector. Given how clumsy Hana is, Yuna has had more reasons to sigh in exasperation as of late. However, she's also been told more and more lately that she isn't frowning as much, and that it's nice to see her smile.
stories.slime_rimuru:
Rimuru Tempest is the ruler of the Jura Tempest Federation and a member of Octagram, the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

Originally, Rimuru was an ordinary office worker living in Tokyo. However, after being stabbed and killed, Rimuru was reincarnated into the Central World. Realizing that he had been reborn as a slime with memories from his previous life, Rimuru successfully adapted to this new world with the help of his Unique Skill, ‘Great Sage.’

Rimuru’s ability to transform into a human form is thanks to ‘Shizu,’ who comes from the same hometown. Shizu, an otherworlder summoned by Demon Lord Leon, caused chaos in Rimuru's village after transforming into 'Ifrit,’ the Greater Elemental of Flame. Although Rimuru managed to regain Shizu by absorbing Ifrit, Shizu's remaining lifespan was short. Consequently, Shizu asked Rimuru to absorb her, enabling Rimuru to take on a human form.

While residing in the Great Jura Forest with the Goblins and the Direwolves, Rimuru resolved various incidents and became the chancellor of the forest. With the assistance of the diverse monsters living in the forest, Rimuru further developed the village. The Dwarf Kingdom, which had been keeping a close eye on Rimuru’s achievements, recognized the village as a nation and signed a treaty with them, establishing the 'Jura Tempest Federation.'

When Rimuru's comrades are killed in a raid by humans who are wary of the rapidly developing Jura Tempest Federation, Rimuru decides to become a Demon Lord to save them. After successfully becoming Demon Lord and evolving the Unique Skill 'Great Sage' into the Ultimate Skill 'Raphael,’ Rimuru resurrects his fallen comrades and is invited to 'Walpurgis' as a new Demon Lord. There, Rimuru confronts and kills Clayman, the true mastermind behind all the incidents, and officially becomes a member of Octagram.

As a food enthusiast, once Rimuru became capable of tasting food in human form, Rimuru contributed to the development of his nation's culture by introducing the food and festivity culture from his previous life. However, Rimuru continues to avoid Shion's cooking, even after she acquired the Unique Skill 'Master Chef.’
stories.slime_shuna:
Shuna serves as the chief economic advisor of the Jura Tempest Federation and is a princess of the Ogre Tribe.

After surviving the Orc Invasion, she journeyed with a group of Ogre survivors, seeking revenge on a masked Majin. During this quest, she came across Rimuru Tempest and engaged in battle due to a misunderstanding. However, Shuna quickly intervened, realizing Rimuru was not the Majin they sought. After hearing about their plight, Rimuru extended an offer for the Ogre survivors to join him as his subordinates, a proposition which they accepted.

As a token of their allegiance, Rimuru bestowed upon her the name "Shuna." Subsequently, during Rimuru's evolution into a Demon Lord through the Harvest Festival, all the Demons spiritually connected to Rimuru, including Shuna, received a gift, resulting in her transformation into an Oni.

Shuna played a significant role in the cultural development of the Jura Tempest Federation while assisting Rimuru. Although she mainly trained students in culinary and sartorial arts, given her status as the Ogre princess, she also exhibited adeptness in negotiations and foreign affairs.

Shuna cares deeply for her lord, Rimuru. Thanks to her faith in Rimuru, Shuna is able to use Holy Magic despite being a monster, with which she once used to overpower Clayman's subordinate, "Adalmann." Occasionally, she gets into friendly arguments with Shion, Rimuru's secretary, about taking care of Rimuru. The look of exhaustion on Rimuru's face during these moments is always an amusing sight.
stories.slime_milim:
Milim Nava is a Dragonoid, born between a True Dragon and a human. Like Rimuru, she is also a member of Octagram, the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

As the longest reigning Demon Lord, Milim's combat prowess is mighty and admired by all. When Rimuru first encountered Milim’s ambition, he noted that it was every bit as powerful as that of ‘Storm Dragon Veldora.’ Milim once demonstrated her combat capabilities by effortlessly destroying a Charybdis that was unaffected by Rimuru's attacks with a single blow and wiping out the Beast Kingdom after being attacked by the Demon Lord, Carrion. However, despite her immense power, she is often underestimated due to her childlike appearance.

Although Milim possesses overwhelming combat prowess, she does not solely rely on her strength to subdue her enemies. Her years of experience as a Demon Lord have taught her to be cunning when it comes to discerning her enemy's intentions and to endure unpleasant tasks when necessary.

Milim and Rimuru became best friends when Milim, who had been living a dull life, decided to move to "Jura Tempest Federation" in search of excitement. Initially, they were bound to be ordinary friends, but Rimuru couldn't resist Milim's pleading eyes and ended up forming a close friendship with her. Milim even brags to her fellow Demon Lords about the gifts Rimuru gave her. Despite typically doing as she pleases, Milim tends to follow Rimuru's orders well, perhaps because she values their friendship greatly.
stories.forest_elf:
Estel is a forest elf and defender who protects the forest and the Elemental Tree.

Forest elves are a race that live in the forest, coexisting with elementals and nature. Having formed a group of defenders with the mission to protect the Elemental Tree that provides vitality to the forest, they patrol the vast woods to defend it from external enemies. This closed-off situation sparked strong curiosity among humans and has even led to rumors of treasure hidden in the forest.

Estel, despite being the youngest among the defenders, is the most skilled in combat. With her exceptional senses, she can instantly detect the presence of distant enemies or read their breathing and pulse to understand their psychological state. Due to her immense confidence in her abilities, unlike other vigilant elves, she tends to be optimistic rather than overly cautious.

The Elemental Tree guarded by the forest elves contained the Elemental Essence, which bestowed power upon the chosen individual who had the potential to become the Elemental King. Then one day, the forest came under attack by a mysterious group intent on seizing the Elemental Essence. In the process, the Elemental Tree was destroyed, which caused the Essence to be scattered. Following the destruction of the tree, the vitality of the forest began to fade, plunging the elementals into chaos.

To revive the Elemental Tree,  the Elemental Essence was required. Through deliberation, the forest elves deemed Estel, the most skilled defender capable of locating the Essence, to be the most suitable candidate to retrieve it. Entrusted with this crucial mission, Estel embarks on a journey beyond the forest, with the support and prayers of her fellow forest elves.

Despite appearing flawless in every aspect, Estel has one flaw: she is irredeemably tone-deaf. Since elves communicate with nature through song, they all possess heavenly voices. But as for Estel, her rhythm, tempo, and pitch are all in disarray. Consequently, Estel never sang in front of other elves, leading her companions to believe she is just shy about communicating with nature.
stories.goat_girl:
Toga is an executive of the werebeast organization ‘Tooth and Fang’.

Tooth and Fang was once a notorious armed group. Back in those days, Toga, who was actively involved as a raid captain, was considered a nightmare to the demons of Demonshire. This was because she would break off and collect a horn from each demon she defeated, sparking fear amongst them and earning her the nickname ‘Horn Huntress’. However, after Toga’s childhood friend Rey became the leader of ‘Tooth and Fang’ and the group became mild-mannered, rumors about the Horn Huntress’ victims have also stopped circulating.

Since childhood, Toga has sharpened her swordsmanship skills by sparring with Rey. As she grew older and started to care more about efficiency, she tried using guns, but by then her swordsmanship skills had already been deeply ingrained in her. Because of that, when circumstances became urgent, she would often swing her guns like swords and break them. Now, she wields a weapon that is a combination of both a sword and a gun.

She enjoys climbing without using any climbing gear. While young werebeasts idolize her for being able to ascend and descend steep cliffs in seconds, their parents worry that they might imitate Toga's dangerous behavior.

Despite her blunt and tough appearance, she likes soft and pretty clothes. But because she doesn't like others seeing her in them, she usually doesn’t wear them unless they are made by Rey. Recently, Rey showed Toga how to make clothes using her own hair. Toga gifted the first garment she made to Rey, but due to a mistake in her measurements, Rey currently uses it as a handkerchief.
stories.blue_dragon:
Yun is a dragon of the vast sea and a protector of the Devil Dragon’s blood.

When Yun was young, her mother used to tell her an old story. It was the story of how three elder dragons and a hero joined forces to defeat the Devil Dragon and seal its blood deep in the sea. It was through this story that Yun first found out that it was the duty of her kin to guard the blood of the Devil Dragon. But before Yun could fully comprehend it all, her mother, a former protector, suddenly disappeared.

The reason Yun volunteered to become a protector was not only to fulfill the duty of her kin but also to resolve the questions she had about her mother. Yun’s senior, unaware of this fact, even questioned why she would volunteer for a task that wasn't particularly honorable or noble. Ironically, many of those who were ensnared by the blood of the Devil Dragon were former protectors. In other words, being a protector meant guarding the Devil Dragon’s blood but at the same time being in the most susceptible position to its allure. Although Yun confidently stated that as long as one's heart wasn't ensnared, it would be fine, in moments when she thinks about the disappearance of her mother, she worries that she too may drop the ball.

Yun is an idealist who wants to protect everyone without anyone having to be sacrificed. Although Yun clearly understands the reason for guarding the blood of the Devil Dragon, harboring discontent with the protectors having to be sacrificed in the process, Yun eventually decides to seek her own solution between the duty of her kin and personal values.

Being virtuous and strictly decorous, Yun might come off as a cold-hearted person. However, in truth, Yun is a well-known social butterfly among several underwater kinds. As a matter of fact, Yun has a close friendship with Sia, a mermaid whom she asks for help in times of hardship.
stories.pixy_girl:
Cornet is a rebel and the King of the Hill of Pixie Village.

Always perceived as the troublemaker of the village due to her rebellious nature, Cornet is treated as an airhead. She has been ignored her whole life for not having an innate skill like the other pixies. When Cornet realized that she couldn't overcome her fate through effort alone, she decided to go astray. However, being inherently good-natured, Cornet's idea of rebellion was merely scribbling graffiti on people's walls. Having a refreshing personality, Cornet is also popular among the children and takes on the role of their leader. Regardless, Cornet isn’t genuinely hated in the village. While she may seem pathetic, everyone knows she's not so bad as to commit any serious wrongdoing.

On the surface, Cornet appears confident, seemingly unaffected by any discrimination, but deep down, she harbors a certain insecurity. No matter how much the children praise her as their leader, she cannot shake the thought that she is just an airhead. After all, even those kids have at least some basic skill, being from Pixie village. Because of this, she often casually throws self-deprecating remarks. Even if someone tells her that she can do it, she quickly becomes pessimistic, thinking they're just mocking her.

Yet, there are moments when Cornet feels proud of herself. There was a time when a kid following Cornet disappeared in the forest. Even when everyone else gave up searching, Cornet didn’t. The moment she found her precious friend was not only a relief but also a confirmation of her own persistence. On that day, a small hope blossomed within Cornet, who had always doubted herself. She began to think, “'Maybe I can do it too...?'"

Cornet may be the village's oddball, but she values and wants to protect the village more than anyone else. She often detects and acts on problems that occasionally arise in the peaceful Pixie Village. The problem is that she does it without anyone knowing, so no one is thankful to Cornet. Despite appearing to be inept, when problems arise, she is the first to step up to protect what is precious to her, showing her loyalty.
stories.milkyway_girl:
Lena is the Chief Scrivener of the Scriptorium, entrusted with the task of recording everything in the universe. 

Scriveners harness a force known as the power of stars, enabling them to objectively document the principles of all things in the world. Each family uniquely manifests this power—be it through writing, music, dance, or other means. At the heart of each family lies the Chief Scrivener, who leads and represents them. Lena, possessing a strong power of stars since childhood, was designated as the next Chief Scrivener regardless of her own will. The role of a scrivener is to record the world objectively, setting aside personal biases. As the appointed Chief Scrivener, Lena bore the weighty duty of documenting the world with utmost fairness.

From her earliest memories, Lena has been the Principal Scrivener. Her life has been solely dedicated to preparing for the role of Chief Scrivener. Her mother, the current Chief Scrivener, treated her only as the successor, leaving Lena devoid of ordinary parental love. As the years passed, Lena began to feel that her life lacked meaning, but no one was there to understand her because this was considered to be a natural part of the Chief Scrivener's role in the Scriptorium. Although Lena never considered abandoning her duties as Chief Scrivener, she could not stop longing for an ordinary life.

Despite her yearning for a normal life, Lena possessed the finest qualities required to become the Chief Scrivener, most notably her exceptional memory. As a child, Lena's urge to have a normal life led her to sneak out of class to play in the ocean. However, her poorly planned escape was soon discovered. As punishment, Lena was made to write a tearful letter of apology reflecting on her actions. To everyone's surprise, the letter was filled with astonishingly detailed and accurate accounts of her escapade. Ironically, this incident only served to solidify her position as the future Chief Scrivener.

The people of the Scriptorium were well aware that Lena was somewhat different from other Chief Scriveners. The quiet of the Scriptorium, once dominated only by the sound of turning pages, was broken by Lena's innocent voice ringing out, and everyone sensed that Lena would become a unique and special Chief Scrivener, unlike any before her.
stories.sunyeo:
Dabin is a novice heavenly maiden who carries a large coffer on her back.

Though her skills are not extraordinary, she never gives up due to her characteristic perseverance. Heavenly maidens, following the will of the sages, defeat yokai that disturb the world and save sentient beings. On these lines, Dabin has completed all of her missions flawlessly. Senior heavenly maidens, who were suspicious of her impressive achievements for a novice, once secretly monitored her. However, they withdrew their suspicions after witnessing Dabin climb a mountain for two days straight just to find a child's lost dog. Since then, the senior heavenly maidens have placed their full trust in Dabin, granting her more freedom despite her novice status.

To assist the sages, heavenly maidens use various tools. Among them, Dabin is particularly fond of a large cannon called Heavenly Cannon. Dabin was fascinated by the earth-shaking explosive sound and tremendous destructive power of the cannon. It's said that when firing it, she would become noticeably excited as if she had turned into a different person. Although Dabin carries all necessary equipment in her magically expanded coffer to be ready to use the cannon at any time, due to its great power, she has never been permitted to use it in real combat. As a result, she often consoles herself after missions by eating the snacks she hides in a corner of her coffer.

One day, Dabin unknowingly encountered the Sea Witch, a dangerous entity previously sealed away by the sages. When the heavenly maidens later discovered this, they panicked, realizing the urgent need to track down the Sea Witch. As the only one who had seen the Sea Witch's face, Dabin is now pursuing her. However, with all the suspicious activities the yokai have been orchestrating lately, finding the Sea Witch has become even more difficult. Nevertheless, Dabin continues her pursuit, hoping that another encounter with the Sea Witch will give her the chance to freely use her beloved cannon.
stories.boatracing_girl:
Rachel, the beach racer who showed up by boat to take on the refreshing seas this summer!

She and the Guardian previously defeated the Graybeard Pirates and rescued a group of children, returning them back to their families. After that day, the children were so inspired by Rachel that they joined her on her adventures as part of her pirate crew. As they were about to declare their departure and set off to the seas, they realized they were missing the most important thing pirates need: a boat.

Rachel rushed to the shipyard to order a pirate ship with an impressive hull and a captivating crimson rose painted on it, but to the carpenters of the shipyard, the Crimson Rose Pirates had already been famously blacklisted. This is because while the boat she requested was the type of work any carpenter longed for, she wanted to pay for it using the treasure she was certain she’d find in the future.

In dire need of money, Rachel got a job as a duck pedal boat lifeguard. However, while working, she received a report from a customer saying that their boat had been seized by a strange man. Rachel immediately hopped onto a spare duck pedal boat and hurtled to the seized boat. Inside the swaying duck pedal boat, Rachel unexpectedly met Graybeard, her former captain. The Graybeard Pirates were trying to make a fresh start using the duck pedal boat after being brought down by Rachel’s betrayal. Now, once again, Rachel was blocking their path. Graybeard, unable to hold back his rage, charged towards Rachel’s duck pedal boat. Both boats capsized.

Rachel returned with the two broken duck pedal boats. Her boss burst into fiery anger over the two broken boats, but Rachel felt proud for catching Graybeard and the customers cheered her on. In the end, her boss had to settle up by giving her a boat, the thing she wanted most. While the boat they were able to procure in this manner was worn-out and shabby, it was more than enough to set the Crimson Rose Pirates sailing. 

Their goal is the Milkyway Race, which determines the best captain in Star Cluster Island! The epic story of the Crimson Rose Pirates on the high seas starts now!
stories.exorcist_girl:
Saya is an exorcist swordswoman who travels and takes on various quests.

Born as the eldest daughter of a famous exorcist family, Saya was raised with high expectations to continue the family legacy. However, it was soon discovered that Saya possessed almost no spiritual power, which is essential for an exorcist. As news spread that her younger sister, Miya, was born with strong spiritual powers, people's attention shifted entirely to Miya. Miya quickly became the new heir of the family, and Saya was gradually pushed into the background and forgotten. Saya was often compared to Miya and became a topic of gossip.

Feeling like a burden without any spiritual power and worried she would hold back her sister, the future head of the family, Saya decided to run away from home. While living as a wanderer, Saya ventured into a forest to find food and was discovered by a yokai, putting her life in danger. Fortunately, an elderly swordswoman passing by slew the yokai in one swift move, saving her life. Impressed by how the swordswoman defeated the yokai using only a sword and no spiritual power, Saya begged her to teach her swordsmanship. Initially skeptical, the swordswoman soon recognized Saya's potential and took her as her apprentice. Although their training was brief, Saya managed to acquire significant sword skills. Before they parted ways, the swordswoman gifted Saya her earrings and returned to Demon World. 

Since then, Saya has traveled alone, taking on exorcism quests to help people. Recently, she has noticed increased activity from the large yokai organization "Dark Immortals" and has been investigating various leads to eradicate the threat.

Saya cares deeply for her only sister, Miya. Unlike the family members who ignored Saya when she was young, Miya was the only one who showed her affection with an innocent smile. Although Saya feels guilty for burdening her precious sister with a heavy responsibility, Miya, in reality, spends her days merely worrying from afar about how her older sister is doing.
stories.secret_agent:
Anna is an intelligence agent of Adela Kingdom and a secret agent in the royal special division known as NEST.

Born into a military family, Anna joined the army to follow in the footsteps of her parents, who died in an accident. Throughout various operations, she demonstrated exceptional tactical abilities, earning recognition and eventually a place in the intelligence division. While serving as an intelligence agent, Anna accidentally discovered that her parents did not die in an accident but during a covert mission. Determined to uncover the truth, she investigated further, only to be suspended by the intelligence division. Thinking the kingdom intentionally covered up her parents' death, she became devastated.

The one who came to her in this state was none other than the newly crowned princess. The princess revealed the truth that Anna's parents had been forced into a reckless and dangerous operation by the nobility. She then shared her plan to dismantle the corrupt noble factions and invited Anna to become a secret agent for NEST.
