Anna was given the codename "Osprey," symbolizing her swift and lethal ability to eliminate threats lurking beneath the surface, just as an osprey swiftly hunts fish underwater.

Now serving as the princess's deadly weapon, Anna carries out missions to eliminate anything that could bring chaos to the kingdom. Never failing a mission and leaving no evidence behind, NEST remains so elusive that certain nobles in Adela Kingdom doubt their reality, questioning if such a group could be real.

Though years of military service and covert operations have made her extremely quiet, Anna flawlessly performs any role during undercover missions. During one such mission in Burywood, she disguised herself as the cheerful manager of movie star Eugene, to the point where even the lively Eugene struggled to keep up with Anna's energy and tried to avoid her.
stories.streamer_girl:
Ruri is a famous streamer in Dungeon Kingdom, known for her game streams and live on-site coverage.

Originally, Ruri was an engineer who designed drones and mechanical devices. She began her first broadcast in Dungeon Kingdom to test if her creations could function in harsh environments full of heat and dust. The high-definition footage of adventurers' various actions and incidents captured during this time gained immense popularity. This newfound fame sparked a new ambition in Ruri, prompting her to transform her dingy little workshop into a vibrant broadcasting studio and reinvent herself from engineer to streamer.

Ruri insists on live, on-site reporting, which has earned her a reputation as a faster and more reliable source than any media outlet. This stems from her engineering days, when she felt compelled to verify her designs personally. As she often ventured into dangerous areas, she frequently encountered fallen adventurers and would rescue them with her drones, saying the sight was unappealing on camera. Many of those she saved have become her subscribers, though Ruri still believes her popularity comes from her flashy commentary and looks rather than her rescue efforts and live broadcasts.

As people became reluctant to go on adventures due to the Invader invasion and various strange anomalies, Ruri's broadcasts gradually shifted to focus more on game streaming than on-site reporting. However, she declared that a true streamer doesn't just sit still when there's no content, and announced her own adventure. She equipped her drones with combat gear and set out herself. Having watched adventurers up close for so long, Ruri turned out to be more skilled than expected, and her courage inspired other adventures to regain their courage and venture out once more.
stories.soulpower_girl:
Dohwa is the heir to the Motori Mountain soul mage family.

Dohwa has a twin sister named Seohwa. While Seohwa has a bright personality and is often lucky despite being in poor health, Dohwa is prone to small misfortunes, like frequently tripping or getting hurt, and is more timid. Though they may seem completely opposite at first glance, their love and care for each other are the same.

From a young age, Dohwa and Seohwa studied soul magic to become soul mages. But one day, after learning about grim reapers, they both decided they wanted to become grim reapers instead. They immediately begged their mother to let them become grim reapers, but their mother scared them by saying that to become a grim reaper, they would first have to die and forget all their memories of this world. Not wanting to forget each other, Dohwa and Seohwa never brought it up again. Afterward, they even started to feel a little sorry for grim reapers.

The primary duty of a soul mage is to resolve problems related to the souls of the residents of Motori Village. Most of the work involves treating nightmares or emotional distress caused by disturbed soul flows. After becoming the heir, Dohwa took over her mother's responsibilities in solving these issues. However, she often stumbles in front of the villagers and frequently apologizes for lacking confidence in her soul magic. Despite this, many people find her clumsiness endearing, and a secret group has formed to quietly support her. It's an open secret that Seohwa secretly joined and participated in this group.
stories.ninja_leader:
Natsume is an executive member of the Snow Blossom Clan, a ninja group led by Sumire.

After being saved by ninjas in the past, Natsume swore never to hesitate again. In the past, when a fire broke out in her village, Natsume tried to help but couldn’t bring herself to act, too afraid of the flames. Fortunately, Sumire and her ninjas were patrolling nearby. They charged into the blaze and saved the villagers, preventing any casualties. Watching them, Natsume felt both admiration for the ninjas and frustration with herself. She left her village, determined to train under Sumire and become a true ninja.

Natsume’s eagerness to act made her stand out, though not always in a good way. Rushing through tasks, she often made mistakes and was frequently scolded by senior ninjas. At one point, she even began doubting her decision. But Sumire encouraged her, saying that on missions, sometimes hesitation isn’t an option. This reassurance fueled Natsume to focus on decisiveness over caution, allowing her to complete more missions than anyone else. Though the mistakes didn’t vanish, she became remarkably quick at fixing them—especially when it came to repairing walls and fences damaged in the chaos.

Her dedication and results didn’t go unnoticed, and, despite her young age, Natsume was unanimously promoted to senior ninja. The applause on her promotion day was one of her happiest moments, sparking her desire to become someone everyone could admire. Still, her hasty nature and occasional slip-ups made her more of a friendly leader than an awe-inspiring one.

Despite clashing with Mikke, a cat yokai, over a series of mishaps, Natsume ultimately agrees to teach Mikke swordsmanship at Sumire’s request. However, the lessons proved challenging. Mikke would often perch in random spots or fall asleep whenever Natsume tried to read to her—a typical cat-like behavior that drove Natsume crazy. Eventually, Natsume stopped trying to keep up appearances, and her lively bickering with MIkke quickly became a source of amusement among the other ninjas. Whenever it was MIkke’s lesson time, they’d all gather to watch—supposedly to "observe" the training.
stories.jade_shaman:
Tasha is an exorcist who eradicates yokai using her family’s ancestral puppet arts.

Tasha was raised in the village of the House of Jade Mountain, one of the three great exorcist families. Growing up, she looked up to the senior exorcists who protected their village from yokai. Inspired by her seniors, Tasha aspired to become an exorcist herself. To become a full-fledged exorcist though, family tradition dictated that all candidates must pass a succession trial. Determined to succeed, she entered the trial alongside her closest friend, Tilda. Together, they overcame numerous challenges and reached the final trial. But in the end, only Tasha passed, officially earning the title of exorcist.

Upon earning her title, she was presented with the "Mask of Dominion," which allows her to control yokai through puppetry. Though this magic is immensely powerful, it carries a grave risk of slowly corrupting the user's mind. Nonetheless, Tasha's strong and steadfast spirit allows her to wield this power without succumbing to its influence.

Having lived her entire life in the village, Tasha harbored a deep curiosity about the outside world. During an exorcism mission to another region, she encountered the Teatan Rangers, who were rescuing children while wearing masks. Though their flashy costumes and dramatic speeches initially shocked her, seeing the children's admiration for these heroes sparked something within her.

Inspired by the Rangers, Tasha began introducing herself as the "Jade Exorcist" when saving people from yokai attacks. As tales of her heroics spread, more and more people have expressed a desire to become an exorcist like Tasha.
stories.frieren:
Frieren is a mage of a peaceful era who has lived over 1000 years.

After her village was overtaken by demons, her master Flamme, taught her magic that would allow her to eliminate them.

She lived alone in a forest for a long time after Flamme’s death, until she was recruited by Himmel, Heiter and Eisen with the goal of vanquishing the Demon King. They journeyed for 10 years, went through countless adventures together and ultimately defeated the Demon King.

This journey with her comrades slowly brought about change in her heart. On the day of Himmel’s passing, Frieren expressed her regret over not getting to know him better despite knowing how briefly humans lived. This induced her to learn more about them. Since then, she has been travelling with Fern and Stark to the Land Where Souls Rest, Aureole, located in Ende, the northernmost tip of the continent, to speak to the deceased Himmel.

Just like her skills, Frieren herself is widely-known amongst demons. The mage who contributed significantly to the research and analysis of Zoltraak, the human killing magic, and has slain more demons than anyone else in history. Demons call her Frieren the Slayer.
stories.fern:
Fern is a first-class mage and an apprentice of Frieren.

Fern, who lost everything and became an orphan during a past war, was on the verge of ending her own life by jumping off a ravine when she was saved by a priest named Heiter. Deeply respecting Heiter, who raised her, she sought to repay his kindness by learning to live independently. 

After receiving a staff from Heiter, Fern trained diligently under Frieren's guidance, never missing a single day. She surpassed a barrier that would normally take ten years for an average person to overcome in just four years, achieving her goal of piercing a boulder across the valley. Following Heiter’s passing, she sets off on a journey with her master, Frieren.

Fern possesses exceptional mana control and detection abilities, impressive enough to awe even long-lived elf races. She became the youngest mage in history to pass the third-class mage exam with the highest score. During the third test of the first-class mage exam, the Great Mage Serie, recognizing her talent, personally invited her to become her apprentice. However, Fern declined, firmly stating that Frieren was her only master.
stories.stark:
Stark is a warrior who serves as the vanguard in Frieren’s group.

Born in a warrior village, he lost everything when demons razed his homeland, leaving him an orphan. He was later taken in by the seasoned warrior Eisen, becoming his first disciple.

One day, during one fateful argument, Stark voiced his reluctance to fight monsters and, in the heat of the moment, was accidentally struck by Eisen's attack. This incident left him deeply traumatized. 

Despite this, Stark eventually earned the title of a village hero when he defended a settlement near Riegel Canyon from the fearsome Solar Dragon. Known for his soft heart and timid nature, he initially met Frieren while trembling in fear of the beast. Yet, after gathering his courage, Stark faced the Solar Dragon and defeated it with his own strength, even though his hands shook just like his master’s once had. From that point on, he joined Frieren on her journey.

Stark’s motivation for traveling with Frieren is to repay his debt to Eisen. As his master had grown too old to adventure himself, Stark resolved to return one day with stories of lighthearted and joyful travels—a gift to honor the man who raised him before he passes on.
stories.twins_android:
Nifty is one of the twin android models specially developed by Cyber Robotics and serves as a secretary who assists the CEO.

Along with her twin Shifty, Nifty carries out secretarial duties and handles overall management of the company on behalf of the busy CEO. While the two androids share a similar structural design, being twin androids, their AIs are completely different. While Nifty considers multiple possibilities when solving problems, Shifty places emphasis on efficient solutions. The CEO deduced that, by working together, the two AIs would complement each other and become perfect, and instructed them to carry out duties as a pair.

They often bicker like sisters, and when they do, their work efficiency drops exponentially. The topic they argue about most is ‘who is older’. Both androids have their reasons for staking claim to be the older sister. Nifty argues that her android body was developed first, while Shifty asserts that her AI was developed first. When their disagreements began affecting their performance, the CEO declared that he would award the title of older sister based on work efficiency. Ever since then, their productivity has tripled.

It’s easy to tell Nifty and Shifty apart now because of their different hair colors, but they originally had identical hair. At one point, the CEO deliberately mixed up their names to spark competition between them, leaving them speechless. When they returned the next day, they had dyed their hair different colors.
stories.valentine_ameris:
Ameris, the girl determined to express her feelings with sweet chocolates!

During her brief time studying abroad at a magic school with Girgas, Ameris was introduced to the many facets of human culture. Among them, the one that left the deepest impression on her was Valentine’s Day. She watched countless girls confess their feelings to their crushes with heartfelt gifts of chocolate and couldn’t help but think of Girgas. Yet, burdened by her long-standing, unrequited love and Girgas’s utter obliviousness, she never dared to imagine confessing her feelings. To her, Valentine's Day was simply something to observe from afar—something she believed had nothing to do with her.

But as this year's Valentine's Day approached, Girgas made an unexpected comment. He had heard rumors about some delicious chocolates being sold in Kamazon and wanted to try them. This threw Ameris into a whirlwind of emotions. Could Girgas be hinting that he wanted chocolates for Valentine’s Day? Or was he even hoping for a confession? Encouraged by this, Ameris decided to muster her courage and convey her true feelings through chocolates.

When Ameris visited Kamazon to buy chocolates, however, she was disappointed by the small, unimpressive box of chocolates she found. Doubting whether something so insignificant could truly convey her feelings, Ameris expressed her concern to the vendor. The vendor reassured her that what mattered most was the size of her heart, not the size of the gift. However, misunderstanding this advice, Ameris concluded that she needed to give Girgas an enormous amount of chocolate to match the size of her feelings. Determined, she decided to buy every single chocolate in Kamazon as a gift for Girgas.

As a result, Ameris gifted Girgas all the chocolates Kamazon had to offer, including bizarre creations like "Slime Chocolate" and "Mace of Stench Chocolate," forcing Girgas to endure quite the ordeal tasting them all.
stories.whiteday_girgas:
Girgas, a reckless young dragon with no interest in White Day!

Ever since he arrived in the human world, Girgas has had no worries aside from finding the Dispel herb. That is, until Valentine’s Day, when he encountered an unexpected dilemma. He had received an overwhelming amount of chocolates from Ameris. He was used to Ameris looking after him, but this time, something felt different. Her strangely flushed face, the way her gaze constantly avoided his, even the strange chocolates that didn’t suit his tastes. It wasn’t like her at all. Seeing her act differently than usual, Girgas came to an absurd conclusion. That Ameris must’ve been cursed.

On White Day, Girgas was still on the hunt for the Dispel herb when he caught wind of a so-called ‘magic candy’ and set out to find it.  His eyes sparkled at its incredible effects. However, upon setting sight on the candy’s ludicrous price tag, Girgas started causing an uproar, declaring that a great fire dragon shouldn’t have to pay a human money for a purchase. In the commotion, the box holding the magic candy was burned up, but Girgas managed to secretly snag a piece before leaving.

Girgas was giddy at the thought of finally being able to break the transformation magic. But just as he was about to eat the candy, he hesitated, thinking of Ameris, who was still under a curse. Unable to ignore Ameris after she constantly took care of him, Girgas decided to give up the magic candy and give it to her instead. 

Of course, Ameris knew full well that it was just an ordinary piece of candy with no dispel effects, and that this was no White Day gift, but she was still deeply moved that Girgas had thought of her. Meanwhile, as Girgas watched Ameris perk up at the candy, he became convinced that the candy must have some truly powerful effects and slightly regretted not eating it himself.
stories.wrestler:
Callie is the marquee star of the La Ventura arena.

In the deep-sea city of La Ventura, there are plenty of attractions, but none compare to the arena. The arena’s battles, where both blood and sweat are shed, offer an unparalleled spectacle and have become the signature tourist attraction of La Ventura, which draws people solely for that thrilling event. As the face of the arena, Callie is extremely popular thanks to her exceptional fighting skills, dazzling looks and showmanship.

Callie’s life before her wrestling career remains a mystery, even to Callie herself. Her earliest memory is waking up alone in a dark, abandoned ruin. It was thanks to the village elder of the slums who first discovered her 5 years ago that she was able to step out into the world. Even after leaving the ruins, Callie’s life has been anything but easy. To someone with no memories or knowledge, life in the slums, where failing to pull your weight meant going hungry, was an unforgiving environment. Callie wouldn’t be here today without the people of the village, who helped her become a valued member of the slums.

To her, the people in the slums are as good as family. In the same way they helped her, she has always believed that it's her duty to be of help to them. Even as a marquee star who earns vast sums of fight money with every fight, Callie still lives in the slums and devotes most of her earnings to supporting her community. She remains there because it's more than home, and because she wants to protect her family.

In the city, Callie’s level of fame is unmatched, even by most celebrities. Her die-hard fans even try to mimic her every move. However, there’s one thing that even they have given up on: her taste in food. Callie’s favorite dish is a triple cheeseburger, always ordered with no pickles and extra cheese. Most people can't even finish a bite because of how greasy it is.
stories.panda_girl:
Xiaoman is an adorable werepanda who loves sleep and food.

Werepandas are a rare tribe, much like the white tiger werebeasts. The forest where the werepandas now live became a refuge for several werebeast groups who once fled discrimination. They have since lived in relative seclusion from other races. Unlike the Demon World, where werebeast rights are a source of ongoing violent conflict, this forest has fostered a peaceful and quiet atmosphere. And the youngest werepanda among them is none other than Xiaoman.

The things Xiaoman loves are simple: sleeping, eating, and zoning out! Of these, eating is her greatest passion. Unlike other werebeasts who are wary of human food, Xiaoman enjoys all kinds of cuisine without hesitation. Each time she tastes something new, her ranking of favorite foods changes, except for her absolute, unchanging number one: bamboo. Her inexplicable obsession with bamboo is well known throughout the forest. The other werebeasts often say they'll never understand her taste, as she happily munches on bamboo every day despite it having neither flavor nor nutritional value.

Xiaoman is impressionable and extremely literal, which often leads to her misunderstanding what others say. For example, when she was still a baby panda, Kanna once called her "mochi" because she was so soft and cute. Xiaoman took it literally and genuinely believed she was mochi. One day, she even jumped into a lake, thinking she could eat her reflection. Kanna had quite a time clearing up the misunderstanding. Although it was eventually resolved, Xiaoman still sometimes licks her lips when she sees her reflection in the water, almost out of habit.
stories.mermaid_spy:
J is an agent of the Atlantis Intelligence Bureau.

In the seas of Tetis, countless species swim freely, but the waters remain ever tranquil thanks to the presence of the Water Elemental King, Triton. Supporting him are the agents of the Intelligence Bureau, who work tirelessly to eliminate large-scale terrorist threats and national-level dangers that threaten Atlantis, preserving peace beneath the waves.

Among them, J is a unique case. Unlike other agents who operate in teams, J is deployed alone into mission zones and completes operations solo. Officially, it is said that the upper echelons have granted her special clearance to undertake solo missions, citing her exceptional ability to handle team-scale operations by herself.

But in truth, J is isolated within the organization. Though fiercely loyal to the nation and known for executing missions with complete emotional detachment—sacrificing aspects of personal life for the sake of duty—J's methods came to be viewed as outdated and inefficient following a generational shift within the Bureau.

As a result, J became the only agent without a team. After countless solo operations, staring at the resignation letter hidden in a corner of her desk drawer became a part of her daily routine. While J wanted to continue protecting the peace established by Triton, there was also a more practical reason: retiring now would disqualify her from receiving the special pension reserved for public servants.

However, everything changed when J participated in a joint operation with an agent named "Osprey." The mission offered her a revelation—both agents focused solely on the objective, with no emotional friction throughout the process. The clean, successful outcome solidified J’s belief that within a results-driven organization, finding compatible teammates was nearly impossible.

From that day forward, J began building a personal team for each mission. The selection criteria were threefold:
1. Shared objectives.
2. Complete transparency.
3. Equal authority.
Through this process, she built teams that could focus entirely on the mission at hand. Over time, these successes accumulated. As a result, in a rare decision from leadership, J was granted full operational autonomy—becoming the only Intelligence Bureau agent authorized to carry out missions without receiving direct orders.

To J, teamwork is just a minor detail. The mission's completion is all that matters.
stories.adela_noble:
Daisy is the baroness of Adela’s fortress city, as well as a girl gifted with incredible strength.

For generations, Daisy’s family has passed down a special power sealed within a brooch, and those chosen to inherit it gain strength beyond human comprehension, as well as the solemn duty to protect Adela. Since only one heir from each generation can receive this power, it was once a source of great pride, even sparking fights among potential candidates. But Daisy, born an only child and already chosen as the next successor, instead feared the idea of inheriting it, unlike those before her.

The day the Invaders attacked Adela, Daisy’s father, the baron at the time, defended the city with all his might. To Daisy, her father was a hero, the strongest man in the world who could not be defeated by anyone. But at the same time, he became a wall she could never surpass. Unlike others in her family, Daisy was timid and always ranked last in swordsmanship classes. She believed that she could never become like her father and slowly withdrew from the pressure. Her once-bright personality grew unsure, self-conscious and overly cautious.

Noticing her distress, her parents reassured her, saying she was already strong enough, but Daisy dismissed this, thinking they were just being supportive parents. In truth, they believed she was a suitable successor due to her gentle heart. They believed that her reluctance to hurt others, even by placing last in swordsmanship classes, was proof enough of her compassion and strength needed to protect the city and kingdom. Of course, it would be a long time before Daisy came to truly understand their sincerity.

After becoming baroness, Daisy faced an unexpected obstacle- a towering stack of paperwork, taller than she was. As someone who disliked studying and was still young, Daisy found the official documents, filled with difficult words, scarier than any monster. All her protests that she would give up the title if this was to be her job, were dismissed. But the princess took pity on her and ordered Anna to give Daisy special tutoring. Thanks to this, rumors have spread that the sound of crying echoes daily from the baroness' estate.
stories.summer_rie:
Beach Cleanup Hitter Rie aims for the Summer Battleball Tournament trophy!

The Summer Battleball Tournament, the biggest event of the season under the blazing summer sun, has officially begun. Known for its thrilling and exhilarating matches, the tournament draws more anticipation than any other battleball competition. After suffering a crushing defeat in last year's finals against the Teatan Giants, Rie spent a spring even hotter than summer, fueled by determination. This summer, the Purple Sox are marching toward the tournament with renewed resolve, burning with the will to reclaim the championship trophy. 

What fans are most excited about this tournament is Rie's performance. In the previous Spring Tournament, she led her team to victory with a 10-game home run streak and flawless defense. At the time, commentators unanimously hailed her as the greatest player in battleball history. When Rie declared in a pre-tournament interview that she had been sharpening her skills and was more prepared than ever, fans and officials alike flocked to the stadium, eager to witness just how unstoppable she'd be in her already near-perfect form. All eyes are now on the Purple Sox’s opening match.

Though Rie is now the most popular and admired player in the league, she never once made the starting lineup during her high school days, spending every game on the bench. Determined to earn her spot, she trained relentlessly each day and even worked as a ball girl to study the techniques of other players. Despite her tireless efforts, she remained in obscurity until one day, the coach of the Purple Sox recognized her hidden potential and recruited her to the Purple Sox, despite opposition from others. With a training program tailored specifically for her, Rie's talent blossomed, and she went on to become the youngest player ever to win the most MVP titles in history. 

For this tournament, Rie pushed herself through a special training regimen. After finishing her regular team practices, she prepared for the summer heat by swinging her bat 10,000 times a day in front of a heater, practicing 1,000 fielding drills barehanded, and running 50 kilometers barefoot. She would end each grueling day with a meal of juicy premium steak and repeat the same routine again the next day. Watching her train with such intensity, her Purple Sox teammates couldn't help but shake their heads, calling her an "extreme training addict."
stories.battleball_pitcher:
“True strength is proven when you rise again.”- Reed

Randi is a southpaw fireballer and Rookie of the Year-winning battleball pitcher.

Randi’s dream of becoming a battleball player was sparked by pitcher Reed’s comeback game. Up until the game, he had been in a long, devastating slump, and no one believed he'd return. But he defied all expectations and stirred up cheers from the crowd as he stepped onto the mound. His blazing fastballs didn’t just strike out batters, they also struck a chord in Randi’s heart. Since then, Randi dreamed of becoming like Reed and began throwing with her left arm.

Those who witnessed her fastballs, thrown by her naturally gifted arm, hailed her as "the second coming of Reed." But she didn’t just rely on her natural talents. She trained relentlessly. But young Randi, surrounded by praise and attention, slowly showed weak spots. As a result, her once-proud fastball lost its edge and a string of losses started following her.

She realized that this would blow her chances of making it into the Purple Sox, where Reed played, and she pulled herself together. She pushed through 1,000 shoulder-strengthening reps a day and took ballet lessons to improve her flexibility. She even limited eating her favorite food, meat, to just one day a year, all to become a great pitcher. In the end, her relentless effort paid off, and she earned a spot on the Purple Sox and was named Rookie of the Year.

But her triumph was short-lived. During a game, she accidentally threw a pitch that badly injured a batter. The guilt and the backlash that followed left her left arm frozen. She was no longer able to throw a fastball, and the pitcher in her was lost. Unable to throw with her left arm, she worked hard to throw with her right, but was unable to move beyond average. Even so, she couldn’t give up battleball, which was everything to her. Driven by her determination to stand on the mound again and the support of those around her, Randi finally made her return.

After getting past a difficult time in her life, Randi’s fans no longer saw her as Reed’s shadow. The player they saw was none other than southpaw fireballer Randi in her own right. One day, a child wearing a Purple Sox uniform ran up to her, holding out a piece of paper and a pen. He asked how he could become a strong pitcher like her. Without a moment of hesitation, Randi replied.

“When you fall, you have to be able to get back up. That’s true strength.
 And… when it’s too hard to do it on your own, take the hand of the person beside you. 
 Because battleball isn’t played alone.”
stories.squirrel_girl:
Chriselle is the manager of the Tetis Brilliant Park as well as a free-spirited weresquirrel.

Although her older brother is a world-class explorer, Chriselle leads a relatively uneventful life. She usually spent her time waiting tirelessly for Chris to return from his explorations, so she often went on small adventures to shake off her loneliness. However, she didn’t venture farther than the small forest in front of her home or the pond in her backyard, because she had to house-sit while her brother was away. But one day, Chriselle went missing. When Chris finally found her late that night, all she could remember was that she had gone a little farther than usual during her forest adventure. Since then, Chriselle started acting strangely, like she had sensed something was out of place, and she became jumpy around purple objects.
”The purple one, I’m pretty sure you’ve seen it before too."

The only thing Chris could do for his sick sister was stop by more often and share stories from his adventures. Chriselle usually seemed distant and didn’t appear to be listening, but her eyes would always light up at the mention of a certain "someone".
”Who, you ask? Tee hee, that's a secret!"

Sensing the change in his younger sister, Chris started preparing stories about that certain ‘someone’ to cheer her up. Sure enough, Chriselle made a remarkable recovery shortly after. Even so, believing she would never be able to go on adventures alone as she had before, Chriselle decided to gather the fantastical places from her brother’s stories and create a new world of her own. 
”And thus, a world of wonder was born! The Tetis Brilliant Park!"

Though she holds the title of manager, Chriselle’s management skills leave much to be desired. ”Excuse me?!" Actually, it’d be more accurate to say she doesn’t do any of the actual work. ”That’s not true!" Under the pretense of "inspection", Chriselle spends much of her time wandering the park, playing pranks on her staff and riding the attractions. ”Ugh… Now when did you find out and when exactly did you write all of this down?" She seems fond of acorns, but doesn’t like eating them, claiming they’re bitter and tasteless. She seems to enjoy peeling off the shells and playing with them. Rumor has it that she repurposes the leftover nuts as bullets…
stories.first_bishop:
Kahlor is one of the Fire Dragon King’s avatars.

Even the benevolent Fire Dragon King Nidhogg had once been naive and immature. Her first avatar, Kahlor, who was born during that time, is a mischief-maker with a personality that is the perfect copy of that of young Nidhogg. Even though she suddenly found herself with a reckless younger sibling, Nidhogg deeply cared for Kahlor, who also thought of Nidhogg as an older sister. Kahlor is Nidhogg’s oldest avatar and she has been by Nidhogg’s side since before the sealing.

While they were twin-like in personality, time and destiny pushed their views apart. To protect everyone in Volver, the Fire Dragon King chose to seal herself. Kahlor, who cared for Nidhogg more than the other avatars, tried over and over to hold Nidhogg back from sealing herself. But there was no denying Nidhogg’s will to give up her freedom. Left behind, Kahlor visited the Sealed Chamber on the anniversary of that day every year, crying out Nidhogg's name like a small child. Even the carefree fire dragons didn’t dare to make a peep on that day.

She’s a hedonist who loves freedom. Fire dragons often have difficulty distinguishing between freedom and self-indulgence, and Kahlor is largely responsible for this. Because she puts her desires above all, she often causes incidents while trying to see them through. Once, she tore off the entire neighborhood of Muspelheim and relocated it on the volcano’s crater. While Kahlor laughed and called the fire dragons' houses that were floating in the lava ‘floating homes’, a sudden eruption from the crater sent lava surging out, destroying many of the homes.

She’s waiting for the Fire Dragon King to be liberated and find true freedom at Mount Volver. Ever since the day that she pledged to protect Volver on behalf of Nidhogg, Kahlor has sat on the empty throne, wiping the usual smile off her face and deepening her resolve. Still, every once in a while, when a worthy challenger appears, she can’t help but smile in anticipation, wondering if this one will be any different.
stories.eternal_flame:
Illuni is the first avatar of Girgas.

For Illuni, every day is a brand-new adventure to discover the world. Driven by a boundless, instinctive curiosity, she can't help but reach out and touch whatever she sees, clutching it tightly in her little hands. More than once, she's gone out with a fresh, rosy face and come back covered head to toe in volcanic ash, so often that even Girgas himself can't help but worry.

Illuni has a natural fondness for all living things. Even when she meets someone for the first time, she greets them with open warmth. But anyone caught by her attention is in for an endless storm of questions. She doesn't actually know many words yet, so her questions are usually simple and often repeated, with her nodding eagerly to show she's listening. On her way home, she quietly mutters the tricky words to herself, rolling them around on her tongue in clumsy, childlike pronunciations.

So lively is Illuni that even after a whole day of play, she hates going to bed. She'll chatter away until dawn, then finally nod off in Girgas's arms. Sometimes she drifts off alone, and on those nights, there's always a little diary left open by her pillow.

'Hi, Diary~! Today I played with Dummy-face, Smiley-face, and Girgas! My favorite was hide-and-seek! But this time, Dummy-face spotted me and went, "There you are!" and I jumped so high! Girgas laughed and called me silly. He said I have to hide my legs too! But it's okay if I get caught. Then I can just hide again! I'm gonna play again and again and again!

Oh! I gave Dummy-face some red water, but they didn't drink it. They said it was lava. Lava's not for drinking, it's yucky! Then the red water went POP! And BOOOOM!!! So... is red water lava? Or yucky??? Hmm... I dunno! There are sooo many funny words in the world! I wanna learn them all!

So I thought about how to do that. Everyone has to stay with me! When we’re together, I learn sooo many new things! And when I copy them, they clap and say I did great! It makes me super happy~! If I learn lots and lots, maybe someday I’ll do something really amazing, just like Girgas! Tomorrow I’m gonna play even more, and if I learn something new, you’ll be the very first I tell, Diary!'

Even in her sleep, Illuni smiles and mumbles to herself—perhaps reliving the joys of the day or already dreaming of the wonders tomorrow will bring. That pure, innocent light is the very reason she is loved by all.
stories.magical_girl:
Haruka is a middle schooler living a double life as a magical girl.

All around the world, young protectors rise to protect their cities. They are called magical girls—chosen ones who wield mysterious powers and fight the monsters that creep from the shadows. With strength beyond their years and bravery shining bright, magical girls became beloved icons and figures of admiration for countless young girls.

But Haruka was different. Her mother, Ayane, always said, "Standing out isn't a good thing. It's safest to be quiet and ordinary." She wanted her daughter to grow up unhurt, following a steady, secure path. And so Haruka did just that. The unintended side effect was a shy, forgettable personality, so invisible she once ended up playing "Tree No. 2" in her elementary school play. Haruka often thought, 'If life were a book, I'd just be one of the nameless extras.' The word "special" always felt distant, and magical girls belonged to a story that wasn't hers.

So when the familiar Shibarin appeared and told her she had the makings of a legendary magical girl, she was left speechless. Not just any magical girl, but to be one born with destiny flowing within her veins? She, who had no talents, no real friends, and nothing remarkable about her, could never imagine saving the world. Yet the more she compared her plain self to the shining image of a magical girl, the more a hidden yearning surfaced: a secret wish to be special. After a brief period of hesitation, Haruka finally signed the contract with Shibarin.

Even as a newly awakened magical girl, on the surface, her life appeared unchanged. She still dashed to school with a slice of toast in her mouth, still tripped on loose shoelaces, and still stumbled into class without catching anyone's attention. But in her quiet corner seat, Haruka listened with Shibarin at her side, stifling a smile as her classmates chattered excitedly about the mysterious new magical girl in town. Reminding herself, silently but firmly, of the mission she had chosen—her mission as a magical girl.
stories.fox_shikigami:
Wakamo is a legendary exorcist and an onmyoji who commands the great yokai Geumho as her dutiful soul.

From childhood, she was said to bear the vision and aura of a reincarnated ancestor. Whether it was lingering spirits unable to let go or unruly yokai, a single playful gesture from Wakamo was enough to bring them peace. So when the great yokai Geumho, who had never before acknowledged a human, chose to serve her as a dutiful soul, none questioned it. Everyone simply nodded in acceptance.

Afterward, Wakamo trained in the sacred mountain where fox dutiful souls resided. Surrounded by her clan's onmyoji, she absorbed vast knowledge and honed her powers. When she came of age, she entered the palace as one of the kingdom's official exorcists. Yet the duties that awaited her were far from the path she had envisioned. Her strength was used only to preserve palace stability, while she was forced to ignore the suffering of those outside its walls. When she voiced her doubts, the clan’s answer was always the same: “Stay in your place.”

“So basically, all you have to do is not leave the palace, and you’re good, right?”
It was a half-yokai boy from the Exorcist Bureau, someone she occasionally spent time with. That absurdly simple remark ended Wakamo’s long hesitation. In the years that followed, she poured her conviction into a book filled with secret arts and broad knowledge. Despite fierce opposition from the palace and her clan, who regarded onmyodo as their exclusive property, she copied and distributed the book across the land. To Wakamo, the art of yin and yang was not the right of a privileged few but a means by which all could learn to protect themselves. For this act she was stripped of her position and cast out of her clan, yet she never once regretted it.

From then on, Wakamo traveled the land with Geumho at her side. She brought relief to those tormented by spirits and yokai, and exorcists inspired by her deeds gathered around her. When the half-yokai boy who had once awakened her resolve joined their ranks, she felt a joy unlike any before. Sharing wisdom with exorcists from many paths, her world—once bound by the limits of onmyodo—expanded beyond measure.

But joy and fulfillment did not last. No matter how many yokai they defeated, disaster always struck elsewhere. Protecting one place meant another fell, and the onmyodo she had passed down to the people proved powerless before yokai that grew even stronger. At last, Wakamo knew she had to choose again: whether to set out on the perilous journey to destroy the "Dark Immortal’s seal," the very source that ceaselessly birthed yokai. A path that could only be paved with the sacrifice of her companions….
stories.gnome_doctor:
Noel is a Gnome doctor who travels the world treating those in need.

Born as Mora in the Gnome Village, she lost her parents early in life during the ongoing war against the Ants. The tragedy left a profound emotional scar within her heart. With no family left, Mora spent her days sitting alone and crying—until one day, an elderly Gnome inventor came across her. He invited her to his home, promising to heal her wounded heart. Having nowhere else to go, she accepted.

As she lived under his care, Mora searched for a way to heal her emotional wound. One snowy day, she found herself comforted by the sight of white snow falling outside the inn’s window. That moment also sparked her curiosity about the outside world. From then on, she observed everything beyond the window, recording her findings in a journal, and dreamed of the vast world outside. She often read the fairy tale “The Little Gnome Adventurer”, and admired its protagonist—Noel—hoping someday to become a brave adventurer just like her.

But one stormy day, Mora leaned too far out the window, trying to imitate the book’s heroine. Caught in a violent blizzard, she suffered severe aftereffects and lost all her memories. With her past erased, the only thing she remembered was the name “Noel.” Believing it to be her own, she adopted it as her new identity.

Time passed. The war between the Gnomes and Ants only grew worse. Wanting to help in any way she could, Noel began learning medical skills, eventually becoming a doctor who tirelessly tended to the wounded. Though the constant injuries kept her endlessly busy, she continued her work with the hope of a peaceful, war-free world.

One day, using one of the inventor doctor’s devices, Noel finally succeeded in ending the war between the two races. Peace returned—and with it, her lost memories. Inspired by the doctor who once healed her heart, she decided to set out into the wider world to heal the emotional wounds of others. After preparing for her journey, Noel leapt into the enormous light once created by the Red Fairy, accompanied by her close companion, the bomb bug Eve. Her body grew to human size, and eventually she met the Knight’s party and formally joined Heavenhold.

Everything in Heavenhold fascinates Noel, who once only observed the world through a small inn window. White beasts with sharp claws and teeth, bustling burger houses filled with people… and of course, the Smiling One she so deeply adores. Whenever Noel sees her idol up close, her heart rate rises noticeably. She recites her prayers with joy each time, though the Smiling One herself remains utterly baffled by the Gnome’s heartfelt devotion.
stories.alicia:
Alicia is a Hero resurrected by an infusion of the Lord of Dark Beasts’ dark ichor, who wields the regalia as a warrior.

A Hero from Sogo Village, Alicia grew up under the tutelage of her father, a genius swordsman, nurturing her dream. Her goal was to slay the Lord of Dark Beasts who stood blocking the Far Side of the World and widen the world beyond. After relentless training, she became one of the 13 heroes. The King of Hiden presented her with the regalia, and she set out to hunt the Lord of Dark Beasts. But she was no match for Clevatess, the Southern Lord of Dark Beasts, and died in defeat, leaving only a shallow cut on his horn.

Soon after her death, she was revived by her nemesis, Clevatess. The Kingdom of Hiden that had hired her had already been annihilated during the single night she lay dead, and to make matters worse, Clevatess’s blood now ran in her veins.

Alicia despaired that the Hero who had taken up arms to slay the Lord of Dark Beasts had become his thrall instead. Yet, oddly enough, the Lord of Dark Beasts before her was engrossed in raising a child. Seeing his interest in Luna, a royal infant, she sensed that the child’s survival held the fate of their world. At the very least, she had to stop him from destroying everything after Hiden.

Even now, Alicia does everything she can to save the world of humanoids. Even in undeath, she remains a Hero.
stories.klen:
Klen is a Lord of Dark Beasts in the form of a humanoid boy.

His true identity is "Clevatess of the Moonlight," one of the Four Lords of Dark Beasts residing in Luna Mountain to the south. Clevatess once had absolutely no interest in humanoids, but a single event changed his perspective: humanoids armed with a red sword invaded his territory. Judging that humanoids could become a threat to his existence, Clevatess slaughtered the party of heroes, including Alicia, and immediately marched on the humanoids' stronghold, annihilating an entire kingdom.

Clevatess was fully prepared to go beyond the kingdom and wipe out every humanoid on the continent of Edthea, but he received an intriguing proposal from an unexpected source. It was a servant boy, dying amidst the ruins, holding a crying newborn in his arms. The boy begged him to spare the infant, claiming the child would prove the value of life, before breathing his last. Though the boy died before hearing an answer, Clevatess accepted his request. To a Lord of Dark Beasts, the time it took for a humanoid to grow up was merely a fleeting moment.

However, contrary to his expectations, raising a humanoid baby was an incredibly difficult task. To feed the hungry, crying infant, he revived the female hero Alicia. But having never given birth, Alicia could not produce milk. Realizing that raising a humanoid child required humanoid knowledge, Clevatess took on the appearance of the page who had entrusted him with the baby and named the child Luna. He made Alicia his servant and later added Nelluru to the group to act as Luna's wet nurse.

Now, Klen devotes himself to raising Luna, concealing the formidable power of the Lord of Dark Beasts. Should anyone dare to harm Luna, every humanoid in Edthea will pay the price.
stories.nelluru:
Nell was born into slavery. Her mother was a slave of the bandit group, the Ravens. The bandits looked down on the slow and clumsy Nell, treating her like livestock. Her only talent lay in caring for babies. With her exceptionally strong maternal instincts, Nell took charge of looking after the infants the bandits had captured. It was only when caring for a child that she felt like a useful being.

One day, a new infant was entrusted to her. The baby was "Luna," a royal child kidnapped by the bandits. Nell fed, rocked, and cared for the baby as she always did. Luna's guardian, Klen, was also being held captive at the bandit stronghold, but Nell had no idea who he really was. Even when Klen personally approached her and suggested she become Luna’s wet nurse and leave the bandits, Nell did not understand the true meaning of his offer.

Although she refused, she was falsely accused of betraying the bandits by dreaming of the outside world and was placed in mortal danger. Even in her final moments, Nell tried desperately to protect Luna from the bandits.

Klen, deeming such a person useful, decided to revive her under the name "Nelluru." Nelluru was resurrected with a sturdy body. As Alicia put it, simply watching Nelluru take care of Luna brings a sense of happiness.
stories.second_bishop:
Lacrima is one of the Avatars of the Flame Dragon King.

In the past, Nidhogg struggled with his own fiery temperament. At peace summits involving numerous dragons, his temper would often flare up, causing the negotiations to collapse. Because of his behavior, the Flame Dragons became known as a race that was always hot-headed and impossible to reason with. Nidhogg eventually sought a being who could correct these flaws in himself.

Thus, Lacrima was born as an Avatar to fill the void within Nidhogg. In stark contrast to Nidhogg's fiery nature, she was always calm and composed. She governed all her actions by set principles, judging right from wrong through sound reasoning and established rules. On the day when all of Mount Volver was plunged into sorrow over the loss of their idol, Lacrima could not afford to indulge in grief even as the Flame Dragon King Nidhogg was being sealed. Believing that the collapse of order following the disappearance of the volcano's pinnacle would betray Nidhogg's will, she established even stricter regulations.

After surviving the crisis of extinction, Nidhogg was released from his seal and abolished numerous treaties and regulations for the sake of everyone on Mount Volver who had been burdened by them. While everyone else rejoiced, Lacrima alone was deeply shocked. For Lacrima, who had lived every moment based on principles, this was a fundamental shaking of her values. In a world without rules, she found herself speechless. Countless legal codes and ancient texts taught her how to uphold principles, but none taught her how to live in a world where they no longer existed.

Leaving the happy crowds behind, she went to the library and came across a picture book titled "The Flower That Always Smiles." The story told of how other flowers gathered around a smiling flower to create a garden, while an angry flower was left all alone. Perhaps inspired by this, Lacrima set out for the plaza to meet people for the first time without any prior appointment or agenda.
stories.carp_girl:
Geumrin is a frail carp sage, yet her sense of justice prevents her from turning a blind eye to anyone in trouble.

Long ago, a massive waterfall and a "Gate" stood at the peak of Shen City's sacred mountain. This gate, which accumulated a powerful force known as celestial energy, periodically released its power into the waterfall, creating intense spiritual ripples. Carp sages would gather to swim against the current, as the condensed power could transform them into "dragons." However, this ascension ritual carried great risk. If someone consumed by greed reached the top, they could become a destructive "Evil Dragon."

Geumrin was one of the sages attempting the climb. To be precise, she was the weakest even among the carp sages, who were considered lower-tier. Her body was naturally ill-suited for accumulating celestial power, and her child-like frame had long since stopped growing. Nevertheless, Geumrin never gave up. She continued her training and climbed the waterfall every time the "heavens opened." She believed that her becoming a sage despite her weakness was surely the will of the heavens, and she desperately wanted to become a dragon to lead the world toward a better future.

After many years, the day the heavens opened finally returned. Geumrin vowed as she climbed the waterfall once more that today, she would finally reach the top... In the process, she exhausted all the celestial power she had painstakingly gathered by helping people in need, but she finally reached the foot of the last waterfall for the first time. However, Geumrin ultimately failed to reach the summit. Another carp sage, who had turned into an Evil Dragon, caused the waterfall and the gate to collapse.

Even so, Geumrin did not despair. Just as she always prioritized helping those in trouble, she stood before the Evil Dragon to protect the people. Then, like a miracle... celestial energy descended upon Geumrin, allowing her to subdue the Evil Dragon and purify it back to its original form. Afterward, Geumrin was no longer obsessed with becoming a dragon. She realized that one doesn't have to be an omnipotent dragon to help others; even as a frail carp sage, she could do plenty.

After the burned village was restored and peace returned, Geumrin left the sacred mountain, leaving the saddened villagers behind. She decided to cultivate her spirit by directly helping those in need in the wider world. However, contrary to her wishes, she faced obstacles every time she tried to help... Because of her child-like appearance, no one believed she was a sage. Unable to perform miracles every time to prove her status, Geumrin had no choice but to share her vast knowledge and old tales to prove just how old she really was. Only after a long conversation could she finally help people, and while she did so with a joyful heart... she sometimes felt a strange sense of self-deprecation.
stories.bridge_messenger:
Seira is a signal soldier for Kanterbury and a messenger of counterattack who fires off signals of hope amidst despair.

Before the Invader invasion, Seira was an ordinary signal soldier in the Kanterbury regular army. Learning from her reliable mentor, 'Kael,' and listening to the peaceful radio chatter was her simple daily routine and source of pride. However, on the day the Invaders attacked Kanterbury, that familiar life collapsed in an instant.

In the chaos of the battlefield, with communication networks paralyzed and indiscriminate bombing raining down, her unit and the refugees were cut off. In a moment of dire crisis, Kael pushed Seira to safety and dove alone into the center of the bombardment. He sounded the evacuation signal until the very end to save others, but when the dust settled, he never reappeared.

The sense of loss from losing the mentor she admired seemed to drive her into total darkness. Yet, instead of succumbing to misfortune or collapsing in grief, Seira gripped the broken radio he had left behind and asked herself:

'If there were someone like him to stay until the end and warn of danger, couldn't we prevent such terrible tragedies?'

The question she posed through her tears soon became the great mission that would guide the rest of her life.

"Someone must warn of the danger."

Since that day, Seira began to rush to wherever signs of bombing appeared to sound the alarm. Thanks to the urgent signals she sounded at the risk of her own life—just as her mentor had done for her—the survivors found the strength to take up arms and fight back against the Invaders.

Watching this, Seira realized something: battle is not just about wielding bayonets to strike down enemies. Saving lives and keeping hope alive is also the most powerful counterattack against the foe.

She can never change the painful past of losing her mentor. However, she can prevent others from losing their comrades and the precious people by their sides.

Today, Seira tunes the frequency of her worn-out radio amidst the flames of the battlefield. As long as she lives, Kanterbury's communication network will never fall silent.
